The thing about growing up in the countryside is you see the same sights day-in, day-out, and for Jinwoo, that means being teased mercilessly by the same local girls. He has a slight reprieve when his family move to Seoul, but when Jinwoo drops out of university, he decides to head back home to help with the family business. The problem is, the position he was promised doesn’t exist, and he instead finds himself the live-in housekeeper of his grandpa’s latest venture - a local share house. To top it all off, Jinwoo finds his hometown, and specifically his new home, is now full of bonafide hotties! With this many young people under one roof, it surely won’t be long before emotions start running high and clothes start coming off…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Caught up in her parents’ political scheme, Yurania is forced to lose her sight and voice in order to marry Duke Casius Euclid and betray him. After being imprisoned for her treachery and despised by all, she makes one dying wish to turn back time and freely live her own life. When Yurania miraculously awakens mere days before the betrayal, she seizes the opportunity to right everything... only to discover that her past relationships and all that she had known weren't what they seemed. 

(Source: Tapas)

*"People become ugly when they're in love."* 

Those are the feelings both Yeon-Ji and her closest friend Mu-Re shared when it came to romance. Despite that, Yeonji risks their friendship by asking out Mu-Re before being brutally rejected. Cursing her former friend's name, she wakes up the next day with the ability to read a person's romantic feelings as though she were in a dating sim! 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Once a winner of the middleweight challenger’s decider bout showdown, Junseo Kang is now a retired fighter struggling to overcome his worst nightmare: zombies. Every time fear catches him, he sees others as zombies. Now with the new opportunity rising, he sees his way out: join the ranker game, win the prize money, and overcome his fragile mental. In an all-or-nothing showdown, a total of 100 characters must fight for their players and eliminate each other to get to the top 5 ranks to win the accumulated prize money of 20 million dollars.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Joo Aesang is nothing if not a hard-working perfectionist who completes any task given to him without a problem. His boss Cha Hanseol on the other hand, is quite the opposite. He’s a lazy and incompetent guy who doesn’t have a care in the world. He has no interest in pretty much anything else except bullying the perfect Aesang.

One fateful night, the final straw comes for Aesang when he’s forced to work overtime to complete an impossible task which was assigned by his evil boss. As he’s leaving work, he accidently finds a voodoo doll and takes it home. Sick and tired of the constant bullying he suffers at the hands of Hanseol, Aesang curses him while hugging the doll. However, unbeknownst to Aesang, it might have worked out better than he imagined it would… 

(Source: Lezhin) 

*Note: Includes six side story chapters.*

Who’s that beautiful man?! It’s only the first day of the new semester, and Heewoong is already crushing on Hongyun, the gorgeous loner who’s infamous for hating everyone on campus. When Heewoong hears rumors that Hongyun has been possessive and emotionally unavailable in all his past relationships, he’s determined to find out who he really is. Will Heewoong be the one to finally push past Hongyun’s walls or will he just be his next toy? 

(Source: Tapas)

*"I've always had feelings for you... Let's do it."*

Growing up, Hyun-Woo has always been confident and popular. But his job has not been easy. One day, he gets accused of an office scandal. Now, he's ready to fight back and show them what he's made of.

(Source: DAYcomics)

MIN-KUK was struggling until SOO-AH and her family helped him out. He worked hard in their store to help out but one day, he saw something he shouldn't have... And the secret that cannot be revealed to anyone keeps building up...!!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After experiencing trauma at a young age, Iselle Blisha is constantly overprotected by her father and older brother. She spends most of her days confined to the Blisha Estate, only finding freedom during her secret visits to her sculpting master to pass on her blessed works of art. As if her ventures outside aren’t worrying enough for her family, Iselle runs into a bit of trouble one day and gets saved by the bloodthirsty grand duke, Lahan El Canox. And what’s more, Lahan soon visits the estate to ask for Iselle’s hand in marriage! Thankfully, the scary rumors surrounding the grand duke aren’t entirely true, and Lahan just might become the greatest shield of all for the always overprotected Iselle… 

(Source: TappyToon)

After getting hit by lightning, he started seeing girls' erogenous zones! Now girls get wet the moment Ok-Hee touches them.

*"I can't take it anymore!"*

But all the lights represent something different? A normal life suddenly turns very sticky!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After the last episode "Servant Yesterday, Crown Princess Today," the author thought she was done with the story. But when she awakens as the villainess, Evangeline, she realizes the ending was just the beginning! To avoid the gruesome end she originally wrote for Evangeline, she resolves to win the male lead's favor and be accepted into his household. But as the plot begins to take strange turns that make Evangeline the new heroine, it becomes clear this story was written by someone else... 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Marriage B: Wed to the Enemy
description:
Goyoh Rubiet did everything in her power to avoid an arranged marriage with the power-hungry Marquess Anthe Betelgeuse. Instead, Goyoh's sister is forced to marry him, but it's not long before Goyoh learns that her sister has been murdered by the marquess. Soon after, as she's struggling with guilt, Goyoh wakes up as a past version of herself. This time around, Goyoh is determined to accept her arranged marriage to save her sister. But is there any way she can avoid meeting the same grisly fate? 

(Source: Tapas)

Won Il-Hoo is eager to return to university life after being discharged from the army. But when he meets the king of campus, Yoo Chae-Heon, things don’t go quite according to plan. Sometimes it seems like Chae-Heon is excited to get to know Il-Hoo, showering him with praise about his good looks and treating him to his favorite foods…but then he rags on him for being a pushover with too much time on his hands! As a tug of war between compliments and curses commences, Il-Hoo may just discover that he is more similar to Chae-Heon than he’d like to admit…and that might not be such a bad thing after all.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four side story chapters.*

Society is corrupt, but no society is as corrupt as Hanbit High School. Cha-Seong, a student at the bottom of the school’s social hierarchy, struggles to survive… until he unexpectedly gains a mysterious ally who claims that together, they can uproot it all. But how? No one knows, but one thing is certain, Cha-Seong’s secret WeTube channel is about to go viral. 

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Dirt needs to be dug up on the Crown Prince Laurent.

Zigrien, having been appointed to work under commander Sir Idris Klyne, has the perfect opportunity to get on the inside and bring to light any incriminating information. There’s just one issue: Idris Klyne is a bloodthirsty maniac and a lapdog of the crown prince. Getting caught snooping by Sir Idris could mean the end for Zigrien. But having access to the royal palace now, this is Zigrien’s perfect opportunity to satisfy his father’s objectives and thus avoid being sent off to do military duty in remote lands. But what was supposed to be standard eavesdropping turns into a shocking revelation. Now Zigrien is caught up in affairs he had never anticipated. Will love and lust wither or bloom in this wicked royal web that Laurent has ensnared him in? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes two Christmas extras.*

Three girls, one guy, team project, easy, right? But what happens when the project... turns non-academic? #Follow me to find out!

(Source: Toomics)

Heilo Lee is a vampire hunter who hasn't slept well since his family was killed in the middle of the night. Determined to discover the identity of the assailant, Heilo accepts an undercover mission in which he must kill Harace Rivera, president of the Rivera family business. But when Harace takes an interest in Heilo and makes him his secretary, he begins to fall for the man he’s supposed to kill. Will Heilo complete his mission, or will his feelings for Harace drive a stake through his plans?

(Source: Tapas)

Bad luck? Fate? That’s never been in the cards for mathematics genius Kang Heeseo. What he trusts are cold hard facts, based on only physics and probability. But his whole world goes toppling down when he’s faced with one Doh Hanbyeol from the popular idol group Illogic. Heeseo finds truth and beauty in Hanbyeol’s beautiful face, and there’s no stopping him from going to the Illogic concert. But then Heeseo fails to get tickets, and the student he’s tutoring, Nam Gunwoo, doesn’t even get into university… And the day after their drunken night of despair, Heeseo wakes up to find none other than Hanbyeol in Gunwoo’s living room. There’s something going on here, and it’s definitely suspicious… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a recent divorce, Seung-Gyu takes in an abandoned human–animal hybrid lingering outside his home, unable to ignore the quiet loneliness they share. As they begin living together, Seung-Gyu names him Samsam and tries to care for him properly, but their gentle cohabitation soon deepens into an intimate bond.

(Source: Lezhin US)

For centuries, the firstborn of House Helsington has been cursed to die young, so the family produces an illegitimate child, Isabella, to take on the curse instead. To get away from her terrible home and live her last days in peace, she wants nothing more than to escape. Her chance comes when Grand Duke Noverdic asks her to marry his son, Cleor. Once she arrives in the north, she is showered with endless affection from both her in-laws and her fiancé... to the point that it's almost suspicious. 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Civil Servant Life Reborn in the Strange World
description:
Den made a promise to his mother on her deathbed that he would find a respectable job. And he almost kept that promise… until truck-kun sent him to a new world. Den is reborn as one of the most powerful magic users and is next in line to be chief of the fearsome Crow Tribe. But Den intends to keep his promise and runs off to the capital to become a civil servant. With a cast of colorful roommates, a family hunting him down, and a shadowy plot to overthrow the empire, can Den actually achieve his simple life goal? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I'm Engaged to an Obsessive Male Lead
description:
One day, Veillyn Orlando comes to the realization that she's been living the last 21 years as a side character in a BL novel and is fated to die in one year! In light of this, Veillyn decides to escape her abusive family and live out the rest of her days in peace. However, her only way out is getting engaged to the male lead of the novel, Jellard Lieseltein. He seems like the perfect candidate for a contractual engagement because he's into men, meaning there's no risk of them actually falling in love with each other... But as the two spend more time together, Jellard seems to be falling for Veillyn. Will Veillyn be able to navigate her growing feelings for Jellard while keeping her inevitable death a secret? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Alpha Yeon In-Jun and Omega Kwon Se-In fell in love in high school but remained friends. However, that changes when Choi Jae-Kyung steals Se-In away by imprinting on him while In-Jun is studying abroad. But when In-Jun and Jae-Kyung get into a car accident, In-Jun wakes up in the other alpha's body! He slowly learns of Jae-Kyung's schemes to take advantage of Se-In's family connections and does his best to protect his omega. Will In-Jun and Se-In get their happily ever after, or has Jae-Kyung damaged their relationship beyond repair?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra.*

Beom-jun is a shy, introverted guy working at an all-girl’s high school as the literature teacher. Owing to his shy nature, he hardly interacts with other teachers, but the P.E. teacher, Yeonwoo, is not having it. When a series of happy accidents force them to share a room together at a training center, Yeonwoo sees it as the perfect opportunity to draw Beom-jun out of his shell and even his clothes… After all, what better way to get to know someone than getting physical?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world of mystical beasts and magic, Rei scours everywhere in search of a cure for his curse. Having undergone extensive human testing by the Alchemist Society, he must find an external source to absorb the mana of the insignia that is eating away at his body. On a quest to find the magical flower flos magicae, Rei follows the sound of a distant groaning to discover its source: the remarkably handsome Kylen, writhing in pain. Though this commander is known to many as the captain of the Beast Hunter Corps, he has a secret all his own - the noble knight secretly holds dragon blood, causing him to transform when his body is ripe with mana. To prevent Kylen’s full transformation, Rei kisses the soldier, using his insignia to absorb the magic that surges within. With Rei now knowing his true identity, the Beast Corps captain must find a way to prevent his secret (and his beast) from getting out. Will this savage captain remain a beast, or become a beauty tamed? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yona’s been dreaming of this day for seven years.
It’s his 18th birthday and he can finally sleep with Park Chang-il. What’s with the age restriction, you ask? Well, Chang-il is a neighborhood prostitute that Yona's been following around like a puppy for years, just waiting for this moment. But one look at Yona’s oddly big junk, and Chang-il has decided he needs to charge double for this little pervert. Will Yona, who has a thing for bad boys, finally be able to seal the deal? And will Chang-il treat this as just another business transaction or can Yona actually win him over…? 

(Source: Lezhin)

Invest like a pro!

The number of individuals investing in stocks is growing daily. But for every brilliant success story, there are countless failures. It isn't easy for small investors to succeed in the ruthless world of stock trading. Still, it isn't impossible — if you can just think like a quant! 

(Source: Manta)

While enjoying a very private moment with porn starring an actress that looks like his stepmom, he ends up cumming on his aunt's face. Living with two beautiful girls isn't all good!

*"I'm going to lose control at this rate!"*

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Kyungho was an ordinary cook before being abducted and forced to fight off a demon invasion in another realm. Years later, he returns to his world, only to find it swarming with monsters. To make matters worse, he discovers that his mother and Earth's guardian deity, Carnis de Lupus, are dying. In order to save them and the world, Kyungho offers to serve Carnis revitalizing meals in return for healing his mother. But does Kyungho have what it takes to be both a hero and a cook?

(Source: Tapas)

Moon-Su has to win another short-film award to become a full-length filmmaker. A good actor produces a good film! To cast the famous actress Su-Ah Kang who returned to film major, Moon-Su approaches her...

*"Hey... This is just casting. How far are you taking this?"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

It's been three years since Weon met Toram at his restaurant and they hit it off as friends. Despite his bad luck in love, Weon always has Toram's sympathetic ear and tasty fried shrimp to cheer him up. However, their friendship is threatened when Weon discovers Toram is a divine snail masquerading as a human! Once the divine world finds out Toram got caught by a human, he'll be demoted to a regular snail and Weon will never see him again... unless he helps Toram earn enough good karma to offset his punishment in just two weeks!

(Source: Tappytoon)

It’s been seven years since Ohn and Seo-woo’s romance began. They’ve been living together for a while now, sharing their daily lives with one another. How has their love blossomed during this time? Come revisit the early days of their intimacy, including their sweet, tender, and hot first experiences together… 

(Source: Lezhin US)
The second season of *Yakuza in Love.*

After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day. Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire. As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart’s desires.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A college freshman and a gym rat, Ga-Won decides to join the cartoon club with his childhood friend Na-Eun, because he fell in love with Da-Yung, who was handing out forms. When he gets rejected from Da-Yung, he goes to Na-Eun for comfort... but her methods are sexy!

*"They say when you do it once, you feel better. Want to fuck me?"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

She only meant to be friends with Gyeom Han, the stranger on the phone. But teasing him awakens something deeper—his surrender, his shame, his desire. And for her, the thrill of it all is far too satisfying to resist.

(Source: Manta)

Secretary Han has been working for the same family for years, so he watched the young master of the house grow up and has always doted on him. But now his beloved young master has taken a special interest in him. Unable to say no to his beautiful young master, they start a steamy sexual relationship. However, Secretary Han is in for an unexpected surprise because his master is going to show him what it’s really like to be under him. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A doctor, Gyeong-Hun Min, has an exceptional grudge against Yeong-U Sin, the chairman of a gang called the Crimson Moon. Desperate to take revenge on Yeong-U for killing his wife and daughter, the doctor finally finds Si-Hwan Ryu, a police officer who has supernatural powers that can surpass the currently invincible Yeong-U. Leveraging this, Gyeong-Hun’s plan is to purposely create a reason for Si-Hwan to despise the Crimson Moon and destroy Yeong-U for good. Will his plans succeed? Will Si-Hwan and Gyeong-Hun finally wipe out the Crimson Moon? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Uriel will give anything to be with Rafflet Mogris, the commander of the Paladins, her savior, and... her master. For years, Uriel happily served as his maid until he left to enlist. Uriel waited for him for seven years before deciding to journey to be at his side in the capital. What the world doesn’t know is Uriel is more than just a maid. In a world riddled with monsters, she has the ability to foresee monster attacks in her dreams. If being with Rafflet means Uriel must join the fight, will her desires be enough to overcome her fears? 

(Source: Tapas)

Up-and-coming actor Seo Gang-U is up for "Rookie of the Year" when his former lover, industry exec Lee Ji-Won, suggests they act like a couple in public. Although they are no longer dating, Ji-Won now needs Gang-U's help to create a dating scandal that will break off an engagement set up by her family. With his lingering affection for Ji-Won, Gang-U jumps at this chance to be close to her again. Although it's all supposed to be acting, will Gang-U's real feelings for Ji-Won blow everything? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

For the past ten years, Baek Ha-Yeon has been living in guilt for ruining the life of his love, Yoon Yi-Han. Because of this, he feels he has no right to object when Yi-Han wishes to continue their relationship despite getting married. At the same time, Yi-Han’s cousin, Yoon Jin-Woon, has been using their secret as leverage to get Ha-Yeon to sleep with him since he also has feelings for him. 

Just when the lives of these three seem to have gotten so irreversibly tangled, Ha-Yeon is sent ten years into the past before the biggest regret of his life occurred. Though he is determined to alter the course of this timeline and save Yi-Han’s life, he wants to keep ignoring Jin-Woon’s blatant feelings for him. 

However, when Jin-Woon offers to help Ha-Yeon avoid the very cause of his problem, the two become entwined all over again…

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes four extra chapters.*

Gang-An’s dream of designing the best sneaker in the world is snuffed out when her sneaker customization team, Tria, loses the Custom Kicks Championship. She tells herself that she has given up on her dream for good and tries to carry on with her life when she comes across a shocking truth. OnGrey, the second-largest sneaker brand in the world, has stolen her design from the Championship! Will Gang-An be able to return to designing despite her fears and succeed in her fight against OnGrey to reclaim what is rightfully hers? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

1-14. **Hwansangeun Bame Jaranda** (환상은 밤에 자란다, Visions of the Night)
*Can you trust what you see?*
Lio lost everything she held dear when her home burned down and her grandmother went missing in a suspicious incident years ago. Now, left with nothing to trust but her mysterious powers of illusion, she hopes to discover the truth of her tragic past in a world where nothing is what it seems to be.

15-22. **Sinui Jib** (신의 집; The House in the Woods)
*"This can't be happening. Let me out!"*
A young man happens upon a mysterious house in the woods and is chosen as its warden. Much to his horror, however, he learns that he is forever trapped inside, and the only way to be free is to lure in a replacement—an impossible feat that must be accomplished from within the confines of the house.

(Source: Manta, edited)

*Note: Includes 1 prologue chapter.*

Six months into their marriage, Yeong-Su can't get any sex as his wife is too busy with work. One day, they decide to go out camping to relieve some stress, and to maybe address their marital troubles. Yeong-Su gets more than he bargained for when another woman comes into the picture!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

I need your energy. Nothing more, nothing less.

Bambi – soon-to-be graduate, top of his class, incubus. Currently there are only two things standing in the way of achieving Bambi’s latest milestone: a college boy named Yoonhu and his delicious energy. On the tails of Yoonhu’s latest breakup, Bambi begins to visit him every night in the form of special dreams. But the attraction is unexpectedly irresistible, and things get convoluted when dreams become better than reality. Everything has always been clear cut and by-the-books for this clever incubus, but will everything go according to plan this time around?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Jake and Judy have been besties forever, but now Jake wants something more... Is Judy on the same page though?

(Source: Toomics)

With her family deep in debt, Hedel Argetnta was looking for any way out of her disastrous situation. Her only option? Marrying the wealthy but monstrous duke of the east, Cassian Ekarde, a total stranger. Upon her arrival in the East, she learns it is a cursed land infested with criminals, and that her new home is full of dangerous servants. Determined to turn things around, Hedel starts to make changes but finds out that the cause of all this mess might be none other than the man she married. 

(Source: Tapas)

"Only the true hero can take down the Demon Lord." Well, Presidio Cage has already accomplished that... numerous times. He can catch the Demon Lord with his bare hands, but every time he does, he's sent to the beginning of the game again. Although he knows all the tips and tricks, he doesn't know how to escape this endless loop. In order to switch things up, Cage summons a "new" hero to defeat the enemy in his stead. Now, he's ready to create the ultimate newbie and finally get back home! 

(Source: Tapas)

Just like most people, Sion Ribellon doesn't want to go to work. But it's not that he's lazy, he just doesn't want his boss to murder him! Before Sion woke up as a character in this world, he read a novel that detailed his death, and his killer is none other than Serifenz A. Pracidus, the Duke of the Holy Lumen Empire and Sion's new boss. Now, Sion has to befriend Serifenz and find out why he eventually turns evil, not only to save his own skin but also to prevent the apocalyptic ending! 

(Source: Tapas)

When you’re a short track speed skater, every second counts. But despite training 24-7, Hoonjae is no match for his arch rival Seojoon. What’s more, with practice taking up all his time, Hoonjae hasn’t been able to explore life’s pleasures - like girls, for instance. One night, he decides to take the plunge and lose his virginity. Once he does, he starts flying across the ice! Plus, all the gorgeous girls around the rink suddenly see Hoonjae in a different light. Soon enough, things begin to get hot and steamy off the ice…

(Source: Lezhin X)

With the entire Belvice Empire awaiting her abilities, Princess Stella’s life is turned upside down when she fails to bring the stars into the sky. Discarded by her family as the empire is overthrown, she is taken in and raised by commoners. But when the empire is restored and her conceited sister finds her, Stella’s peaceful life is threatened once again. Is she doomed to live as a puppet for the family that hated her? Or can she shatter their demands and rise as the true leader of Belvice? 

(Source: Tapas)

Seo-Hwa finally gets hired at the best mattress company in the country, but its CEO, Cheol-Su Gam, turns out to be a sleep demon who hasn't been able to sleep for 600 years! Upon meeting, he suspects that she's his human partner - the only person who can make him fall asleep and allow him to return to the demon world. It's strictly business, but there’s undeniable chemistry between the two of them. Will he be able to go back to the demon world, or will her sudden inability to sleep thwart their destiny? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

While trying to hide the fact that he’s an alpha, Hayden is approached by Brett for help on a class project. However, it turns out that Brett is not only a fellow alpha, but one that doesn’t use scent blockers. The two naturally butt heads and continue as a series of unsettling encounters unfold…until Brett takes things one step too far. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

College graduate Gi-Un creates a hiking club with his friend Jae-U. After having a drink with the queen of the club Jin-Sol and the cute newcomer Da-Hee, Gi-Un blacks out...

*“Don't you remember what you did last night?!”

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)*

Ju Do-Eun learned from an early age that people are fickle. As a result, she's focused solely on things that don't change—for example, her family's world-famous luxury handbag label IJu. In order to clinch her succession of the company, she agrees to get engaged to a famous designer to bring him on board. However, when she becomes entangled with police detective Gu Se-Young, she finds herself developing real feelings for the first time. Can Do-Eun learn to let her personal preferences take over?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Wild Flower of the Palace
description:
Hun is the carefree crown prince of the Taesa Kingdom, wholly uninterested in state affairs and devoted only to his lover. However, Ryuha, his appointed bride, has other plans. With her ruthless tactics and political finesse, Ryuha plans to charm and educate him so that he stands a chance at surviving... But the imperial concubine and her son are dead set on taking the palace for themselves. 

Ryuha must navigate the lies, spies, and savagery of the concubine, whereas Hun must face his growing feelings for Ryuha and figure out why she feels so familiar to him. Meanwhile, a mysterious tragedy from the past tying the two together threatens to rear its ugly head. Will Ryuha be able to use her wit and charm to protect Hun and take hold of the palace before it's too late?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Who knew dating could be so hairy?

After waking up from a night of drinking, Yeon-Hui is shocked to find herself in the bed of the hottest guy at school, Saeksi An! And apparently she gave him a Brazilian wax?! Saeksi gives her an ultimatum — tell everyone they slept together and start dating, or he'll reveal their hairy business!

(Source: Manta, edited)

A young man delivers food to the same house every day. However, the young woman who picks up the food starts wearing skimpy clothes day after day...

*"Is she trying to seduce me?"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

Joo Si-Hyeon, a successful 33-year-old CEO, has decided to return to high school to get his diploma. As Si-Hyeon tries to find a way to balance school and work, Eun Ha-Im is worried about her new job as the older student's homeroom teacher. Ha-Im soon realizes that's the least of her worries, as it turns out Si-Hyeon is the same man she had a one-night stand with in Canada just months ago! The two thought they would never see each other again, but who knew they would meet in a classroom like this?

(Source: Tapas)

After gaining admission to Han University in Seoul, Yunho is sent to live with his brother, Yunsoo, and his wife, Yoosun. But when he walks on his sexy sister-in-law breastfeeding, he is unable to shake the image from his mind. Coupled with the knowledge that Yunsoo can’t satisfy her carnal desires, Yunho is torn between his duty as a younger brother and his hunger for Yoosun as a red-blooded man. But when he becomes the object of the campus bombshell’s desire, it might be just what he needs to serve as a distraction…

(Source: Lezhin US)

The Taesung Gang was everything to its boss, Kang Deokbae. But his golden days come to an end on his 50th birthday, when a rival mob ambushes the gang and fatally injures him. After entrusting Taesung to his loyal subordinates, Deokbae closes his eyes and wakes up 30 years later as Lee Taejun, a 23-year-old gangster! And upon learning that his gang is no longer the upright group it once was, Deokbae swears to set things right... even if he must destroy Taesung from the ground up.

(Source: Tapas)

The super hot gamer girl. The live streamer with the bodacious bod. The sweet and innocent girl you meet through a friend. The world is your oyster and it’s time to catch some pearls! You just never know where you might meet your next match. In what situation will the next hottie come from? They'll all be revealed here, so sit back, relax, and watch these legendary love scenarios unfold!

(Source: Lezhin X)

[Original Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/content/60213137)

***Note:** This is part of [SSS Romance Collection](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/nmxi6tk), this being the first story.*

I reunited with the love of my life after all these years at my new job. But that didn't last long... as all sorts of women start to come at me!

*"Can we... do it until the end on an airplane?"*

(Source: TOPTOON+)

display_title: Love is an Illusion! - The Queen
description:
Free-spirited Alpha Do-Gyeom has finally decided to put her promiscuous past behind her and settle down. As a 39-year-old woman, however, her options for marriage partners have dwindled. Luckily she has her beleaguered Omega secretary, Seung-Ah, to do most of the work of finding a suitable match for her. It shouldn’t be a problem, even if Seung-Ah and Do-Gyeom have harbored secret feelings for each other for years. In fact, arranging Do-Gyeom’s marriage may just be the catalyst for the two of them to finally admit their attraction…unless another Alpha gets in the way! 

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.*

Jaegal Minhwan is only a child when he’s ordered by his father to enter the Midnight Forest - a mysterious and equally terrifying place said to house a great master of the martial arts. Minhwan eventually meets the rumored master, who introduces himself as Beom Dan-ryeong. However, he finds that the mysterious man is nothing as Minhwan imagined. Dan-ryeong is a strong, benevolent, and kind teacher, providing Min-hwan with the warmth he had always longed for. Throughout their years together as master and disciple, Minhwan is certain that nothing will shake their bond. Until one fateful night on the full moon, when it is revealed that Dan-ryeong has an unsatiable appetite for nothing other than… his disciple’s blood. Under the moonlight, the cloying scent of blood intertwines with unknown desires… and the line between master and disciple begins to blur. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes 15 side stories.*

Dating the hottest girl in your high school feels impossible when you’re an average no-name. Min-gi doesn’t have a shot, but that doesn’t stop him from ogling So-yul whenever he has the chance. But now, those days are behind him! College student Min-gi’s set on having fun, as well as meeting up with as many cute chicks as he can. Never did he expect that his high-school crush would appear out of seemingly nowhere, and this time, she seems to be more than a little interested...

(Source: Lezhin X)

Son Je-Wan was a rising star in the broadcasting world until he suddenly lost the ability to recognize faces. The loss forces him to rebuild his career as a freelancer and for three long years, every face was a blur. One day, he finally recognizes someone, Lee Jin, an assistant writer at a TV station he'd bumped into before having face blindness... whose name is also written on Je-Wan's body! Determined to reclaim his place at the top, Je-Wan proposes a contractual relationship with Jin, but things soon spiral far beyond what either of them expected...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Countess Edwith was destined to be executed for stealing Prince Linus' magical heart and selling it. That is, before I became the villainess herself! To avoid getting killed, I set off to search for the heart's whereabouts, only to end up stumbling upon a half-dead Linus! Getting involved with the heartless male lead is the last thing I want, but what can a girl do when her survival depends on it? Besides, it shouldn't be that hard to convince Linus that I'm not as evil as he thinks... right? 

(Source: Tapas)

When life is so bad that you'd rather be held hostage, your next step is obvious. That's what Elaine realizes after a fatal accident slings her back to the past, where she wakes up as her powerless child self. All it takes is pretending that she's the daughter of her evil uncle the king to be captured by the enemy empire's tyrant. However, Elaine knows that she must struggle to prove her value as a hostage in order to survive. Or so she thinks... the last thing she expects is to take the emperor's heart hostage with her cuteness, of all things! It's not long before Elaine is adopted into the imperial family-- which includes a scary empress dowager and three equally intimidating princes. Earning their approval as an outsider seems like an uphill battle, but now that she's come this far, Elaine is determined to win over these formidable royals!

(Source: Tappytoon)

What if your soul could leave your body and possess people -- or even animals? Thanks to an incident in the past, that’s what happens to Marshall Lidiance every time she passes out or falls asleep. No one knows her little secret, but things become problematic for Marshall when she gets absorbed into a teddy bear owned by the icy-cold Duke Ludvillian! Will Marshall be able to figure out what caused the soul absorption while still keeping it a secret from everyone? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Certan was the prince of the demon world who wrecked havoc a long time ago. His father, the king of the demon world, had his soul sealed in an octagonal tablet and he sent to the human world…

By accident, he got stuck with a boy named Go Jin-Yeong…

‘Let’s conquer the martial world with magic!’

The popular martial arts novel, Magic Scholar, returns as a webtoon!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Who said rural life is peaceful?

Tricked by his grandfather, city boy Jiyool stumbles into Heedong village and is now the local vet. Nothing seems to go right for him in his new life, until in a sudden turn of events he is reunited with his childhood crush. Will he survive this bumpy ride on country roads?

(Source: Manta)

High priest Sia awaits her peaceful death after leading a life devoted to helping other people. Instead of finding herself next to Lord Pleon the God, she finds herself in the body of Elena, a woman known to be wicked.
While adjusting to her new body and new life as a universally hated figure, Sia continues to encounter men she had acquainted during her day as a high priest. What's even more surprising is that those men seem to get increasingly obsessed with her. 

*"I am no longer the high priest on whom everyone depended, so why are these men still getting obsessed with me?!"* 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Rainier Cavalier is a handsome duke burdened with an enormous debt. Henrietta Cortez is a wealthy yet neglected heiress. When Rainier’s friend suggests that he “bride-kidnap” Henrietta as a means to relieve his financial woes, he does just that. However, he wasn’t expecting Henrietta to be so beautiful, nor was he expecting her to propose a marriage of convenience that would improve both their lives. Are these two merely business partners in this unusual arrangement? Or could deeper feelings blossom from a simple “marriage by capture?"

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Haeun's peaceful life fell into pieces the night her twin Chaeeun disappeared without a trace. With no way to contact her sister and rent to pay, Haeun has little choice but to go to Chaeeun's company, disguised as Chaeeun herself! Things get even more complicated when she falls for the aloof Oh Joowan, her sister's colleague and mortal enemy! Will Haeun successfully dupe everyone, including her newfound crush, or will the consequences of going twincognito be too much for her?

(Source: Tapas)

After finding out her boyfriend has been cheating on her, Lee Da-Eun decides to forget him with a one-night stand. But as soon as Da-Eun returns to reality at her new job, she discovers that the guy she slept with is none other than Han Gyeoul, her boss! To make things even worse, he proposes to her out of the blue. Though shocked by his offer, Da-Eun gives him a chance. The only problem is, while Gyeoul may be a genius at work, he's a total fool when it comes to love! Does this pair have any hope?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes 12 side story chapters.*

​​Urania was just a lowly maid until she captured the attention of King Kraus III and became his concubine. The nobles and the other maids, however, despised their love and dragged Urania down. Heartbroken and at her wit’s end, she was ready to accept her death, but then a mysterious entity returns her to her past when she is still a maid. With her second chance at life, Urania is determined to become the king’s concubine once more, but this all changes when she meets Oscar, who pushes her to aspire for greater things…

(Source: Tapas)

As an introvert, Alisha Weber has spent most of her time writing the fantasy series "The Knight's Return" under a pseudonym, only to have her freedom threatened when she's pressured to marry. Enter Duke Lhesa Armunt, another introvert with a similar issue and a rabid fan of "The Knight's Return"! Upon meeting each other, they realize they're a rather good match and agree to a contract marriage. But how long can Alisha keep her writing life a secret when living with a huge fan of her own work? 

(Source: Tapas)

It’s not easy to be a broke college student who also happens to a bit of a pushover. Scratch that; it’s damn hard. So when Henry receives an offer to make some easy cash, he caves in quickly. The offer? To impersonate his roommate, Felix, and go to addiction counseling in his stead. So Henry joins group counseling and meets Elliot. The most attractive, seductive man Henry has ever seen…who also happens to be a sex addict. Things are about to get a lot harder than Henry bargained for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After being framed for plagiarism, Hyedo flees to a new city to start over as an art teacher. Just as he’s settling into his new life, he discovers Myeongwol Bathhouse and its stunningly handsome owner, Yoonje. Now, not only is Yoonje completely Hyedo’s type, but the man is incredibly forward with Hyedo. So it’s pretty inevitable that Hyedo falls for the man’s charms and into his bed during one drunken night. But is a happy ending also inevitable for the two of them? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jin-Ha meets his deceased brother's former roommate and lover, Won, at his brother's funeral, and falls for him instantly. Despite Jin-Ha's estranged relationship with his brother, he and Won share a passionate moment and embark on a romantic relationship. Won becomes Jin-Ha's only escape from the tragedy surrounding him. However, Won's charming demeanor begins to crack and reveals his possessiveness and manipulation, which seep into every aspect of Jin-Ha's life. As their relationship intensifies, Jin-Ha will have to face the reality of Won's dark side, or he might find himself trapped in something much more poisonous than he ever imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Ever since changing his WIFI password, a strange video started playing on his TV...

*"Who's that? Is my TV paired with someone else's?"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

Cafe Midnight isn't your average cafe. It opens from dusk till dawn, the master never ages, and... it's a time slip?! There are visitors from different backgrounds and different time periods, all with their own stories to tell. One thing that they have in common? They've all somehow found their way to Cafe Midnight, where they can encounter those living in the present, past, and future. No one really knows the purpose of the cafe, but one thing's for sure-- it's magical.

(Source: Tapas)

I'm learning to love myself. 

Hyeon-Jung, a physiotherapist, dreams of drawing comics despite her family constantly putting her down. Her boyfriend Seul-Gi is a successful cartoonist, but he can't stand it when he finds himself in a rut while Hyeon-Jung matures and evolves. The two find themselves on the way to splitting up... 

(Source: Manta, edited)

Seok is a jovial manservant for a noble family. One day, while out on an errand, he gets a glimpse of a mysterious and alluring performer that has arrived at the market. But a fleeting look won’t suffice. He can’t get his mind off of this enigmatic figure. Will he ever see them again? 

As fate would have it, their paths will certainly cross again. But the complications of their lives and the entanglements of their relationships will mean that things will unfold in ways that are anything but easy. Who will risk it all and dive deep into the blue for a chance at love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

An argument, a fall, and a lie. Determined to save her loveless marriage, Yeonhwa impulsively fakes memory loss to buy herself some time. After all, who would insist on divorcing someone with a brain injury? But now, not only is her ice-cold husband suddenly warm and caring, he’s telling her that they’ve always shared a bed -- even though she knows they’ve never even kissed! How long can she hold him at bay? Does she even want to? And maybe more to the point, who’s playing who, here? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

Da-Eun Jeong and Jong-U Yun are the sole known survivors of two killing rampages perpetrated by a mysterious gang. Many years later, an investigation into a possible copycat crime forces them to revisit their trauma. Da-Eun becomes determined once again to find her boyfriend, Gyu-Heon Shim, who went missing after the murders they witnessed. Meanwhile, Jong-u is plagued by the ghost of “Room 203,” his former neighbor who came within inches of killing him. His sick brother Jong-Seok was his only reason for living, but with Jong-Seok now dead, will he help DaEeun? And will Gyu-Heon ever be found? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

When Park Ha discovers three strange men sitting in her new place, she would have never guessed one of them was the Crown Prince. As Park Ha tries to navigate her new life in Seoul, she discovers bits of her secret childhood and how she came to be separated from her family. Meanwhile, 300 years earlier, the Crown Prince is desperate to find out answers to his wife's mysterious death. Before he does, cosmic forces intervene and he's switched with someone who looks just like him from 300-years-later Seoul. The ultimate crossover between Joseon and Seoul fueled by mystery ensues when the two meet.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

display_title: Wish You: Your Melody From My Heart
description:
Sangyi, an intern at the biggest entertainment company, struggles every day from his boss who's busy stealing his credit, and his jealous teammates. One day, he stumbles upon Insoo performing on the street and is immediately mesmerized by his voice. Sangyi finds Insoo's voice oddly familiar, but he can't seem to remember their bizarre first encounter. Will Sangyi ever find out where he met Insoo for the first time?

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Psychometry is the ability to read the memories contained in an item. Kang Min-Woo has been blessed, or cursed, with this ability. Though only a high school student, he's been tapped by police detective Lee Aran to use his ability to help solve cases. In exchange, Detective Lee will help him settle a score of his own. The job is bearable, until one blood-chilling murder case leads them into a world of violence, madness, kidnapping, and cults that strikes a little too close to home for Minwoo.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Healer Will Not See You Now
description:
An ordinary girl is reincarnated as Diana, the heroine of a third-rate novel who marries the male lead and ends up dying from being overworked as a healer. Earning a spot at the Academy of Magic is just the beginning — can she sidestep the male lead and find a happy ending with Rozen, the man of her dreams?

(Source: Manta)

Adelia Gerard had lost everything. The man she loved was dead, and her home was reduced to ashes. The person responsible for her misery? Her fiancé and crown prince of the empire, Elkarion Yearis. Heartbroken, Adelia vowed to knock him off his throne, but unbeknownst to her, the gears of fate had already begun to turn, sending her unexpectedly back in time. Now 19 again with her world back to normal, will Adelia be able to save her loved ones and bring down the crown prince once and for all? 

(Source: Tapas)

Succubi are the weakest in the underworld... But what if one was able to again sexual control over the Demon King?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Sol Kwon is a moody art major whose life gets shaken up by the arrival of Jeebin Bae—a modeling major who volunteers to pose for the art classes. Sol is attracted to Jeebin, but two factors hold him back. One, his personality isn’t as good as his face, and two… he is dating Sol’s sister. Things take a turn when Sol’s sister breaks up with Jeebin to travel to Europe. Suddenly, Jeebin starts acting differently around Sol… Is Jeebin genuinely interested in Sol? Or is he only giving Sol the time of day because he reminds him of his sister? 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes 23 side story chapters.*

How far would you go to convince your billionaire father that you deserve the keys to his kingdom? Smart, ambitious Seol would do just about anything, including hard labor on a farm for three months. Of course, it helps that her new boss, Bong-Su, is easy on the eyes. Will Seol prove to the hot farmer that she has what it takes? Will she win the respect of her family? Most importantly, how will she keep from falling in love with Bong-Su?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Oh Eun-Soo and Min Jae-Ha are madly in love, but Jae-Ha's best friend, Ji Geon-Wook, is appalled that the two are even together. After putting up with Geon-Wook's rude behavior, Eun-Soo tells Jae-Ha that she wants nothing to do with his pal. But after an unexpected accident takes Jae-Ha's life, the one to bring her up from the dark depths of despair is none other than Geon-Wook. Eun-Soo thought that she had nothing but hatred for him, but could he be the one to make her see the world in color again?

(Source: Tapas)

If you thought life on earth was hard, then try purgatory. What lengths would you go to fight for a life of guaranteed riches and success? These souls might have once forsaken their lives, but now, they’ll fight tooth and nail to return to life. Who will win the survival competition to gain the prize of being revived? 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

In high school, Choi Sung-Jae confessed to his best friend Geon-Hu, but was firmly rejected. Despite staying friends and going to college, Sung-Jae is still ardently in love with Geon-Hu and makes a wish on a shooting star for just one chance to sleep with him. The next day he wakes up in the body of Lee Chung-Min, a fellow classmate and...Geon-Hu's lover?! Chung-Min is now in Sung-Jae's body and makes the wild suggestion that they have a threesome. Is Sung-Jae's wish coming true this easily?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

A runaway noble lady, now a maid at an inn. 

Meryl Parte, the Count's only daughter, escapes an unwanted marriage and flees to Harp Island to keep a promise to her late mother. After a night at the rundown inn Dragondaily, she wakes up penniless and in bed with a mysterious man! He offers to help her, but only if she works as the inn's maid! 

(Source: Manta)

Can't there be friends among male and female? HO-JUN and YU-HA are very close, but never seen each other as a man and a woman. But, the day before HO-JUN went into the military, something happened. In an awkward silence, YU-HA suddenly makes a move and kisses HO-JUN. This turned on HO-JUN's switch... "We're not actually dating, but we treat each other as if we are... Are we a thing?" 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

What if a myth from 300 years ago wasn’t just a myth? According to Joseon legends, it has been told that Haechi, the youngest son of the Jade Emperor, was inseparable from the Princess So-yang. Following the recent discovery of the princess’s tomb, Lee Young-gwang is chosen to curate the exhibition. However, it seems there were more than just ruins in the tomb that was excavated… Haechi reappears in modern-day Korea to search for his princess. Will he be able to find her? And is Young-gwang ready for the adventure that awaits her, full of danger and centuries-old vengeance? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eleanor, a beta nobleman, finally weds his beloved Fenrir—but his joy is short-lived. Unable to bear children, he becomes a source of shame to the family and, overcome with despair, throws himself from a window. But instead of death, he wakes up as an omega… on the morning of his wedding day. With no idea how or why he’s turned back time—or changed sexes—Eleanor must navigate a new reality where his body, instincts, and even his relationship with Fenrir are shifting. As if that weren’t enough, three powerful alphas begin circling him with growing interest. In this second life, will Eleanor protect his love… or be swept into an entirely new destiny?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Carefree Life of an SSS-Class Knight
description:
The world now swarms with supernatural beings called Celestials and the Awakened, people with newfound special powers. But none of this means anything to Yoo Sungwon, an ordinary man trying to live an ordinary life. Unfortunately for him, his peaceful days end when he gets a mysterious text and becomes a rare SSS-class knight with perks to die for. In order to avoid getting killed or targeted by those who want his powers for their own, Sungwon has no choice but to get stronger by leveling up. 

(Source: Tapas)

TAE-MIN HAN, had to break up with his girlfriend because his dick is just too big. After finding out about a statue that grants any wish, he goes there, hoping to make his dick smaller... However, he meets the most popular girl on campus there... and now they have to make a wish together?!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After years of toil and ridicule, one man finally found the Artifacts—remnants of a lost technology so advanced that they cannot be replicated. Several years later, that same man founded a criminal organization in Korea—the Daejung Syndicate. The man expanded his influence using five child soldiers he armed with Artifacts, and Gil-Ja is one of them. But Gil-Ja soon realizes that the Artifacts can free her of the syndicate entirely. However, this freedom comes with a steep price...

(Source: Tapas)

Kyunghoo Ha just wants to know why he got ghosted. Things seemed great between him and his unofficial boyfriend, Wonjoon Baek, until they suddenly weren’t. After two years of military service, Kyunghoo is back and he is ready to get some answers. The only problem is, Wonjoon seems game to hook up, but he doesn't want anything more. Can Kyunghoo get his elusive and mysterious ex to communicate, or will he lose the guy and his reputation by trying? 

(Source: Tapas)

To Heesoo, men are like delicious pieces of cake that satisfy her emotional hunger…which is why she’s sleeping with three of them. She neither chooses nor gives up one for the other and enjoys their company just as partners. She doesn’t want to commit to a serious relationship. But one day, her first love from high school slides back into her life. Unable to give up either romance or sex, Heesoo must now perform a delicate balancing act to keep her secrets. Will Heesoo be able to have all her cake and eat it too?

(Source: Lezhin X)

*Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.*

When Eilec wakes up in the past after slaughtering everyone who played a part in his beloved wife's death, he knows the best way to avoid making the same mistakes would be to let Rose go. Despite this, Eilec is determined to change the future with her by his side, as he can't imagine a life without her. But when Rose regains her memories and sees that Eilec has dragged her into the hellish world of nobles and their political scheming for the second time, he realizes he has made a grave mistake. The hatred and resentment that burns in her eyes are almost as hot as the fire that killed her in the past. Will Rose find it in herself to forgive her husband, or will she burn everything to ashes, including him? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Shi-Woo Jeong is trying to catch his big break when everything falls apart. He gets accused of stalking a star actor and is blacklisted by his high school crush, Tae-Rim Han, who now runs a successful acting agency. Tae-Rim decides to follow up on the disgraced actor only to realize Shi-Woo’s life is in shambles. He takes Shi-Woo in to set him straight, but discovers that there may be more to this talentless hack. Can Tae-Rim add such a risk to his agency’s roster and make something of Shi-Woo while his romantic feelings resurface? 

(Source: Tapas)

Outdoors, with the neighbor’s wife, in the kitchen, on the floor…just about anything you can imagine! Let these tantalizing tales help you break from the monotony of everyday life, and explore your deepest desires!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kyowoo's department buzzes with excitement when the handsome executive director's son, Jiwook, joins as a new recruit. But oddly enough, the other quieter recruit, Leehak, catches Kyowoo's eye more. Could it be because of his clumsiness when it comes to basic office tasks, his subtly aloof attitude at work, or the fact that he wears the same cologne as Kyowoo's crush in high school? Either way, Kyowoo suspects that he's related to someone important at the company, but pretends not to notice. In his efforts to treat Leehak normally, however, Kyowoo ends up capturing his romantic interest. What's more, Leehak turns out to be the son of none other than the company's chairman! Though Kyowoo is reluctant to come off as a hyena after his wealth, Leehak remains persistent... and Kyowoo doesn't exactly dislike him, either. Will the two come together in an unexpected office romance, despite the many hurdles in their relationship? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Many people imagine living the life of a hero/heroine within their favorite fantasy novels. However, what if you wake up in the body of the main villain/villainess instead?

Our main character goes through a seemingly fatal air crash and wakes up in the body of Letisha de Arcadia, the main villainess within her favorite fantasy novel. What's even worse is that she already knows how this story is going to end: Letisha's beheading after her identity as a fake princess gets revealed. To evade her tragic fate, our character must continue living as a fake princess while attempting to forge an amicable relationship with the original protagonists of the novel, Amelita and Sighard.

This is a story of survival.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

HO-CHAN arrives at the kimchi factory his mother told him about... and the first thing he sees... are the manager's huge breasts! Also, his young, sexy co-worker is trying to seduce him as well! Stuck between a mature woman and a young, fresh girl... This is the best place to be!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

*Note: The chapter count includes an epilogue.*

With her wedding ruined by the groom's secret girlfriend barging in, Kang-Wu crashes at her best friend Tae-Ju's place, not expecting to run into her little brother Tae-Hui in the morning. Despite their awkward first encounter, Kang-Wu finds him to be perfect little brother material. But after he protects her from her obsessive ex's harassment, she sees him in a different light. He's tall and good-looking, he's a great cook, he's funny, he's sweet... Wait, has Kang-Wu already fallen for Tae-Hui?! 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

General surgery resident Yoon Hae-Soo has always focused on paying off her father's debt and becoming a great surgeon. But after CEO Chae Ji-Seok enters the ER as a VIP patient, her world is completely turned upside down. Not only does he want her to be his only doctor, Ji-Seok wants to spend every second with her. Hae-Soo can't understand why a stranger would be so interested in her, but she also feels strangely attracted to him. Little does she know that this isn't their first time meeting...

(Source: Tapas)

When Yeo-Eun gets a text message from her boyfriend with details about a hotel room and a time, she is overjoyed. But it’s too early to celebrate because a few minutes later, he sends her another message saying that the first one was for his team’s after-party event. Although slightly disappointed, she decides she should surprise him at the hotel nonetheless. Unfortunately, when she gets there, she witnesses her boyfriend with another woman walking right toward her. In a moment of panic, Yeo-Eun grabs the man in front of her and steals his lips to keep herself from being caught. As it turns out, she just kissed the fiancé of the woman her boyfriend was having an affair with! Now suddenly, Yeo-Eun finds herself caught up in a whirlwind of events full of romance and revenge. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Upon returning from a business trip, workaholic Ko Minhae is met with the news that her crush is engaged to her roommate. Devastated, she tries to drink away her sorrows before a horrific car accident sends Minhae into the past. With a second chance, she swears to live differently... starting by confessing to her crush! But unbeknownst to her, her plans are put in danger by a secret admirer who has his sights set on her. This time, will Minhae finally succeed in making her love come true? 

(Source: Tapas)

Shinwoo Cha likes it rough. When Shinwoo spies his hot frenemy neighbor Taegyung Han and a K-pop singer and his idol Inoch making out, his life will never be the same. He becomes the duo's boy toy, and they pass him around during very awkward moments, and Shinwoo must figure out how to bluff his way amongthe people.

Can he hide his mother's shocking past and his own lusts, or will bullies continue to tease and beat him up? Will he discover whether Taegyung is provoking the bullies or really defending his dignity? And will Shinwoo finally find the meaning of love in a world of conformity and boring rich people?

(Source: NETCOMICS)

*Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.*

I was caught by the evil Elves. What awaits me is a dreadful slave life that is far worse than death... But... What? It's an Elf's instinct to desire a strong male?! And 80 percent of Elves are women?! What will happen to me, Yushin Gilead, from now on?!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

“He looks just like your ex-muse, right?”

Lee Mu-Wan leads a quiet life as a writer. His friends constantly worry about him and his solitary lifestyle. One day, a friend of his decides to hire a housekeeper for him, so Mu-Wan can at least live in relative cleanliness. There’s just one problem. The guy he hired, U-I, looks just like Mu-Wan's ex-lover…

U-I's just a young college kid looking to make some money part-time, but there’s definitely a weird tension in the air between them… Mu-Wan knows it’s wrong to get too close. This is strictly a business relationship and his ex can’t just be replaced by some random kid… But something seems to keep drawing them closer as their mutual curiosity for one another grows...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

I'll be a voice for the animals!

Though Elise is forced to live in isolation, she doesn't feel alone thanks to her ability to communicate with animals. That is until she's sent off to marry the ruler of what's known as the Land of the Barbarians! What adventures, and dangers, await Elise in this strange, new world? 

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Cold Marquis and the Ironclad Lady
description:
Marquis Alpheus Rhodian is brilliant, handsome, and infamously distant. Edith, his no-nonsense treasurer, is roped into pretending to be his fiancée to ward off an unwanted match. But as their fake engagement unfolds, Alpheus’s sincerity leaves Edith questioning what’s real. A cold marquis and a lady guarded in iron - can their contract turn into something more?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A guy ends up posting an ad to sell a dildo on the college online board. What is worse is that someone actually messaged him, wanting to buy it! And it was a really pretty girl too!

*"Are you... going to use that?"*

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Once upon a time, Iris' greatest challenge as a socially inept mage was receiving the occasional client at her workshop. Little did she know that the nasty woman knocking on her door would change that forever. One violent confrontation later, the two women end up switching bodies-- and as it turns out, Iris' new body belongs to the kingdom's infamous shrew, Queen Rosemary! With her original body damaged and the real Rosemary dead, Iris must continue living as the queen. But that's easier said than done when the entire royal court hates her, especially her fiery husband the king... who Rosemary was conveniently plotting to dethrone with the help of her many lovers. Needless to say, Iris is woefully unprepared for the deadliest "ball" of her life, and not just because she's a terrible dancer. All she can do is pray that the moon will guide her through these hopelessly dark times!

(Source: Tappytoon)

A standard parachuting drill turns deadly for Commander Kang San and Lieutenant Kim Biyeon when they land in a mysterious dimension filled with bloodthirsty monsters. The only help they have comes in the form of mysterious texts and rewards for completing missions. As the two soldiers push themselves to their limits to survive, they unlock mysterious abilities that are powerful beyond their control. Can they learn to harness these powers to stay alive and make it out of this twisted game? 

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Washing dishes were a pain so he decided to make someone else do it. But he didn't expect a beautiful woman to show up! It started with dishwashing, but he also had other chores in mind.

(Source: DAYcomics)

After three years of struggling to find a job, Kim Donghyuk manages to get hired at the esteemed company, DN group. Not only is it one of the most highly respected corporations in Korea, but it’s famous for having a plethora of sexy woman in its workforce. This is everything Donghyuk has ever dreamed of… except for just one thing. His boss, aka “the ruffian”, whose nickname stems from the brutal way she treats her subordinates, turns out to be his ruthless high school bully. Will Donghyuk be able to navigate the murky waters of his new office environment?

(Source: Lezhin X)

When rogue pirate Francis Drake comes face-to-face with Elizabeth I, Queen of England, it looks like the end of the line for his crew. But instead, the scoundrel and the sovereign join forces to take down the Spanish Armada, forming one of history's most unlikely alliances. As they work together, this money-crazy man and power-hungry woman find that there may be something else that makes their hearts race... But in the midst of political turmoil and impending war, does love stand a chance? 

(Source: Tapas)

Yong-joon is all set to spend an uneventful summer vacation at his college friend Deok-hee’s place. So, he was not prepared for how hot Deok-hee’s mom, Mrs. Park, is. Blown away by her beauty, Yong-joon is increasingly drawn to her. He knows it’s wrong… but she is like a fine bottle of wine he wants to gulp down in a go. Fate works in Yong-joon’s favor when he finds himself escorting an injured Mrs. Park to the doctor’s office. Alone with Mrs. Park, the young, hot-blooded Yong-joon can no longer control himself and makes his move. But will Mrs. Park give in, or will he be rejected?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The last thing a powerful attorney like Jin Do-Ha wants to do on the weekends is fill in for his sister as a housekeeper. It doesn't help that his client, Yi Won-Yi, always finishes the chores for him. Won-Yi, on the other hand, is just trying to live her best life as far away from her messy family as possible. At the law firm where she works, she's known for being cold and distant, but somehow Do-Ha never sees that side of her. Could her rare show of openness have to do with her feelings for him?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Annoying Older Girl Next Door
description:
Back when I was sick and my friends didn't want to play with me, Eun-Seol was the kind older girl who always took care of me and kept me company. The problem is, even now that I'm an adult, she still clings to me and treats me like a little kid. Because of her, even in college, I ended up with the nickname "Baby" and became a complete loner. Now, I have to make her see me as a man if I ever want to stop being treated like a child.

(Source: DAYcomics)

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.*

6 friends grew up together in a small alley. At night when everyone is asleep, YOON-HO makes a secret with a girl in the neighborhood.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Looking to bust out of his oppressive home life, Gi-Hyeon has decided to work at the amusement park. He’s living in the workers’ dorms and trying to start fresh. That means making new friends, getting the hang of work, and with all the hot girls working here, maybe even land a girlfriend! Things are looking promising when he makes friends with a sweet girl named Hye-Sol. He just has to bide his time and not mess things up! But when a mystery girl, who he first saw in the woods, comes into the picture, could Gi-Hyeon’s wildest fantasies be ruined…or is this just the beginning?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Llewyn Winston is a humble man who lives to serve crown prince Helion Andres Ischeny. Thanks to a blessing cast on his bloodline, Helion never gets sick – so, when one day he suddenly collapses, Llewyn is tasked with finding a cure. Distraught, Llewyn goes to the royal library uninvited…when he is caught by none other than third in line for the throne, Helion’s brother Esteban. Annoyed at the thief that invaded his property, Esteban is ready to have Llewyn killed. In a desperate attempt to save himself, Llewyn kisses Esteban to distract him. After the kiss, the unwieldy prince reveals to Llewyn that he is cursed. The only way to break the spell is for the two to sleep together…and Esteban won’t let him leave until that happens. Is the prince telling the truth? Or could this be a love trap…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Two Empires: A Tale of One Slave
description:
Murdered in cold blood, Emperor Levenoad of Strahss is reincarnated as a slave named Ray in the enemy empire of El Fascher! To make matters worse, he's caught the eye of the emperor, Jiskar, and gets dragged off to the palace as his concubine. In order to escape, Ray must spread his legs for Jiskar in order to win his favor, all while carefully avoiding the jealous, power-hungry empress and crown prince who will do anything to tear him down. More importantly, he must figure out who killed him in his past life... and why. Unfortunately, none of this will prove to be easy with guards at his side 24/7 and his feet in shackles. Will Ray be able to find freedom while uncovering the truth about his past? Or is he doomed to be forever chained in the palace of the enemy empire? 

(Sourde: Tappytoon)

Having grown up in the same household, Sin Cha-On and Mun Se-Han were once inseparable. However, everything changes after the two reach adulthood. Between attending college classes, Se-Han is busy learning the violent ways of a gang boss like his father. Meanwhile, Cha-On has been occupied with his own “extracurricular activities” in hotel rooms to satisfy his inner masochist. But unbeknownst to Cha-On, his childhood friend is fully aware of his dirty little secret and he’s had enough. It’s time Se-Han stops hiding his sadistic desire to break Cha-On and bring him under his complete control...

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

When a sudden fire forces Jae-Gyoung out of his shared living quarters, he's left scrambling for a place to stay-- all while struggling to stay afloat. Just as things seem to take a turn for the worse, Seong-Beom, a college classmate of Jae-Gyeong's, surprises him with a streak of generosity. He offers Jae-Gyeong a spare room in his apartment-- free of charge. But the two couldn't be more different, Jae-Gyeong is reserved, while Seong-Beom's outgoing nature seems to fill every room he enters. As they navigate the challenges of sharing a home, and a budding friendship, their clashing personalities ignite tension, possibly warming up to something more. Will their spark turn into a roaring flame or die out into embers?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 8 side story chapters.*

Mi-Na's world crumbles when her boyfriend of 9 years dumps her a month before their wedding. His shocking confession? He's been cheating on her with her best friend, who's now pregnant with his child. Mina's revenge plan quickly unfolds: hold a fake wedding with Ryeohwi, her childhood friend, as her stand-in groom. As their fake marriage gains momentum, Mina begins to see Ryeohwi as more than just a little brother. Will this charade lead to unexpected love? Or is Mina just playing with fire?

(Source: Tapas)

When corporate director Seo Woohyun goes on a blind date with journalist Lee Byul, love is not on his mind. Nonetheless, charmed by her eccentric personality, he soon finds himself in bed with her. But when Byul suddenly disappears, Woohyun tracks her down at an abandoned hotel that his company plans to develop. To his surprise, it’s a hangout for stray cats, a handsome young actor… and Byul! With the hotel rights and Byul now firmly in his clutches, Woohyun isn’t going to let her go this time.

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Chapter count includes 15 side stories.*

Waking up as the villainess destined for a gruesome death, Olivia de Versace only has two goals in mind: 1. Avoid the Imperial Palace at all costs, and 2. Marry her childhood crush and live her life in peace. With a newfound passion for both swordsmanship and commerce and romance in the air, Olivia is building her reputation as the new local girlboss. But… does all of this attention come at a price? Why are all of these men she’s trying to stay far away from flocking to her side?! 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Vampire's Plans to Die in Peace
description:
After a failed attempt at ending her own life, our female lead is reborn in the body of a blood-sucking Vampire who is unable to die. To her dismay, she discovers that she is Luna, the Final Boss of the Novel, "The Hunter and the Saintess,", which she read before jumping to her death. 

She realizes that her once chance at a clean death is the prolonged and painful end, destined for her at the hands of the novel's protagonists. 

"Please, can't i just die in Peace?!!!" With centuries to go until the protagonists are even born, Luna launches a multi-generational master plan to change the course of the original story. If the protagonists are provided will all the tools and benefits they need, they could destroy her with ease, allowing her to end things in peace. 

For centuries, Luna executes this master plan, only to have her own involvement interrupt her desired outcomes at each turn. With powerful abilities and the influence of noble houses at her fingertips, will Luna's plans to find and raise her fated killers succeed? Will she get the peaceful death she desires? 

(Source: Pocket Comics, edited)

When Karina wakes up inside a novel, she realizes she’s been given a chance to change the tragic lives of the male lead, Roland Bleuet, and his sister, Melisa. Karina saves up as much money as she can and makes a run for it with the children. But to her dismay, the money she has saved up isn’t enough to get the three of them to the capital. Instead, they head for Torres where Karina bumps into Duke Claude Torres, a “talent fanatic” who is obsessed with collecting talented individuals and an antagonist who will negatively impact Roland’s life in the future. Will Karina be able to protect Roland and Melisa from all dangers and give her adoptive children a better future? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

When your secret high school crush becomes your new boss, things can get complicated. Na-Min Kwon hasn’t seen Mr. Jeong since that fateful day at school when he lost control. Does his new boss remember him? Hate him? Desire him? It can be hard to tell sometimes. But spending time together, from client dinners to business trips, just might shine a light on the truth—no matter how unexpected. 

(Source: Tapas)

 *Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

First rule of the workplace: don’t date your boss. It’s a rule that should be easy for workaholic lawyer Hyeon-Seo Cha to follow, especially since her new boss, Jeong-Hyeok Seo, has a reputation of being a heartless playboy who only cares about money. But despite his infuriating smirk and arrogant tone, Hyeon-Seo finds herself slowly being drawn to him as he wears down the armor of cold indifference she’s worn over the years. But does he feel the same towards her? Or is Hyeon-Seo just setting herself up for a devastating heartbreak? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Kwon Ha-Ra is just an ordinary high schooler until she is summoned to the world of Tatara, where she meets her favorite book character, Tori Veriharts. Although star-struck by Tori, she desperately wants to return home to her beloved mother. The only way back, she is told, is to become the successor of the powerful lightning stone and defeat the evil wizard, Parus. With no other choice, Ha-Ra and Tori set out on an electrifying adventure to save Tatara and return home!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Talented office worker Ha-Gong Park’s life takes an unexpected turn when Jin Woon, a former friend who confessed his feelings for him years ago, joins the company. As their mutual attraction rekindles, Ha-Gong begins to notice that Woon keeps avoiding any physical contact. Frustrated and confused, Ha-Gong decides to visit Woon’s home late at night—only to see a stranger leaving Woon’s place...

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note:
\- Chapter count includes a prologue.
\- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.*

He is a dark beast worthy of his name who’ll do anything for money. This is what Isabella Barret is told about Lion Black, the man she must marry while in disguise as his actual fiancée, Violet Lancaster. As dangerous as this gamble is, if Isabella manages to fool Lion until their one-year marriage contract is over, she’ll be freed of yet another contract that has kept her shackled for the past five years. But to Isabella’s surprise, she isn’t the only one putting up a fake act in the relationship, as Lion’s heart might not be as cruel as his reputation suggests. And what’s more, the longer Isabella looks at him, the more she begins to see in him a precious old friend who presumably died years ago…

(Source: TappyToon)

We're doing all right, aren't we?

A single mother who makes a living translating thriller novels, a teenage daughter just a bit on the unique side, and a cat with a penchant for tube treats. We might not be the perfect family, but we're doing our best in our own way!

(Source: Manta)

Eunhyo has always been sweet and innocent. She grew up constantly smiling. But then one day he came into her life and took that innocence away. This man who’s thirsty for sex and violence. Once there to protect her, his presence has now become a curse. Eunhyo needs to escape from this beast at all costs, even if it means killing him…

(Source: Lezhin X)

display_title: How to Train a Good-for-Nothing Rich Boy
description:
As the spoiled son of a rich businessman, Yi Seo hates the idea of labor. So when his father threatens to cut him off unless he starts working, his first instinct is to run away to Germany. There, a mix-up involving suitcases results in him meeting the handsome Jaeha, who invites him to a bar for some wine. After a surprisingly deep conversation, the two men spend a passionate night together. But eventually, Yi Seo is kidnapped by his father's secretary and taken back to Korea. He then spends his days slacking off at his father's company... until Jaeha joins his department as the new team leader!

To Yi Seo's surprise, the man has zero tolerance for his laziness, and threatens to heat things up at work, where people could walk in on them at any minute! Will Jaeha succeed in whipping Yi Seo into a model employee with his torturous yet pleasurable punishments? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

What are the chances of finding love through a dating app? The shy and unexperienced Hyunsoo definitely doesn’t have the answer to that question, or to her nonexistent love life.
