But after hiding her sexual orientation for years, she decides to give the lesbian dating app, “Maybe,” a shot. There, she meets the drop-dead gorgeous Sijin, who whisks her away for an enchanting night together. One night quickly becomes two, and soon they find themselves developing feelings they’d never expected. However, the more they learn about one another, the more they find their past wounds and insecurities returning to haunt them and their relationship. Perhaps what Sijin and Hyunsoo have will be a passing fling, or maybe… it could be the start of something special. 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Yoon-A comes back to Korea from studying abroad and moves in with her sister Yoon-Jung and brother-in-law, Do-Il. She seems innocent but provocative and Do-Il slowly starts to cross boundaries.

*"Do-Il... I want to get to know you better if you know what I mean."

(Source: DAYcomics)*

display_title: Aristité was Blessed with a Curse
description:
In the Kingdom of Strandeon, one man from each noble family is required to serve in the Order of the Royal Vine, and Aristité is chosen to fulfill this duty for House Theseus. One day, while the order is carrying out a mission, a witch places a curse on Aristité, saying that he’ll lose something important. Everyone in the order thinks that this curse is what transforms Aristité into a woman, but little do they know that Aristité, whose real name is Ariel, was a woman from the start. All the curse did was take away her special medicine that changes her voice. With the help of her friends and cousin, Ariel struggles to protect her secret, but someone in the order seems determined to expose her and land her in trouble...

(Source: TappyToon)

*Note: The English translation was pre-released on Tappytoon before the Korean version was published on Naver on October 7, 2022.*

In a land where ungodly demons devour the souls of the living, Hokook is left helpless. Demons destroyed those he held dear, and he is the lone survivor, saved by a band of Taoist Masters. How did this evil come to exist? Rumor has it that these hellish events stem from the mysterious Creator, and the Spirit of Hell will soon strike again. As the Masters struggle to assemble their forces, Hokook realizes he has a hidden skill, one that defies the laws of nature and could save humanity. But to use it, Hokook must commune with the otherworldly. 

(Source: Tapas)

In a world of dwindling omegas, Seyeon finds out she is one of the rare ones — the only compatible match to the Alphas. Immersed in a special care program, Seyeon must survive cycles of "heat" by pairing up with an Alpha of her choice. Not just one... but many.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

Is being a virgin a good or a bad thing? For 24-year-old Joo Hansol, it’s a pain in the ass. Why you ask? Because he finally managed to meet the love of his life but was coldly rejected just for not having any experience. So, he makes it his mission to have his cherry popped. But it won’t be that easy, especially when his best friend is Do Woobin. A man of many talents, Woobin seems to be the only one capable of reining the impulsive Hansol in. Will Hansol succeed in his quest to finally have his cherry picked…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*“Give me this huge, thick banana~”*

JUN used to be the most successful buyer in the company, but after falling into a trap put by his rivals, he is accused of sexual harassment and is sent off to the countryside. However, there is still hope, and he will do anything to make the store a success for his revenge!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The only warmth he felt in his hellish school was from the class president. But she faced the reprisal for her kindness from the same gang that tormented him.

*"Can I protect her from trash that's given up on being human?"* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

display_title: While I'm Back in Time, I'll Get My Revenge
description:
Most people would consider getting a second chance at life a blessing, but Arnell Radfell is furious when she wakes up to find herself back in the past.

Terrified of having to suffer through the horrors of her past life twice, she attempts to end her life again but is rescued by Sir Herbert Schladin, the very man who gave her the courage to end her life the first time.

However, when Arnell finds out that she can use the power of mana, she has a change of heart.

They say revenge is sweet, and now, Arnell is determined to make everyone who made her suffer in her past life pay. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

A university student, a model, a hacker, an auto repair apprentice…the list goes on, and these seemingly unrelated people have one thing in common. They are all from the same graduating class. One day, these 32 former classmates receive a suspicious text message from an anonymous sender. They’re promised $10,000 if they attend a class reunion held on an abandoned island. No one knows who sent the message or why, but they all participate. Some for fun, some for money, and some for the mystery. What will be awaiting them on the island?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Su-Ho isn’t the kind of guy to care deeply about other people. He’s tried the whole infatuation thing once, and it didn’t work out. He’s pretty determined not to repeat the ordeal. Yul is equally, if not more, aggressive about keeping personal boundaries. When the two of them collide, their defensive reactions cause sparks to fly. But are those sparks merely angry ones? Or are they more?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hong Woomi has always loved Park Euijun all her life. But when she finally confesses to him, he flat-out rejects her because they practically grew up together. Heartbroken, Woomi tries to keep away from Euijun at their company, only to end up working with him on the same project. Little does she know, he added her to his team because he's been secretly in love with her all along! With Woomi trying to get over him now, will Euijun successfully tempt her to fall for him again? 

(Source: Tapas)

As the adopted daughter of House Avano, Ines has always been grateful for her loving family. But tragically, half of them succumb to an ancient curse, and only after does she find a way to lift it. An oracle says that she must marry the cold and cruel duke, Kaisac Aljert, to prevent the deaths of the rest of her family. So she enters into a contract with him, but he has a rather steamy stipulation that he wants every night. Can Ines handle Kaisac's passion when she just wants to save her family? 

(Source: Tapas)

With the appearance of the Overlord’s Star in the sky, the world plunges into chaos, and only the one born with the essence of the star can save it. Amidst the upheaval, former comrades Baek Woonhoi and Chun Ryuyoung each dream of becoming the Overlord. Ryuyoung to save his family, and Woonhoi because he has nothing else to lose. But as the star shines brighter, the two find themselves swept up in an impending war. Both men’s ambitions burn fiercely, but only one Overlord can reign supreme! 

(Source: Tapas)

Hyun Jihwan is an aspiring musician who can teleport. One day, he takes a trip to Germany on a whim, and is discovered by Nigel Ernst Kerne. Ever since that fateful encounter, Jihwan begins to frequently visit Nigel, who showers him with good hospitality and affection in return. But as the visits become more frequent and Nigel begins to want more of him, Jihwan isn't sure if this unique double life can go on. Can this unusual long distance relationship work? Or was it never meant to be?

(Source: Tapas)

Taekseung is too busy getting through each day to think about the debris lodged in his skull, ready to kill him someday. He has no regrets, but he still wants to experience a happiness that will make him want to fight for his life. Enter Sunyeon, Taekseung’s high school crush. Mishaps and miscommunication kickstart their casual, confusing relationship, but still--Taekseung is starting to feel like it’s something…more.

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: I’ll Become the Heroine in This Life
description:
If Amber Verdi had known a goddess was a fan of her novel, she never would’ve discontinued writing it. Unfortunately, she’s angered a goddess. And as punishment, she must become a side character and help the female and male leads, Freya Ardel and Kyle Blackwood, reach a happy ending. But when Freya suddenly dies as a result of her actions, she manages to pacify the enraged goddess once again by becoming the new heroine of the story. Will Amber's journey with Kyle bring a satisfying conclusion for her most extreme fan? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ishino would like to say he’s your average drug dealer. He’d really love that. Unfortunately for him, he also regularly goes into heat for some mysterious reason, and this kickstarts his maybe-strings-attached relationship with infamous mafia boss Nemeth. And that’s just the first mafia boss who wants a piece of him. What is going on with Ishino’s strange ability to attract dangerous figureheads, and just how much of his dignity will survive this?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong-oh is a beta who lives with his alpha friend, Yeong-won. They’ve maintained a close friendship for years now, and everything seemed fine…until Ha-yeon, the newly hired alpha at Jeong-oh’s office, brings a crucial fact to Jeong-oh’s attention: Yeong-won has been secretly showering Jeong-oh with his pheromones to keep other alphas and omegas away. As the trust in their friendship cracks and reveals hidden depths underneath, Jeong-oh must navigate his rapidly changing relationship with Yeong-won—which is going to be infinitely harder with Ha-yeon entering the picture. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: In the Jungle With My Boss
description:
Secretary Mo Yeon-Hee had never even made eye contact with her boss, Kang Ha-Jun. So imagine Yeon-Hee’s surprise when he calls her to fly out and join him on his business trip for a special task. Everything is going smoothly until… their helicopter suddenly malfunctions, and they are forced to jump! Stranded alone in the jungle, the two must find a way to survive and get back home. Will Yeon-Hee and Ha-Jun be lost forever, or will they find their way out and into each other’s hearts?

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Hae-In, or Hellen, got his nickname for one simple reason - it sounds like Hell. Hae-In’s specific hell begins after he is kidnapped, finding himself constantly drugged and made dependent on his master, Phillip. But Phillip seems to have a different reason for choosing the name Hellen. Did he really take Hae-In because he wanted a rare beauty, or is there more to it than Hae-In realizes…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note:
\- Chapter count includes a prologue.
\- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.*

As the unfortunate red-hair baby, Tilias is saved at the brink of her death by the beautiful yet penniless Linden family. Reborn as a baby, she's unable to speak or express her gratitude to the Linden family, but that's when she discovers that she sees weather signs on top of people's heads! After countless experiments, she realizes that the weather signs depict people's love affairs. She uses her special ability to read other people's love affairs to her advantage and return the love she received.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Jae-Bok moves to the city from his country home when his step-sister Hyang-A makes an offer. He starts to work as her in-laws' family driver and slowly develops secret relationships with the city women...

(Source: DAYcomics)

Isn't it exciting to imagine doing it with an innocent teacher? I wanted to confess my feelings to the perfect teacher who has it all once I graduate. But she just said that she is quitting her job to get married...!

(Source: DAYcomics)

When a night out to a piano recital turns into a literal nightmare for Seo-Yun, she's unceremoniously inducted into a world of horrifying beings. There, she meets Hui-Won, a charming "superbia" who informs her that she is nothing more than food for these creatures born of sin. Now, she must succumb to the likes of vampires and incubi as they feed on her for sustenance. Can she escape the darkness that lurks under the cover of night, or will she find a reason to stay inside this sinister realm? 

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

After many years, Noah returned to the mansion of his first love to return what he took. However, Henry, Noah's first love, caught him and gave him punishment for leaving him. With words that were left unsaid and the lies spoken in the past, will the two have a happy ending? 

(Source: INKR Comics)

The most powerful families of the court owe their influence to three things: property, titles, and magic. House Konbayazen, lacking a sorcerer, became a laughingstock among fellow aristocrats; that is, until the head of their House took his daughter Sabina and invited the curse of death upon her - turning her into “death incarnate.” This curse causes any who utter Sabina’s name to catch a fatal illness and contact with her flesh causes one’s own to rot away. This new power allows her father to monger fear, killing anyone who dare stand in his way. 

After countless years of abuse at the hands of her father, Sabina is allowed to convalesce in the countryside to regain her strength. He sends her to an empty, abandoned village with the imperial knight Erzan Muskovayev to be her bodyguard… But there is something different about Erzan. Normally repulsed by the heat of another person’s body, Sabina immediately finds an abnormal comfort in his presence. What’s more, Erzan seems immune to any curse that he encounters. 

As the two spend time together in the seemingly haunted village, they find themselves inexplicably drawn to each other, in a way neither knew was possible…

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world where vampires and humans coexist, orphaned Eugene seeks recognition from his enigmatic vampire progenitor, Logan. Struggling with his lack of human emotions, Eugene stumbles upon an intimate scene involving Dominic, sparking a desire to reclaim his lost humanity. To learn emotions, Eugene makes an unusual deal with Dominic, blurring lines of desire, loyalty, and sacrifice in a world where emotions are both prized and perilous.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hwang Hae-Chan, a Phys Ed major, has one nagging problem: despite his many attempts, his relationships never last. One night at a party, he meets Kim Tae-Yi, the Business Department's heartthrob, and falls head over heels. Could all his past heartbreaks have been leading him to this perfect man?

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: Swept Up By the Wind Spirit
description:
After being reborn as a weak wind spirit destined to be killed in the battle against cursed beings, Asella had only one goal: survive! But her plans go awry when she forms a pact with Captain Lassez Siertensia, the man who will cause her death. Desperate to change her fate, Asella tries to find a way to break the pact quietly, only to attract the unwanted attention of four other men who take an interest in her. Will Asella find a way to overcome her misfortune without being swept off her feet? 

(Source: Tapas)

Yoo Heesung is…not a nice person, to say the least. Arrogant, selfish, and criminally lacking in loyalty. So when he decides to steal from his childhood friend, their years of history don’t really weigh upon his mind. Until he wakes up, head pounding, tied to the bed of a dingy room?! Choi Jaeyeon knows just how awful Heesung can be, and is determined to teach him a lesson he will never forget.

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue, 6 side story chapters, and a Christmas extra.*

There's nothing more frustrating than a novel with endless tragedy and zero triumph. Such is the tale of Ophelia, a powerless princess who is used by those around her only to be cast aside and poisoned to death. So when an ordinary bookworm wakes up in the princess's body, she knows that she must rise to the throne in order to survive. Being the illegitimate daughter of the king is a setback, but luckily, she also happens to be the daughter of the palace temple's abbess. Once she pretends that she had a vision of her future self as the queen, the king starts relying on her "oracles" to guide his decisions. But even with her father's support, Ophelia knows that eliminating her political rivals won't be an easy task. Will the new heroine be able to scam her way to queendom, and more importantly, a happier ending? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

One rainy day, Collin Brown is heading home when he feels a strange presence following him. Just before the verge of ambush, he is rescued by Edwin Clark, who happens to be his long-time crush. Now collin has no choice but to keep a dangerous secret... Will he be able to continue this mysterious relationship with Edwin? 

Source: Pocket Comics

Stuck between my first love and my hero.

After suddenly becoming an orphan, Isnelda is sent to live with her cold relatives until she reaches adulthood and can gain her inheritance. Yet upon becoming an adult, a benefactor returns to Isnelda's life, opening her eyes to a world of wealth, greed, lust, and... magic? What could go wrong?

(Source: Manta)

Love is a jungle, and only the fierce survive.

Kidnapped and held captive in the jungle, Tristan's only ally is Jia, a girl who was sold off to the cartel that killed his mother. She protects him—but as love grows, so does the danger. Can they escape together and make those who shattered their lives pay the price?

(Source: Manta)

In a world where vampires are considered superior and lycans are considered inferior, Seojoon is a half-lycan considered an outsider to both lycans and humans alike. Still, he's determined to keep his head up as a firefighter in a society that doesn't recognize his efforts. As a vampire, Ray doesn’t understand that pride, but he is nevertheless determined to take Seojoon overseas. But the two of them have already splintered apart before, and Seojoon isn’t ready to take a leap of faith just yet. As society and Ray both pressure him into a corner, Seojoon finds himself stumbling into the dark of the night, where he just might find his damnation...or salvation. 

(Source: Lezhin)

Can she be the main character?
High school senior Ji-Hyeon Han wants to be the heroine of a teen comic but every application has been rejected. Desperate and running out of options, she takes a chance at a once in a lifetime opportunity to prove herself. Can she finally be the main character for once?

(Source: Manta)

Asha the potion maker remembers everything about her tragic past life, including her former husband, Karligo. They were in a seemingly loveless marriage that constantly left Asha feeling lonely and unfulfilled because Karligo would never even look at her, let alone touch her. But in this life, Asha has met a drastically changed Karligo! Now that he's afflicted with uncontrollable desire and feverish lust, can Asha cure him before his fiery passion burns them both? 

(Source: Tapas)

As the male lead's older sister, Edna Luschen Demirette is destined to die from the void virus, a dangerous disease with no cure. Fortunately, Edna discovers that the virus can be purified by touching Prince Carlen, a poor outcast with divine powers. But as simple as that sounds, Edna's plans to befriend him go awry when he mistakes her for an obsessive fan during their first meeting. Armed with nothing but her sharp wits, will Edna successfully persuade the cold prince and save herself? 

(Source: Tapas)

*"I acknowledge every detail of my crime, and I have no regrets about my actions."* 

Two years ago, a fire engulfed the New Dawn Home for Children, leaving behind a single survivor—a child bearing scars of unspeakable abuse. Despite the damning evidence, the court sided with the abuser, a wealthy heir named Lee Ikjoong. Unable to save the child, Dr. Han Jaeyoung was left with no choice but to watch him return to a life of torment.
But when Jaeyoung stabs Ikjoong to death, he feels no remorse.
With the help of his mentor, Dr. Choi Taekyung, Jaeyoung escapes conviction under a plea of self-defense. Resigned to leaving his medical career behind, his plans change when the charismatic CEO Jae Woojin offers him a position at Seonggyeol Hospital. 

*"If you come work for me, those kinds of people won't be able to harm you so easily because I take care of my people."* 

Though reluctant at first, Jaeyoung finds himself drawn to Woojin’s relentless persuasion. Finally succumbing, he steps into Seonggyeol Hospital—a decision that will entangle him in a web of temptation, power, and justice. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After all-boys schools, a male-dominated major, and a stint in the military, Kim Sungmin has barely even spoken to a woman, let alone dated one. Now, having landed a position at a well-known company, Sungmin feels ready to settle down, until he comes across an article that changes his whole worldview. Faced with the knowledge that women will only ever go for strong alpha males, Sungmin knows he has to change if he wants to avoid a loveless marriage and being reduced to nothing more than a slightly pudgy ATM. Can Sungmin go from boring beta to attractive alpha?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In an attempt to overthrow her tyrannical brother and father, Princess Erinyes Taltal colluded with House Lowenthal... only to have the plot end with the family's death. Her last hope is Tristan Lowenthal, who managed to survive by becoming her slave. But her plans to have him become the leader of the revolt go awry when she discovers Tristan has no interest in reclaiming his family's title or fortune. With such dismal prospects, will Erinyes be able to emerge as the victor in this battle?

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Genius Sales Person: Mind Reader
description:
Jihun Min is a diligent and honest medical sales representative who is trying to make a name for himself in a company that is rampant with nepotism. Hence, he is constantly being outshined by his general manager’s nephew, Junseong Choi, who monopolizes sales performance through lobbying and shady tactics. One day, Jihun is blessed with a special ability that could propel him forward in his career. Things are finally going his way and he’s feeling more optimistic than ever, but will Jihun be able to maintain his strong moral compass and not lose sight of what truly matters? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: The Saintess and Her Secret Chambers
description:
When Aristella gets chosen as the new Saintess for the Temple of Yggmentar, she has no choice but to abide the orders. However, when the goddess of destruction Yggmentar gets sealed into Aristella's body, all hell is about to break lose. Yggmentar lures the young, inexperienced priests to get into bed with her every night, and the men have no choice but to give into her temptation. Even when Aristella isn't possessed by the goddess, she finds herself lusting for the men inside the Temple. It's only a matter of time until she finds out about the dark secret of the goddess Yggmentar, and that the priests aren't exactly the type of people she thought them to be... 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

At a formal marriage meeting, omega Seo-Ho drops a shocking bombshell... he’s pregnant. But there’s a twist: the father isn’t his fiancé, but a complete stranger he only met the night before. That stranger is Eun-Hyun, a wealthy alpha from a powerful family. With no time to backtrack, Seo-Ho is forced into a fake engagement with him, a contract bound by secrets, lies, and complicated emotions. As they navigate family expectations, public scrutiny, and their own tangled feelings, tension simmers between them. Can this accidental couple survive the chaos they’ve unleashed, or will their carefully built house of cards come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Se-Han wasn’t expecting to be turned on...but after catching a glimpse of Chan-Hyeong in bed with another man, he can’t shake the curiosity. As Se-Han begins to grow closer to Chan-Hyeong, Jin-Wu, who’s always had feelings for Se-Han, starts to suspect something. Fueled by jealousy and a few too many drinks, Jin-Wu confronts Se-Han one night. Se-Han’s response? He makes an unexpected proposition…one that blurs every line between friendship and desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

A crowded subway full of people, and a hand that enters from beneath the skirt. The fear of being seen by others, and the pleasure from his touch, gets the girls addicted.

*"I can't believe I came, what's happening to me?"*

(Source: DAYcomics)

For most people, family is important. For Seo Do-wook, it’s everything…especially when it comes to his stepsister, Han Gayoung. After Gayoung’s mother passed away when the two were young, Do-wook made a promise to do everything in his power to keep his noona safe. But when their father marries again to a wicked woman determined to make their lives a living hell, it proves harder than he thought. Attempting to escape, the two move out on their own only to be presented with a new problem. As their once familial love begins to turn into tangible desire, will the two step-siblings be able to resist temptation? Or will they give in to themselves and take their relationship one step too far...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jihyun is tired of being a loser. No matter where he goes, he is practically invisible to everyone…which means he’s never spent the night with a girl, let alone touched one. But after his friend Yoomi gives him a crash course in self-styling, things begin to change... Will Jihyun be able to handle his sudden ascension to campus king? Or will the inner nerd prevent him from reaching his true potential?

(Source: Lezhin US)

If only she could remember his face!

A one-night stand. Three possible suspects— er, lovers. Who did Bori really sleep with that night? A steamy office romance unfolds as our heroine follows the clues to find her man.

(Source: Manta)

Han Sung-Min, an escort who repeatedly fails to satisfy his clients is given a last chance to make a big score. But by some twist of fate, he mistakes the wrong man for his client and leads him to the hotel—only to discover that the man is actually a mob boss...

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note:
\- Chapter count includes a prologue.
\- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.*

I recently started a new job at a café where I met my old sergeant... My hot, sexy, sergeant... And yes, we have a past...

(Source: Toomics)

Ye Woo-Ju has all but given up on remembering who he is after a terrible accident leaves him with amnesia. But he's hit with a cold hard case of déjà vu when illustrious actor Lee Young-Won shows up on his doorstep. While the film star claims to be an old friend, a few steamy encounters suggest their relationship went far deeper than that. Now, with his supposed ex-lover being the epitome of everything he once aspired to be, Woo-Ju starts to think maybe his old self is worth remembering. But what if the past holds such dark secrets that forgetting was the only way to move on? As Woo-Ju grapples with his trauma and a celebrity heartthrob determined to win him over, reigniting the flame he and his friend once shared might just be the key to remembering his true self. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Once upon a time, in a land far away…lived the ordinary and painfully single high school literature teacher, Bu Taekwon. Ordinary, that is, until he found himself transported into one of his students’ comic books. But this wasn’t your typical comic book adventure, and Taekwon never anticipated the unconventional genre awaiting him. To his despair, he was now trapped in a hardcore BL fantasy world, where sex-crazed maniacs - dudes no less! - were ready to enact unspeakable acts upon him. The last thing the forever-single Taekwon desired was to…mingle with the men of this insane realm. But can he really manage to fend off their advances and safeguard his virginity? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Han Yisu’s proud of himself for winning over Kang Jihyung, the perfect partner. Not only is Jihyung incredibly rich and handsome, he’s also turned gay just for Yisu and Yisu alone. For Jihyung, Yisu’s willing to move in with Kang Jungman, Jihyung’s father and president of Cheonbong Corporations, and be the daughter-in-law that Jungman so seems to want. So just imagine his surprise when Jihyung suddenly brings home a woman and declares her his fiancee. And not just any woman, but Jungman’s mistress from his favorite bar. Enraged, Jungman chases his own son out of his home and vows to cut him off. Meanwhile Yisu, heartbroken and confused, wants to move out, but Jungman insists that Yisu needs to “take my son’s place.” Yisu’s always considered himself tough, but all this family drama is too much even for him… Just what is he to the house of Kang? Son-in-law, daughter-in-law, stepson, or maybe…all of the above? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Even angels give into temptation. Once God’s right-hand warrior, the archangel Agnes has succumbed to desire and formed a contract with Lucifer, the ruler of demons. Now as fallen angel, she poses as a simple taxi driver and patrols the bustling city of Seoul during the midnight hours. Cursed by the king of hell to seek souls for her life force, Agnes pursues depraved individuals who prey upon innocents for their own pleasure and uses their carnal desires against them. But when her past comes back to haunt her, a tantalizing game of cat and mouse involving vengeful entities ensues.

This is a mature smut story with mystical themes.

**Official Translations:**  
[English (Dropped)](https://www.lezhinx.com/detail/midnighttaxi), [English](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/midnighttaxi)

Under orders from his police chief, Detective Yoo Ji-Han infiltrates the powerful Hwa Ryeon Seung syndicate. Unfortunately, he gets found out by Han Do-Kyung, the organization's second-in-command, who offers to keep Ji-Han's identity a secret if he becomes Do-Kyung's dog. Amidst the ensuing humiliation, Ji-Han begins to feel inexplicably drawn toward Do-Kyung...

(Source: Lezhin US)

She’s got the perfect guy, she’s just graduated, and she’s about to go on vacation! Kaitlyn’s life was perfect… until it wasn’t. After getting dumped and finding out she has no place to stay, Kaitlyn is forced to crash at the Dune Scape, a dilapidated motel owned by her childhood crush and her brother’s best friend, Cole Thomas! Will sparks fly between the two of them? Or will Cole’s loyalty to her brother doom their relationship before it even begins?

(Source: Tapas)

In Herera, neuro-tech is the norm and immortality is just a body swap away. As head of Herrera’s military, Finlay Eckstein has always had reason to watch the closed-off Prime Minister, Kiaran Bedoya, but not much reason to take an interest. That is, until Finlay comes across a rather…special video. It shows a Kiaran of decades earlier, standing in an S&M club with his eyes fixated on the scene before him. But it’s not the Prime Minister’s presence at a raunchy location that intrigues Finlay - no, it’s the look in Kiaran’s eyes. Lust. Desire. Jealousy. One thing is clear to Finlay, and it’s that the cold and aloof Prime Minister wants nothing more than to be turned into a pleasure slave and Finlay himself is more than happy to oblige. But with these two men both holding positions at the top of Herera’s political hierarchy, could their entanglement have consequences far bigger than mutual satisfaction? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yiram is a half-breed vampire. Which sounds pretty mysterious and grand, but it’s nothing glamorous. He’s a fairly regular guy working as a middle school art teacher, and he doesn’t even drink blood. Mostly because he has a teeny tiny trauma regarding blood, but that’s not important. Hardly memorable…until Hong Jua, the very root of that trauma, becomes his coworker. There’s no way this can go wrong, right? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes 4 side story chapters.*

The girl who always smiles, and brings light to his life... is actually a succubus? One day, after a fire, she turns to him for help. "Can you... let me stay at your place?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Antstudio brings you a collection of five stories that transcend time and space, with each one filled with more love and romance than the last. This collection takes you from a world of demons versus humans to a manor full of unexpected relationships and magical surprises. After that, it brings you to a "sew"lful grand empire and then to a humble sweet potato farm full of lonely longing. Finally, you return to the present day as you reminisce about past loves by "drawing" on happy memories. 

(Source: Tapas)

1. **The Tyrant Princess Wants to Get Married** (폭군 공주는 결혼이 하고 싶어!, Pokgun Gongjuneun Gyeolhoni Hago Sipeo!) \[Somnip, Ppangyaui Nubeopja, Nubi\]
2. **Winter Magic at Nordfield Manor** (노드필드의 겨울엔 마법이 있다, Nodeupildeu-ui Gyeouren Mabeobi Itda) \[Yeongyeon & Se-Woon Jeong\]
3. **The Needlepoint Swordmaster** (자수 놓는 소드마스터, Jasu Nonneun Sodeumaseuteo) \[ Wolhet & Nubi\]
4. **The Field Warrior** (밭 가는 용사, Ban Ganeun Yongsa) \[Da-Da Lee,Ye-Seul Kang, Yu-Sin Kim, Shalom\]
5.**Chalkboard Doodle** (칠판 낙서, Chilpan Nakseo) \[Heung and Hong, Saejagga, Ha-Rim Jung\]

Cha Chan-ok is a man in his forties that grew up believing that happiness shared is doubled and and sadness shared is halved. He is a good man that helps whenever and whoever. But that has come to bite him in the ass. After his father’s death, he has everything taken away from him - wealth, power, status, friends and even his family. However, his good disposition didn’t bring only misfortune. In the past, he ended up saving a young girl called Jae-hee. And after a traumatic event lands Chan-ok in the hospital, she’s the only one willing to help him turn things around. But his path to vengeance might not be as smooth as he’d like. Love, sex, betrayal and blackmail will all be part of the game. 

(Source: Lezhin X)

Lady of Vengeance and the returned Prince.

Cecylia Saryan, liege to the order of Hearthtread and heir to the Dukedom after her father's sudden death, discovers a young boy hidden in his legacy — the Crown Prince Ethan, thought to have drowned 5 years ago. Will Cecylia be able to keep her House intact while helping Ethan reclaim his throne?

(Source: Manta)

A statue said to have been the home of a sex spirit was smashed... by me! And these girls think it moved inside me. Oh, I have an idea!

(Source: Toomics)

display_title: The Tale of a Fox's Love
description:
Yeon is a powerful gumiho with a distrust for love and an even bigger distrust towards humans, but what will happen when she gets involved with Dong-i, a poor painter who defies all her expectations of human nature? Will Yeon finally get the happy ending she deserves, or will she pay the price for falling in love with a mortal?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Do I want to live? Of course I do!

Just before she gets hit by a huge truck, Inseo Han, an ordinary South Korean woman who worked in a research lab, receives a text message offering her a special journey, new relationships, and opportunities for extra income. Determined to make it out of the situation alive, she accepts the offer and soon finds herself in the Raotwan Empire of Laseania as Duke Adrian's 12th fiancee candidate, Isella Derhen. Inseo has to act the role for an entire month in order to make it back to earth alive, but this job requires her to deceive not only a few nobles but the entire empire as well as the emperor. Not only that, but Duke Adrian demands that Inseo must never fall in love with him.

Meanwhile, Adrian, the duke and patriach of House Beleskez, is in search of an adequate fiancee to avoid a royal marriage with the emperor's third daughter, Princess Kiersten. Though things would be very simple if the princess were to marry the duke's son, Lord Aslan, political strife complicates the situation and Adrian cannot simply turn down the marriage. Hence, he seeks someone who can act as his fiancee so he would have a justified reason to avoid the royal marriage until Aslan succeeds the dukedom.

Will Inseo win the deal and the opportunity to save her life? Can she and Adrian pull off the tremendous act without getting caught?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

College student Jung-hyuk just finished his military service and is ready to find a part-time job to pay for his expenses. To celebrate their discharge, he and his best friend Yong-il go clubbing together. Be it a coincidence or not, they meet Jia, Jung-hyuk’s unforgettable first love, and her sexy friend Soojung. Contrary to his wishes, but still unable to refuse, Jung-hyuk ends up having a one night stand with Soojung. As if his life wasn’t already complicated enough, now he keeps running into Soojung and Jia all the time, and he just can’t seem to refuse Soojung’s advances. He is torn since his body wants one thing, but his heart wants another. Add his best friend, his best friend’s little sister and his newly found boss to the mix and things are sure to get even more complicated. Love triangles, steamy nights and unrequited loves. Who’ll be flying high in the end?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Shy and timid Yoo Seoyeong is desperate to get back at Min Jooyeon for ruining her life in high school, no matter how petty the revenge is. So when she sees Seo Jaeha, the gorgeous new department manager of her company and Jooyeon's fiance, she grabs the chance to seduce him into spending a steamy night with her. But what should've been a one-night stand becomes much more tangled as both Seoyeong's body and heart burns for Jaeha's affection. Will she walk out of her revenge plot unscathed? Or will she be scorched by the very fire she started? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

When Robelia Naegrad married Emperor Carmond DeHardt, it was expected that she would produce an heir to the imperial bloodline of the Golden Dragon, one who would inherit the family's mind-control abilities. However, with her own deadly powers being manipulated for her devious mother's mysterious scheme, Robelia must do all she can to avoid sharing a bed with her husband. Caught in between the two, will she be able to resist Carmond's continued seduction and avoid becoming her mother's pawn? 

(Source: Tapas)

After a hard day’s work, Heesu wants nothing more than to go home and have a relaxing time with his…toys. He’s amassed quite a collection over the years so he’s not lacking for options. But one day, things start to oddly go missing from his house. His shampoo, his remote, his half-eaten apple and his most precious toy! Maybe he’s just absent-mindedly misplacing things these days, he is stressed out at work after all. That’s what he thought anyway, until one day he came home and caught the thief red-handed! The only problem is, this thief isn’t just your plain old neighborhood cat burglar, in fact he’s not from Heesu’s neighborhood at all! This thief is from another dimension and now Heesu is trapped there too. Hm, this thief is kinda cute…but no more toying around, Heesu’s gotta get back home anyway he can! 

(Source: Lezhin) 

*Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.*

Mild-mannered Sowol is a business owner like any other -- only his laundry service, Yeon, services demons! Housed in the strange, mixed-use Trinity Residential Complex where demons and humans live side-by-side, Yeon is frequented by deadly demons and annoying customers alike. With a new part-time hire to train and mysterious new tenants moving in, Sowol’s got more than his share of dirty laundry to handle. 

(Source: WEBTOONS)

To claim his family’s title, Rael—a hidden omega posing as an alpha—uses pheromone perfume made by a mysterious perfumer. But when he's told to produce an heir or lose everything, he makes Hyde an unthinkable offer… one only Hyde can fulfill. 

(Source: Manta) 

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

Seol Chae-woo is a top vocal talent at his university with a promising future seemingly his for the taking; until his life comes crashing down before his eyes. When his mother suddenly passes and his father’s business goes bankrupt, Chae-woo is now forced to work odd jobs to keep his crumbling family afloat. But when his uncle approaches him with the idea of becoming a Reset Partner - one who carries an alpha’s child for him in exchange for hefty compensation - Chae-woo has a choice to make. The only problem? The alpha in question is Chae-woo’s rival - the enigmatic dominant alpha Beom Euigeon. Will the two be able to put their differences aside and create beautiful music together, or will this low note in Chae-woo’s life become an indefinite song of sorrow? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Cheaters get punished – that’s how the rules work in most games. However, in the VR MMORPG First Land, exploiting bugs is an open secret, allowing players to gain powerful abilities, expensive items, and level up with ease. Even First Land’s top-ranked player, PotatoFistKim, is a bug user who cheated his way to the top. For Jihan, the user behind PotatoFistKim, the stakes are high as he needs to earn money to treat his sick sister. But he’s eventually forced to face the consequences of his actions, as he encounters a “bug eater” charged with punishing cheaters… 

(Source: WEBTOON)

It’s been almost 5 years since Hyeon-Seo’s wife, Ju-Ha, has passed. Yet he’s still not over the hurt and the lingering feelings of love he carries for his late wife. But who should come knocking on his door one day is none other than Ju-Ha’s younger brother, his brother-in-law, Yu-Ha. Just having come back from studying abroad, Yu-Ha needs a place to stay until he can get a place of his own. Hyeon-Seo gladly lets him stay at his place, but the problem is that Yu-Ha looks too much alike Ju-Ha… And looks like someone’s been sporting a crush all these years, and now that he’s all grown-up and Hyeon-Seo is available, he’s not afraid to make a move and give into these taboo temptations…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five side story chapters.*

Neyra Myers of the Celbrid Empire follows her diplomat father to an eastern country, where she meets a magical Dragon Prince, Haeryun, who claims that she is his destined partner. Enchanted by this mystical stranger with calm eyes and demeanor, Neyra attempts to escape her troublesome life by following the Dragon Prince to another world where she is made his Queen, but soon discovers she has made a grave mistake. After a century of unthinkable suffering and emotional torture, she finds a way out, winding time back to a year before their encounter.

Making amends and vowing to never get tangled with Haeryun, Neyra uses her century of knowledge to pave a different path from her former self. However, fate still brings the Dragon Prince to her doorstep, and this time, his once calm eyes are filled with rage and desire. Will Neyra find a way to escape her destined partner? What is it that the Dragon Prince truly want from her?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

After being betrayed by his ex-girlfriend and former coach, a former MMA fighter, Hyung Dojun, spirals into a life of aimless wandering. One day, he stumbles into a small eatery called Sticky & Sweet and finds himself surrounded by a new set of intriguing women. Hyang-Gee, the shop owner, struggles with debt. Hyunah, the head cook, is free-spirited and bold. Jinha, a regular customer, grows increasingly interested in him. Even Okjoo, a loan shark, gets involved in his life. One man, five women. The tension is thick. The chemistry is sizzling. But can this sticky & sweet atmosphere last?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Baek Uigun is the stud on campus who has it all. The only thing he’s lacking is…a conscience! And after spotting a guy in his lecture who had caught his eye at the club, he starts to make his move. But Dajun, the classmate, slips away like a slithering snake. It’s whatever for Uigun, he’ll just find someone else to sleep with… But things soon become an emergency when he realizes he can’t get it up for anyone else! There’s always pride before the fall…and this time Uigun has got to swallow his in order to get with Dajun… 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

Magical Boy Maple has one goal and one goal only: to protect the land from the evil hordes that seek to conquer and destroy it. Any lewd thoughts are just…a byproduct! He’s dedicated to his cause, that’s for sure, but his powers have yet to fully develop. That is, until the dark leader Daisy comes into his life. One look at those thick thighs and bulging pecs and - poof! - Maples magic comes in. And when the magical gods gift you tentacles, what else are you supposed to do if not use them…?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

In an alternate reality, the Republic of Korea is a constitutional monarchy ruled by the royal family of the Joseon Dynasty (1392-). One day, the shocking announcement is made that the Crown Prince has suddenly died, and the identity of the next in line to the throne is shrouded in mystery. The new Crown Prince is unmarried but expected to attend his coronation ceremony with his significant other, but instead of the beautiful entertainer and daughter of a powerful CEO with whom he was romantically linked, the prince again shocks the nation with a profession of love for another – but who can it be? A plucky, savvy, young reporter Leejin Choi vows to get to the bottom of the story finds that she is strangely connected to the prince.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Welcome to our shared house, where you'll find a lot of eggs, friends and maybe some love! 

(Source: Toomics)

Famous superstar Malcolm... What caused him to throw away all his fame and become a police detective? Will he be able to solve the mystery behind his friend's death?

(Source: Toomics)

You tore out my heart. Now, I must find out why. 

The humans of the Bavenberg Empire and the sea people called mermarcs have been embroiled in a bloody war for over a decade. When a truce is finally called, a young half-mermarc girl called Cordelia is sent to the imperial palace as a token of peace. As the years pass by, she befriends the imperial prince, Noah von Bavenberg, and the lady-in-waiting, Melina von Hannover. She has everything that she could want or need, except for one thing - the ability to set foot outside of the imperial villa. Despite this, Cordelia spends her days free from care, surrounded by the love of her friends and the generosity of the emperor. 

However, on her 18th birthday, Cordelia's life takes a dark and twisted turn. After a horrific incident, she finds herself transported two years back in time. 

Can Cordelia remove the veil from her eyes to discover the sinister truth behind the empire? Will she be able to save herself from the inevitable events to come? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Seisia Lidyne is on the run. After her stepmother berated her once more, it was the last straw for Seisia. With just enough money to take a carriage to a nearby village, she makes her escape from Lidyne Estate. The villagers remain wary at first at the sight of a stranger. Seisia also fumbles as she enters the world of commoners for the first time in her life. Due to a fortunate turn of events, she manages to hide her identity and settle in the village as its healer. She starts her new life as Sha, the village healer. Although some of the villagers remain abrasive towards her, she's still glad that Lidyne Estate is now behind her. Unbeknownst to the villagers and her own family, Seisia possesses healing powers. She comes from a lineage of dark magicians and as a result, she was the black sheep of Lidyne Estate. Her powers remain hidden until she discovers a wounded man one day. She has no choice but to use her powers to heal him. After he's healed he introduces himself as Dian and Seisia speculates that he comes from nobility based on his uniform and knowledge of medicinal herbs. He decides to extend his stay in the village while Seisia's curiosity about him continues to grow. When a villager shares a story about a promiscuous young noblewoman who strongly resembles Sha in description, she decides that it's time to move on to the next village.

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by AniList standards.*

display_title: The High School Survival Guide for a Wizard
description:
Despite her hatred of humans, the powerful wizard Oz decides to attend a human high school and make friends due to an old deal. Unfortunately, she has difficulty adjusting due to her uncontrollable magic. Things get even more complicated when a mysterious tornado from Oz's world drops a knight named Dorothy at her school. In an effort not to blow her cover, Oz quickly takes him in, oblivious to the fact that this annoying intruder may be the key to unlocking the school life she wants.

(Source: Tapas)

I enrolled for the army to forget about my girlfriend... But who would've known I would meet the most sexiest woman in my life there?!

(Source: Toomics)

Welcome to Sedithion, a magical place where dragons, faeries, and demons coexist in peace. It’s also the home of Creserua, the “Twilight Dragon” and the only daughter of the Dragon Lord. Despite this impressive title, Creserua’s physical strength and mana are amongst the weakest of her race. She may not be completely content, but at least her pharmacological talents let her excel above her peers. She’s only just reconciled with the idea that nothing will change for a dragon as weak as herself, until one day...she wakes up next to three familiar figures. Her childhood friend, a faerie she’s grown estranged from, and her demon co-researcher. Not only that, but she’s pregnant with no idea who the father is!

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: This series originally released as a R15 version but rereleased as a R19 version in 2024 after the series completed. The R15 version is completed with 80 chapters while the R19 version is completed with 107 chapters.*

Woo Soo-han is what you would call the “complete package.” He’s young, physically fit, handsome, and has flourishing career to boot. He’s got everything anyone could ever desire, except maybe a relationship. That never bothered him, as work has always been his main priority. Everything changes when he meets his close hyung (and work subordinate)’s wife, Nayoung. From the moment he laid eyes on her, he felt an inexplicable attraction. Soo-han knew it was wrong and tried to forget about her, but when the two cross paths at a night club, and he ends up taking an intoxicated Nayoung back to her house. After discovering her husband isn’t home, Soo-han finds that he is no longer able to control his urges…

(Source: Lezhin X)

Three can be a tricky number: some say all good things come in threes, while others say it’s a crowd. Yoo Joon is pretty sure it’s the latter. Ever since he laid eyes on his classmate Pyo Jong-oh, the wimpy and sickly Yoon has been bitten by the lovebug. Tall and dark, with the perfect personality and a banging body to boot, there’s seemingly nothing wrong with his upperclassman - except for the fact that he’s best friends with Seong Ah-in, Joon’s former friend-turned-rival. Wherever Jong-oh goes, Ah-in is sure to follow. But if Yoon is to have a chance of getting closer to the man of his dreams, he’ll have to put up with it…for now. When the three head off on an overnight trip, Jong-oh and Yoon are finally separated from Ah-in, giving the bumbling Yoon a chance to make his move. Will this finally be the opportunity for Yoon to find love, touch, and companionship? Or will it leave him unfulfilled, heart-broken, and alone? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the heart of Hanyang lies Butterfly Dream, an establishment where powerful men can spend a pleasant night of respite and dream their problems away. Do-Kyeom Baek, a diligent and stoic lord, is one of those men. Like many before him, he has fallen madly in love with So-Rang, the most treasured performer at the Dream, known as “The Butterfly.” Try as he might to push his desires away, Do-Kyeom cannot stop himself from dreaming constantly of So-Rang… 

(Source: Tapas)

Hwang Jaemin has been dealt the worst hand possible in life. Orphaned since young, all he’s ever wanted to do was follow in his heroic parents’ footsteps. But tragically, his last moments are spent choking on his own blood, stuck with a wicked constellation who revels in his suffering. Just as he’s all but given up, a mysterious constellation appears and offers him a second chance! Next thing he knows, he’s gone back three years in time, and his new constellation is claiming to be… his mother?! 

(Source: Tapas)

Do Ahyeon is a total nutjob, at least according to her boss, Heeseong. Not only is she blackmailing him into sleeping with her for fun, but she's got a phone full of guys she's ready to get down and dirty with at a moment's notice. Sharing is caring in Ahyeon's world, and there's more than enough of her to go around. But while wading through her diverse cast of boy toys, from total players to absolute control freaks, Heeseong begins to realize that he has real feelings for Ahyeon. And now, he won't settle for being second... or third, or even fourth best. It's a love-hate relationship of the most complicated kind, but he's willing to do whatever it takes to win this wily woman's heart.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Susan is the perfect and sweet female lead–or so the novel says. Because of this, the newly possessed Lady Medena Rodenherg doesn’t think twice about supporting the protagonist on her journey. However, the story Medena knows isn’t the entire truth, and Susan is actually far from the kind girl she’s been portrayed to be on the pages. This becomes most apparent when she ultimately betrays Medena and has her unjustly executed. Now back in time before ever meeting Susan, Medena decides to take the opposite approach in this life and team up with the novel’s antagonist, Pharren. Lucky for her, Pharren may not entirely be the wicked villain Medena has read about in the original novel…

(Source: Tappytoon)

When war tore Rubika from her life and her love, Armand, she thought everything was over... until she wakes up as her 22-year-old self! Though ecstatic at this second chance to reunite with her beloved, she discovers that she must now marry Duke Kleimore due to her conniving relatives' scheme. Unable to avoid the union, Rubika decides to just get the duke to divorce her instead! With a marriage to break up and a war looming in the near future, will Rubika be able to safely meet Armand once more? 

(Source: Tapas)

Exposing his gigantic dick by accident in campus, Nam-Hyeon is too embarrassed and is thinking of taking a break from school. But what the teaching assistant Han-Yeong, said might be right. He keeps somehow getting linked to the popular girls.

*"Hey, they all want a taste of it~!"*

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Nayoung, a newlywed bride, looks forward to welcoming her husband back home after working overnight as a police detective. But she comes home only to learn he had been murdered. Unable to trust the police, she takes matters into her own hands to uncover the truth. Too bad for them, though. Nayoung turns out to be a former North Korean spy and notorious elite assassin known to intelligence agencies by the code name "Tarantula." How will the Tarantula avenge her husband's death? 

(Source: WEBTOON)

For Sandy the maid, seeing Killian Winifred's handsome face is the best part of working for the Winifred family. But Killian's fiancee, Alexandra, hates his womanizing ways and would rather be struck by lightning than marry him. As if to answer her prayer, lightning strikes Alexandra's carriage while she's out on a rainy day. In that exact moment, Sandy falls off a cliff while gathering mushrooms, landing on the carriage. Next thing she knows, she's waking up in Alexandra's body! With her own body buried in a cemetery, Sandy has no choice but to pretend she's Alexandra. But despite her best efforts, Killian starts noticing changes in "Alexandra's" behavior. The situation get even messier when the real Alexandra's soul shows up and demands her body back. Can Sandy and Alexandra return to their previous lives, or will they have a better chance of getting struck by lightning again? 

(Source, Tappytoon)

Jeong Seo-Hyeon has just about had it with married life. She wants nothing more than to divorce her cheating husband, Ma Gi-Jin, and move on from their loveless marriage. All she needs is his signature on the divorce papers, but… next thing she knows, Gi-Jin has gotten into a major car accident. And to top it all off, it seems he’s forgotten everything about her! Could this be Seo-Hyeon's opportunity to fix things between them? Or will the shards of their broken marriage just end up hurting them both?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Eun-Seong walks in on his crush Ji-U in an empty lecture hall. Their shared secret brings the two closer, but Ji-U is only interested in using Eun-Seong as a means to satisfy his own desires. Eun-Seong grows tired of Ji-U's selfish ways and has a change of heart, just as Ji-U realizes his feelings for Eun-Seong and begins treating him with a fondness like never before. Will this relationship work with the two boys’ positions now totally switched?

(Source: NETCOMICS, edited)

A sexy married woman visits a struggling hypnotherapy clinic. She mistakes JEONG-TAE for her husband under hypnosis, and even asks for sex. Using this power… He plans to get his first love back…!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Do-Bin, the handsome art student, finds himself in the midst of heartbreak and wonders if he'll ever be able to get a good night's rest since his breakup. Jae-Hui, the flower shop owner, has never fallen in love in his life and is uncertain if he'll ever find the one. What will happen when these two unlikely people cross paths? Will they find the answers in each other?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: How to Make Friends and Win Love
description:
Can charisma be learned? 

Desperate to charm his crush, shy Tae-O buys a copy of How to Win Friends and Influence People. To his shock, the book's spirit pops out and starts giving him advice, and he sees a flicker of hope. Follow Tae-O as he learns the art of love, friendship, and social skills from a wise old fox spirit! 

(Source: Manta, edited)

After being gruesomely murdered, Park Juhyeon begs the grim reaper for a chance to find his killer. To solve this mystery, he returns to earth as a ghost and teams up with Choi Seongmin, a vampire who assists the dead in the world of the living. As they dig deeper into the case, Juhyeon uncovers some disturbing clues and slowly realizes that his past was less clear-cut than he remembered. Was Juhyeon really just unlucky to meet an untimely death? Or did he have a hand in his own bloody demise? 

(Source: Tapas)

My name is Lee Sera, and I somehow woke up in the body of the beautiful but despised public enemy of the empire, Igna Larkbella. To make matters worse, a letter just arrived demanding payment on an overwhelming amount of debt Igna acquired after ruining her family's 500-year-old business. It seems like I'm not going back home any time soon, so I need to set things straight if I'm going to survive here. It's time to make this villainess the most popular girl in the empire! 

(Source: Tapas)

"I've been looking for you all my life, but you...you don't remember me?" Within the back alleys of futuristic Jin-gwang district, Kangtae is the ultimate street fighter and task rabbit; an enhanced human with animalistic abilities, he is able to accomplish things most people find impossible. But these powers come with a cost: just like his bestial counterparts, Kangtae is forced into ruts when his wild side takes over. To make matters worse, Kangtae runs into mysterious-yet-alluring Rion—a Virtual World designer who claims to have known him in his youth. As the two explore their history together, they discover a romance nouveau only possible in this new age of humanity... 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes three side story chapters.*

display_title: A Love Story of Heaven and Hell
description:
Oil meets water. Cat meets dog. That's the best way to describe the relationship between Sara, the Queen of Hell, and Marshall, the King of Heaven. Originally forced into marriage to end the brutal conflict between Heaven and Hell, Sara immediately assumes that there's no way she'll actually fall in love with Marshall. Not only is he barely of age, but he is much too sweet and submissive for her fiery personality. Yet Marshall persists in worming his way into Sara's heart, doing his absolute best to dote on her and get to know her better. And despite interference from Sara's jealous ex-fiance and Marshall's scheming older brothers, Sara becomes slowly (and awkwardly) attached to her puppy-dog of a husband. Will the Queen of Hell learn to love Marshall in his entirety, despite her heart of ice? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Trapped in a Fan Fiction With My Bias
description:
One day, my bias suddenly appeared in front of my eyes. I thought I was finally getting rid of my title as the 'unlucky fangirl". Little did I know, the first thing my bias said to me was, "Stop bullying her." My bias was as cold as ice, and next to him was the tragic heroine, 'Rahee'. When there's a heroine, there's always a viallaness. But that villaness is.... me? I ended up as a villain in a fan ficition overnight.

This is not what I asked for! I want to go back!

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

The servant of God, Saharo, breaks the biggest rule for an angel when she momentarily sympathizes with Evil. After letting Evil escape from heaven’s grasp, Saharo loses her angelic wings and won’t be able to reascend until she destroys the dark enemy once and for all. There’s just one problem: her target is reincarnated as a human boy named Yannick Unbrey. While angels have the power to eliminate Evil, they are forbidden from ever killing a human being. Thus, Saharo’s only choice is to watch over the boy and make sure the darkness within him never awakens. But the older Yannick gets, the more he becomes tainted by the wicked nature of the world. Will Saharo be able to protect Yannick from his slumbering demon, or will she end up giving in to its sinful call with him? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yoon-Ji is living a boring and repetitive life. Her desire to be loved and make love is getting bigger by the day. However, that is about to change.

*"Do you want to do it with me? You can if you want..."* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

College student Juwon has a hot girlfriend and everything else a guy could ask for. But when his childhood best friend cum first love, Nahee, moves into his boarding house and joins his college after years of no contact, Juwon finds himself in a sticky situation. Especially when she brings up the promise he made to her as a teenager: to let her, an aspiring artist, draw his hard on. Of course, Juwon tries to refuse, but Nahee is not one to be swayed by reason, and a man can hardly go back on his word, right? But things soon start getting stickier before Juwon realizes what’s happening…

(Source: Lezhin X)

1-12. **Yasi** (야시; The Night Market)
*Do you dare enter the night market?*
One day Mia finds Yuji, an old friend from high school, waiting for her outside her house. She reluctantly agrees to go with him to a night market which turns out to be run by demons. To make matters worse, they can't seem to escape. Does Yuji know more about this strange place than he lets on?

13-24. **Baramui Dosi** (바람의 도시; The City of Wind)
*Care for a stroll on a mysterious path?*
Lost in a park, Jun finds his way home thanks to a mysterious woman he meets on an even more mysterious path. Years later, he revisits this bizarre road with his friend, Haru. They soon discover that not only is this place filled with monsters, but they can't return home! Will they find a way out? 

(Source: Manta, edited)

*Note: Contains a prologue chapter*

display_title: My Husband Ascended as the Chosen One
description:
*"How could you be so self-centered? You have a wife and child!"*

Shirley's husband, George, flees to the capital on his own, saying that he'd return one day as the chosen one. Left all alone, she decides to raise her son, Brandon, on her own and forget about her scoundrel husband. But life is always full of surprises. Shirley had to learn it the hard way, when her irresponsible husband returned to her with pride as the chosen one.

 *"Forget about my past mistake and come live with me, for Brandon's sake..."*

Being forced to accept George's offer, Shirley forgives her husband and moves to the capital city with her son. After all, Brandon's happiness is all she cares about.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

After years of abuse at the hands of those who covet her title as heir to one of the seven great families, Aileen Spade discovers that the red eye she was shamed into hiding all her life is really the source of her family’s great magical power. Ready to reclaim her strength, she enters the magic academy, where she quickly becomes popular with her peers, the protagonist, and… the prince! But when she’s fated to become the story’s tragic villain, will popularity be enough to turn her life around? 

(Source: Tapas)

An ordinary girl meets an extraordinary mage. 

Asha lives a hard life with her alcoholic father. That is, until the day she meets a mysterious stranger who whisks her away and gives her everything she could ever want. Who is he? Why is he so kind? And why does he look at her as if he knows her? Asha wonders what secrets their past holds. 

(Source: Manta)

On the brink of death, Eunji is approached by a handsome devil named Joshua, who promises her a second shot at life with a kiss to seal the deal. When Eunji wakes up to her “second” life, nothing seems different until Dojin, the human manifestation of Joshua, shows up at her school and starts following her everywhere she goes, turning heads and causing drama. Their honeymoon period is cut short when yet another devil, Sora, comes to ruin their fun. Can Joshua save his first love from the forces of Earth and hell?

(Source: WEBTOON)

display_title: APP for the Emperor of the Night
description:
Min-Jun is a loser who only plays video games in his room, but his life completely changes when a mysterious app called “The World is Money and Women” is installed on his phone. Enter a world of ‘Sex Fantasy’, where he embarks on a quest of lust, money and woman… All while getting rewarded for everything he does!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

With a handsome fiancé and a career at a fashion magazine, Jung Dana just about has it all. In order to clinch a promotion, she just needs to get star photographer Park Jihan to do a shoot. Dana manages to convince him, but after the shoot, Jihan disappears and Dana is brutally dumped by her fiancé. Dana bitterly swears off dating, but when she and Jihan run into each other four years later, sparks start flying. Can the two of them overcome their past trauma and find a safe haven in each other?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60201135), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC%EC%9D%80-%EC%82%AC%EC%96%91%ED%95%A9%EB%8B%88%EB%8B%A4/3097)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://tapas.io/series/marriage-no-thanks/info), [S.Chinese](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/16383), [Japanese](https://piccoma.com/web/product/126230)

display_title: My Boss is My Biggest Fan!
description:
By day, Naeul Ju is an unassuming pushover at J&H Tab House. By night, she is Author Juna, a popular writer known for her web novel, Love Shot. No one knows about her secret double life except for her two closest friends. Hiding behind her taglines, she struggles to speak up while working for her ignorant boss, Dobin Kwon. She finds comfort in her cyberfriend, Dobi, who has always been there to support her. Workplace drama, pen names, and hidden identities… what will Naeul do when she realizes that Dobi is actually her ruthless boss, Dobin? 

(Source: Tapas)

In an era where "future photos" can either show a person their life 10 years from now or reveal a blackout that indicates they will die in a decade, Yun Si-U is an ordinary employee at a company that develops such photos. Unfortunately, his work causes him to be haunted by nightmares of his clients' blackouts. So when he stumbles upon a chance to save a little girl whose fate has been sealed by a photo, he seizes it. But can he change a bleak future that's been set in stone? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

As a skilled hacker, Gyeon Woo-Min is hired by a criminal organization to infiltrate Taeyoung Corporation and steal data. However, when the security system goes off, he's caught by no other than the CEO, Tae Beom-Hyun. Instead of calling the cops, Beom-Hyun offers him a deal that's little better than a slave contract. Left with no other choice, Woo-Min signs the contract and finds himself carrying out all sorts of risky and provocative errands ordered by Beom-Hyun.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes seven extra chapters.*

“The emperor devours men,” the servants in the palace whisper. Han doesn’t believe them, until on his very first day of service he is dragged to the emperor’s bedchambers. Hunger and lust drives the tyranny that is rampant in the palace. Will Han be able to sate the tyrant and change him for the better? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seokyung Kang is the most in-demand math teacher in the most prestigious town in the country. One day, she is driven over by a truck and wakes up as Abella, a gorgeous but intellectually challenged daughter of the Archduke. Before she could even get a hold of what's going on, she has to marry the "monster," a hunchback imperial prince who has burns all over his body! But the so-called "monster" turns out to be a hunk and a pretty boy! Now, Abella has to figure out what's her mysterious husband's mind while battling a group of mean imperial in-laws. Can Abella use her role as the "fool of the court" to her advantage to turn her married life around? Watch out, this fool is coming for you!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

Welcome to Seoul, 2022. Woo San is an orphaned gangster who makes a living by stealing and selling artifacts. Following the orders of his gang superiors, he steals an ancient relic that once belonged to Yeong Jong, the 25th king of the Hwa-yeon kingdom. Meanwhile, back in the year 1852, during the Hwa-yeon Kingdom's reign, Heo Myeon is trying to retrieve a precious family heirloom that his father gave away to a disgruntled customer. Something unexplainable happens and San is transported back 170 years in the past and comes across a captured Myeon. As the two tussle over this incredibly valuable object, it is clear that whatever happens from now on, history, as it was known, has been altered, and their destinies are now forever intertwined.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/crazyabout), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/crazyabout), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000065453), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11662748), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=240988), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65386478)

**Official Translations:**  
English: [Lezhin](https://www.lezhinus.com/en/comic/crazy_about)  
Japanese: [Beltoon](https://www.beltoon.jp/detail/crazyabout), [Lezhin](https://lezhin.jp/comic/crazyabout)  
Others: [Spanish](https://lezhin.es/detail/crazy-about)

Taeho, who is a perfumer, has been dating Sunhye for seven years. He felt that their relationship was stuck in a rut and needed some change to spice things up. One day, his best friend accidentally spilled a new perfume on Taeho and that night he realized that she couldn’t resist him because of this powerful new scent. With the creation of this new perfume, Taeho quickly runs to his best friend and asks him to seduce her, so that he is able to make his NTR fantasy become a reality.

*“I want you…to seduce her.”*

(Source: Lezhin X)

…I like you. I like you a lot.

The talk of the town, the famous confession post that was uploaded anonymously. Daon knows intuitively that the post is directed towards him, but he has no idea who wrote it. The upperclassman that only takes care of me? My only female friend? Or the lunatic keep bumping into?

I have no idea. Everyone is suspicious!!

(Source: NETCOMICS)

Ryu Ji-Woo wakes up to a nightmare: blindfolded and leashed, he awakes in the basement of a madman. In order to see the one he loves again, he will have to bend to his master’s will, forgoing his sense of decency for the chance to escape and see the sunlight once more…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note:
\- Chapter count includes a prologue.
\- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.*

Back in high school, Park Haneul was the object of everyone's affection, the popular girl who captivated hearts. Yoo Jung-in dedicated himself to his studies in pursuit of becoming someone worthy of dating her. However, life had a different plan as Haneul married another man. Now, Jung-in finds himself working at a guesthouse, surrounded by bittersweet memories that refuse to fade away. But then, out of nowhere, a familiar face reappears and asks to stay at the guesthouse. Will this unexpected reunion reignite old flames or open doors to new possibilities?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tae-Yang and Hee-Tae have grown up alongside each other their whole lives. Hee-Tae’s feelings for Tae-Yang are so strong that all of their close friends are aware of them. But Tae-Yang, the subject of his affection, is oblivious. The two are so close they live together in the same house, but one day Hee-Tae notices something strange about Tae-Yang. He’s hiding something from him! Out of curiosity and sadness, Hee-Tae barges into Tae-Yangs locked room and sees…Tae-Yang’s chest!..But something’s coming out of them?!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

It’s the apocalypse, and Seoyoung wakes up in a desolated world without any memories. He wanders around until he comes across Younghyun, an esper with the ability to summon and control fire. The two trek across a city of ruins, trying to recover Seoyoung’s lost memories. But Younghyun seems too familiar with the city as it is. There’s something he’s not telling Seoyoung, and it seems the two used to know each other from before. But he’s all Seoyoung has for now… Both of them need a way out of their darkness, but could they be the guiding light for each other? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes nine extra chapters.*

Seon Jin-Woo’s life takes a sharp turn when someone he once helped vanishes—leaving him stuck with a mountain of debt that isn’t even his. Refusing to give in, Jin-Woo stands his ground. But loan shark Seong-Hyeon has other ideas, pressuring him to seal an unusual deal: a contract that uses his very body as collateral. Which begs the question, how far are you willing to go to pay for someone else’s mistakes?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note:
\- Chapter count includes a prologue.
\- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.*

display_title: To You Who Wish For My Despair
description:
Orphaned at a young age and drowning in her father’s debts, Anastasia spent her days starving despite being a noble. One day, her uncle, Count Everdeen, proposed to pay off her family’s debts if she agreed to get engaged to his enemy, Duke Theodore. Having no better alternatives, she accepted her uncle’s offer and moved to Theodore’s palace. Despised by Theodore and his servants, all kinds of mistreatments awaited Anastasia, from ruining her dress to serving her rotten food, with the last straw of Theodore telling her it was a good thing her parents died. However, Anastasia's lonely and depressing life takes a turn when she encounters a gentleman at a ball...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

The "Dirty Talk, Dirty Stories" club is only for people into dirty things... But could romance flourish there too?

(Source: Toomics)

S-class Esper Eunhyeon is forced into a rural transfer and paired with a male Guide, Jaewoo. Bored and biding time until he can return, he's shocked to find Jaewoo tangled up with another Esper. Could there be more to this “dull” partner than meets the eye?

(Source: Manta) 

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

As the end of the dating sim came ever closer, I had decided...to run away.
Woo-hyun, who died in an accident at the age of 25, opens his eyes and finds himself in the world of a dating sim. Suddenly, he is 18 years old again, and the stepmother who had always disapproved of him is revealed to be his biological mother. He now possesses the ability to gauge people’s affection for him with numbers above their heads. Unlike his past life in the previous world, Woo-hyun has the perfect life: loving parents, friends at university, and a sweet, devoted boyfriend named Sunwoo. However, as Sunwoo's “relationship points” continue to increase with each passing day, Woo-hyun can't help but wonder what will happen when the score reaches 100, indicating the end of this “game.” Fearing the loss of Sunwoo, whom he has grown to love with all his heart, Woo-hyun decides to run away in an attempt to prevent the score from rising any further. Nevertheless, Woo-hyun soon discovers that Sunwoo's feelings run even deeper than he could have ever imagined, and Sunwoo is determined to keep him by his side, no matter what it takes. 

(Source: Lezhin)

When an unknown substance called “Burnout Shock” blankets Earth, all fire and energy are disabled, upending modern civilization. Amidst the chaos, Ra Yi loses his mother to the mafia leader Sakan. To survive alone, he takes an experimental pill and becomes a powerful mutant known as a subject. But the side effects are slowly killing him. Now, he must find the Lady of Fire, whose unique ability can heal his condition, and journey to the fearsome Top Zone, where his road to revenge begins! 

(Source: Tapas)

Yu Eun-Wu, the “trophy” of the conurbation army, is dismissed from service and ends up being sent to the central academy.
