There, she meets the president of the dispatch department, Seo Jae-Hee, and a former soldier, Jeong Yun-Hwan, who used to work for Yu Eun-Wu’s past guardian. Seo Jae-Hee offers to protect Eun-Wu while she’s at the academy in return for access to her memories, while Yun-Hwan seems to be out to get her for some unknown reason. Not a day goes by in peace in the academy, and all Eun-Wu wishes for is to fix her shortcomings and return to the army. But in an age of despair where the truth is concealed, these three people are swept up in an ominous prophecy. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

Some people start off their possession stories on an epic journey of discovery and growth–but not the newly awakened Trixie Giuseppe. She’s not even five minutes into her novel but is already married to the biggest creep ever and disowned by her parents. Wishing to free herself from the shackles placed by her awful husband, Trixie takes a job as a servant at a remote estate. But she discovers too late that the “young master” she has to serve is the empire’s foolish prince, Leone Atarta. The novel’s author must’ve misspelled the word “feral” as Leone turns out to be much more of a beast than a simple beauty. And thus begins Trixie’s tale of trying to tame her new “dog” and make him the shining crown prince he’s meant to be.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Dong-Jun has always loved Na-Yeon, who owns a small corner store. She never thought of him as anything but a very close friend. One day, she learns of his amazing hand skills, and asks him for a massage. The pleasure she feels will change how she views him forever…

(Source: TOPTOON+)

display_title: The DARK ELF QUEEN and the SLAVE ORC
description:
JURAL, the Orc chief, asks the Dark Elf Queen for help against the invading Kingdom of Light. However, the perverted Elf is only interested in his dick! 

*"I'll help you... Only if you can satisfy me in bed!"* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After stumbling into her own book and becoming a countryside maid, Behania's only goal is to save enough money, reach the capital, and find a way home. Unfortunately, those plans are ruined when her employer is murdered at the hands of Radeiel Krainu, the novel's psychotic villain. To save herself, Behania aids Radeiel's escape and later offers to help him in return for his protection on her journey. Little does she know that in doing so, she'll end up rewriting her story entirely...

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Supporting Characters Also Need Some Love
description:
While driven in her life and supported by loving parents, Mihyang Kim has been a sidekick, shadowed by her childhood friend, Shiyeon. When both of them suffer a fatal accident, Mihyang is reborn as Damia, and Shiyeon is reborn as Eileene in a new fantasy world.Surprisingly, their new lives as Nobles and Socialites in this new world mirror their lives back in Korea, and Damia drives herself to find her own path in life, escaping the shadow of her long-time friend. However, with Eileene caught in a web of royal politics and a large conspiracy slowly revealing itself in the kingdom, Damia must find a way to help her friend, and survive this new world herself!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

*“You made me like this. You have to take responsibility, Jae-Hee.”*

It’s been ten years since Jae-Hee last saw Sae-Heon. Back then, Sae-Heon was her whole world. But after a miserable breakup, Jae-Hee left all of that behind her and has been focusing solely on her career. At least that’s what she thought until she unexpectedly reunites with Sae-Heon, but this time as boss and employee. On top of Sae-Heon acting like the worst boss ever, he makes an infuriating proposal, a relationship with no strings attached. Will these high school sweethearts find a way back to each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

**“We're starting a club where we do whatever we want! Do you want to join??”** 

The Color Training School is a place that manages all the colors of the world. At this school, there are six colors that each have their own personality—that means each person of a color is supposed to act in the manner befitting their color. This is a rollercoaster of a story about a group of outcasts who don't fit into their assigned colors, and the friends they make along the way! 

(Source: Comikey)

Reborn into a novel, Lulu Ekray knew that she was destined to become the villainess and that she would fall in love with the male protagonist, her obsession with him eventually leading to her execution. Nonetheless, she falls in love with Grand Duke Carlix Rochester anyway, but now, the obsessive one is him! After a night of passion, Lulu gets pregnant, but to avoid becoming the villainess, she decides to leave Carlix. But Lulu has no idea just what lengths Carlix will go to get her back! 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: chapter count includes 18 side stories.*
Special chapters for Downpour.

display_title: Legend of the Thousand Year Tiger
description:
A tiger-hating hunter, a human-loving tiger, and a possessed tax collector walk into a historical webtoon. This thrilling yet passionate tale follows these three entities as they defy the food chain and challenge the order of nature. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Marianne Pon Cling, a beloved daughter of house Cling and the wife of marquess Chester, was betrayed and murdered by her husband one gloomy night because she knew about the marquess's plot against the emperor. When she was brought back to life, she decides to pay a visit to the emperor to report her husband's future coup, the emperor makes the offer that she can't refuse. *"Be my fiancee and spy on marquess."*

(Source: Pocket Comics)

When his mother became the mistress of a wealthy chairman, Seon-Woo was forced into the role of a “perfect” son in a picture-perfect but hollow family. No matter how hard he tried, he could never measure up... Especially next to Seung-Wook, who seemed to have everything from the start. Their bond fractured, and they went their separate ways. Five years later, Seung-Wook returns from abroad, and their paths cross again. But instead of reconciliation, he offers Seon-Woo a dangerous proposition…one that crosses a line neither of them can ever take back.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After becoming the #1 player in "New World," Ark has lost his drive to play and simply fixes things in the game. One day, the government asks him to help defeat Lucifer, an AI from the game who has escaped to the real world and occupied nuclear generators. Lucifer states that he won't detonate them if Ark joins the new game "Galaxian" and defeats him. Excited to play and take down an old foe, Ark joins the game, but this "legend" can't figure out how to get out of the tutorial stage!

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Love and Blade: Girl in Peril
description:
I was reborn as a web novel character and found out that I was destined to be assassinated by my rivals! 

My name is Moyong Ah-rin, a girl who just lost her parents and joined the Moyong sect, one of the strongest groups in Murim. To avoid the inevitable, I disguised myself as a boy and changed my name to Moyong Ah-hyun. But there's one problem, my brother-in-arms and distant relative, Moyong Chun, is taking an interest in me... 

Stop obsessing over me, Brother Chun! If you love me, my fate won't change!

(Source: POCKET COMICS) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Everyone has at least one dirty little secret.

As a result of a game started by her father, Ellie grew up unable to speak or write very well. Knowing her condition, three men disclose their deepest secrets to her. However, just as they begin taking an interest in her, Ellie disappears. She's eventually found, but this time, she can speak!

(Source: Manta) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Love is divine.

Miso Lee lives an uneventful life. Then one day, a man drops down from the heavens before her and claims to be a god. He also insists that Miso has a ring… one he had given to his lover centuries ago. Is he telling the truth? And if he is, does that mean Miso is the reincarnation of his old lover?

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Although originally a Korean work, the first publication in an eligible country of origin was the Chinese translation.*

With her best interests at heart, Ethan decides to let his first love, Ruellie, wed his faithful knight, Zenon. However, on the day she is set to travel and meet her betrothed's family, tragedy strikes and she is found unconscious with her fiancé having gone missing. Ethan saves Ruellie, but upon waking up finds that not only did she lose her memories, she thinks Ethan is her fiancé! Will he be able to right these wrongs by recovering Ruellie's memories and finding Zenon?

(Source: Tapas)

Growing up in a world of monsters and angels, Yoo Jaya learns from a young age that there's no such thing as safety. Now, he makes a living as a Hyena - a scavenger for monster parts - but an unpleasant prophecy from an angel puts a time limit on his survival. It seems like his only hope is the one who gave him his powers…the noble archangel, Metatron. Finding her is said to be impossible, but he has to try! And so, Yoo Jaya’s unforgettable adventure begins.

(Source: Lezhin X)

Gangju Lee is a new star in the K-pop world. When a stalker starts to get too close, his CEO insists on hiring a security detail. Han-ah Dae is now in charge of Gangju’s protection and deems it safest that the two live together. Gangju initially rejects the idea until he sees the many benefits of having an extremely hot roommate who will guard him at all costs and has a knack for anticipating even his most minor needs. And Gangju has some pretty big needs that only Han-ah is equipped to fill… 

(Source: Tapas)

From [Tapas](https://www.mangaupdates.com/groups.html?id=4290065293):  

Kkotbun lives a miserable life as a slave in Joseon. As punishment for merely wanting an education, she is sent up a mountain to catch a rabbit in the dead of winter. When she comes across a ferocious tiger, she thinks she’s met her end, but to her surprise, she wakes up in a world filled with colorful magic. 

Renaming herself Rose, she’s now a potential pupil of the greatest light mage in the land. But with her affinity with dark magic, can she thrive rather than just survive in this new world?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EC%A3%BC%EB%AC%B8%EC%9D%84-%EB%A7%90%ED%95%B4-%EB%A1%9C%EC%A6%88/2749), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/58851301)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://tapas.io/series/say-the-spell-rose/info), [Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/112386), [S.Chinese](https://pdt.tencentac.com/?adtag=appshare.ios.detail%26QQ%26273&contentId=273), [T.Chinese](https://tw.kakaowebtoon.com/content/%E9%AD%94%E6%B3%95%E5%B0%91%E5%A5%B3%E8%98%BF%E7%B5%B2/761)

Being with you is a risk I'm willing to take. 

On New Year's Eve, Do-A, the daughter of an aristocrat, spends a romantic night with the nobleman who saved her life. However, he disappears the next day, and Do-A fears she'll never see him again... That is until she sees him working in a butcher shop! Is the man Do-A fell for not who she thought he was? 

(Source: Manta, edited)

In a world where heroes and villains live among humans, ACE hero agency and the Olymforce villains are in a constant power struggle. ACE hero Evan (codename Roid), blessed with super strength, is an impenetrable wall of force and power. The only thing that can make him crumble? His roommate Nolan, who he’s been crushing on for over three years. However, everything comes crashing down when Evan nearly catches the elusive teleporting villain Hermes…only to discover that he’s been Nolan all along! Stuck between his unwavering sense of duty and his unrequited love, Evan has a choice to make: turn Nolan in to keep the city safe, or help keep the villain’s identity hidden for a chance at love. With great power comes great responsibility – whether you want it or not! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.*

I died a lonely virgin after being used by women all my life. But guess what? The God of Losers, the protector of virgins like myself, gave me another shot! Will I make it through this survival game where the only way to live is by hooking up with female friends?

(Source: DAYcomics)

I just wanted to fall in love!

About to be trapped in a loveless marriage, Esmeralda is determined to find a husband of her own choosing. When the handsome Lord Alfonse woos her at her first society event, she decides to take a gamble and asks him to court her. But why didn't anyone tell her he's the emperor's hound?! 

(Source: Manta)

To support the family after her father's untimely death, Milvia sacrifices her life force to make gold using the forbidden practice of alchemy. But after being accused of trying to kill her stepsister, Relliana, she is sentenced to death. Just before taking her last breath, Milvia realizes she's been betrayed by her own family and is mysteriously given a second chance at life. Now, with the help of a knight named Deus, she's determined to get revenge, but things are not as simple as they seem...

(Source: Tapas)

*Note: Chapter count includes epilogue.*

When Eun-Ho heard that the fabric softener given to him by his ex-girlfriend was discontinued, he left a complaint at the company’s customer center while drinking. Soo-In reads the complaint and is shocked and delivers all the remaining fabric softener samples. Somehow they became close and fell in love. But for Soo-In, Eun-Ho’s ex-girlfriend was too strong of a force. There was nothing she could do for him other than hug him tightly when he was sad. So now it has to be revealed. She is the one who deleted his memories. 

(Source: Manta, edited)

For those fighting discrimination. 

Why does systemic discrimination go unnoticed? Who are the people who stand to benefit from hatred? What if remaining neutral ultimately means you're siding with the oppressors? Follow this story about discrimination, equality, and the fight for justice through the eyes of four different characters! 

(Source: Manta)

Archduke Gabriel de Luzia is cursed. Since his seventh bride died in a tragic accident, he's become an outcast and has stayed holed up in his castle. His only companions there are his loyal servants, until the day a young woman comes wandering right through the castle's protective magical barrier! Having traveled all the way from her village, Marianne has a favor to ask of Gabriel, but nothing comes for free in this world, and what the archduke asks of her in return could put her life at stake! 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: My Boss Can't Sleep Without Me
description:
Chae Eun-Soo just wants a stable life with no drama. After a wild night out leads her to sleep with a man she’s just met, she's relieved to find that he only slept next to her… and nothing more. When she runs into him again, he reveals his desperate need for some shut-eye, which only Eun-Soo could induce. He asks if they could sleep together again, and while he seems polite, she soon learns he’s not just a random stranger, but Seo Do-Jin, a boss from her company! So much for a drama-free life!

(Source: Tapas)

After being rejected by her unrequited love, the usually carefree Narae decides she needs to redeem her self-esteem. A normal girl by day, at night Narae now transforms into "BJ Nari," the cosplaying livestreamer! It doesn’t matter that she got rejected, she’ll show her adoring fans how sexy she is! Things start heating up when a mysterious user named “Aooya” proposes something naughty to Narae on her livestream. Hesitant at first, she’s a true exhibitionist at heart and gives her fans what they want. As she gets deeper and deeper into the world of live streaming, will Narae be able to resist the temptations that await her?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Mable Ra Robin, once a duchess to house Quintrell, disappeared without a trace. 5 years later, she shows up at her family's house in the middle of the night. But her name was no longer Duchess Quintrell, she's now Lady Robin because she left her husband. But there's one more surprise, she brought a boy with her. The name is Patrick, and he's the child of a heartless duke and her ex-husband, Percival De Quintrell. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

In high school, Cheol-Ho's obsessive behavior towards Jin-Tae led to a fateful comment: ""I'll consider it if you ever turn into a girl."" Years later, as adults, their paths cross again under shocking circumstances. Jin-Tae wakes up one day to find his body has inexplicably transformed. As they navigate this new and twisted dynamic, Jin-Tae must confront his transformed identity and the dangerous desires Cheol-Ho harbors. Will Jin-Tae find a way to reclaim control over his life, or will he be ensnared by Cheol-Ho's possessive grip?"

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

Princess Renia Alesdubois had finally found happiness with her husband Clovis Jenoff, the Grand Duke. But when the empire finds her guilty of her husband's murder amidst political chaos, a dying wish to set everything right sends her back before it all began. Armed with memories of the past, Renia decides to call off her engagement in order to save her beloved. As she goes to extreme lengths to keep the past from repeating, she finds that some things are not at all what she expected. 

(Source: Tapas)

Cheong-Yeon Ham thought he finally got the opportunity of a lifetime! The rich heiress of a powerful conglomerate offered all the luxuries money could buy in exchange for participating in a flashy sham marriage. But Cheong-Yeon soon realized that it was all a trap! His brother-in-law, Do-Eum Yoon, masterminded the whole affair as an elaborate scheme to enact his revenge decades in the making. And his method of doing so? SEX! Nasty sex! But is there more than meets the eye? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Chan-Woo owns a coffee shop in Seoul. His little brother Jung-Min is living with him while he looks for jobs. These two brothers share something in common. They both have the hots for one Da-Yeon Sung. She’s a childhood friend of theirs and now lives in Seoul as a model. Jung-Min’s the one who got there first however, and is now dating Da-Yeon. Looks like Chan-Woo has to just wonder what could have been… But Jung-Min’s cheating ways end up bringing Da-Yeon into Chan-Woo’s arms. And when Jung-Min discovers the two together, things look like they’re about to get ugly. But…is this really happening? Is seeing his brother sleep with his girlfriend really turning him on?! Still, Jung-Min can’t let his brother get away with this. Like the bitter taste of caffeine, these sexy thrills can be dangerous but addicting...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

display_title: I Don't Want to Be a Hero!
description:
PAVILLO grew up in the underground, where it is full of monsters. He came to the ground above, looking for peace. However, that dream was short-lived, as monsters started attacking him even here, and soon, people started calling him a hero... 

(Source: DAYcomics)

Ji-Han has spent a lifetime adhering to the rules in a bid to win the approval of his parents and peers. But he never receives true affection until he meets a boy by the name of Joon-Hyuk injured on the street. Against all expectations otherwise, Ji-Han takes Joon-Hyuk in as his roommate. But little does Ji-Han know that this chance encounter will change his entire life...

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.*

After their mother’s tragic passing, sisters Yeonmi and Hwiyeon want nothing more than a happy life away from their awful step-father. But it turns out that living alone and earning money is harder than it looks! Thank goodness for their mother’s adoptive brother, who swoops in to save them from certain-failure. He sets them up with both a place to live and a food truck license, and finally their dreams of happiness and independence seem to be in their grasp. But it turns out that their uncle might not be the sweet and unassuming savior that he seemed, and he’s certainly not the only one with dirty laundry… Just what will these two get up to in their quest for happiness?

(Source: Lezhin X)

As the biggest nerd on campus, Leslie Glass’s chances of randomly hooking up with a cute hottie are dwindling daily. Desperate for love, she turns to online dating. She finds a guy who’s exactly her type, but “FWB?” “BDSM?” Those words in his bio mean nothing to her. Little does she know that her online pretty boy is none other than Jack Offerman, the talk of the campus. Plus, she doesn’t know that he…really likes getting pegged. Will Jack be the perfect person to guide Leslie through the confusing, but oddly alluring, world of BDSM?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eunkyung's homelife is... boring, to say the least. With no job, no kids and a distant husband, she's beginning to feel depressed. Things start looking up when her hunky young nephew moves in, but having all that extra testosterone in the house proves stressful! To relieve her tension, Eunkyung decides to take up yoga - only to find out her nephew is the instructor! She's got a lot to learn, and he's a very thorough instructor. Who knew yoga was so hands-on?! 

(Source: Lezhin X)

Yeonji, the tenacious breadwinner of her family, had a bite-filled one-night stand with Joonwon. He reappears six years later, this time as the infamous Vice President of her company. Struggling as a temp, she clumsily tries to avoid his attention until Joonwon plops her into his personal office. Strangely enough, he won't let her forget any detail from that night. Will he drag her into the twisted politics of his life?

*"This time, help me, Miss Nam" … "I don't know if one night will be enough."*

Does he want her body or something more? And how will her past come to haunt her? In this ever-twisting romance, Yeonji might experience enticing excitement or bittersweet heartbreak.

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Saint Reborn as the Villain
description:
For ten years, Beatrice lived as a saint to protect the empire and earn her family's love. But when Lina steals her position, Beatrice is accused of witchcraft and sentenced to death. In her second life, she vows to get revenge. Thus begins Beatrice's transformation!

(Source: Manta)

Lee Youngsoo has been single her whole life and doesn't believe in love. One day, a dating app pops up on her phone, saying that she has a 98% success rate with a guy. She decides to try it out, but sadly ends up losing the guy to someone else. Furious, she goes to the app's office, where she runs into an old man. As night falls, he turns into the moon god Wolyoung Seon and says that they are destined to be together. Everyone is fated to be with someone, but who knew her someone would be a god?

(Source: Tapas)

Yeon-Ho Kang is a veterinary student with a strange ability: communicating with animals. Ironically kicked out of his residency program because of this, Yeon-Ho is imposed to figure out how to get back on track, until he is offered a chance to work as a school nurse.There, he meets a strange and mysterious girl named Yeoul, a "feral child," unlike anyone he has ever seen before. A girl so different, yet in the most unexpected way, so similar.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Yoon Bom-bit loves one thing above all else – dating simulation games. Her most recent obsession? A feudal-era game called “The Lonely Hawk Sings in the Absinthe-Colored Cage” starring Anette De Valois. Bom-bit would do anything to give Anette the happy ending she deserves…but her plans are consistently ruined by Mariette: Anette’s twisted stepsister who leads Bom-bit to getting a bad ending over and over again. One day, Bom-bit starts her computer up, only to be transported into the world of the game – and inside Mariette’s body! With this newfound chance, will Bom-bit be able to help Anette finally get the happy ending of her dreams? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

After falling into Isaiah's temptation, Denis walked the path of faith and became a priest to redeem himself... However ten years later the devil is back at his throat. 

(Source: Lalatoon) 

 *Note: Includes six extra chapters.*

Ba-Da never dreamed of getting into a steamy relationship with a celebrity before. Well, until recently, that is. Now, after meeting famous actor Shim Chae-Yoon and getting an offer from the nation’s heartthrob to teach him how to be in a relationship, Ba-Da has been having some explicit dreams. Except…maybe they’re more than dreams. The line between dream and reality is fading faster by the day…

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes a prologue and two AU side story chapters.*

Arhin Avand is taking a big risk disguising herself as a man to be a knight — because if she's discovered, she'll be deemed a witch! But thankfully, the only person who sees through her disguise is Marquess Ludvig Vert, her new captain and the first man she ever kissed. Now, as they work together to carry out secret missions for the good of the empire, Arhin can't help but feel like he's giving her special treatment. Is the marquess's favoritism a good thing, or will it totally blow her cover?

(Source: Tapas)

One might think being engaged to Hadius Myer, the son of one of the most prestigious families in the kingdom, sounds like a fairy tale, but for Emilia Bern, a commoner, her reality is nothing but a nightmare. Tired of the constant criticism she receives from other nobles and her fiancé’s cold attitude, all Emilia wants now is to end this charade. But when Hadius turns 19, his attitude suddenly changes. The truth is, Hadius has always been in love with Emilia, but he has been keeping his distance from her because of his unstable position within his family. Unfortunately, Hadius has already lost Emilia’s trust and must prove his sincerity to gain it back. Will the two be able to overcome adversity and hardship and find a way to be together? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

With a perfect older brother, Yim Ju-Hyeong's inferiority complex has always driven him to be better than other people. Everything goes well until a new transfer student named Yim Se-On shows up. Despite being superior to Ju-Hyeong in every single way, Se-On, for some mysterious reason, seems intent on devoting himself to taking care of Ju-Hyeong. Even though Ju-Hyeong should hate it, he doesn't understand why he can't push Se-On away.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

After losing her professional golfing license due to a failed drug test, the innocent Im Soo-an is forced to find other work. However, the only person she can turn to is her first love - the very same man she coldly dumped in the past! Fortunately, he agrees to help her and manages to find her a job as a caddie, but it’s a far cry from being a professional golfer… To make matters worse, the men at the country club seem to think they can take advantage of her! She just has to deal with their advances until she clears her name, but how…?

(Source: Lezhin X)

After helping the Four Warriors put the evil dragon Aktale back to sleep, Cornelia thought she would be honored as a hero, but she was gravely mistaken. Though she helped lead the warriors to victory, no one recognized her efforts, since she was a commoner. Even the warriors themselves did not stand by her side. After regretting giving her all to help the empire, she leaves the capital to start anew, but just as she is settling into her new life, the evil dragon awakens again... 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: Time to Call Off This Engagement
description:
Soojin is suddenly transported into the 18-year-old body of Leah, the second female lead in her favorite web novel. As a villainess reincarnate, her mission is to avoid a terrible ending. Soojin's only option is to break off the engagement... However, Devan, her egotistical fiancee is not making this easy, not one bit.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Si-Hu’s life is a pretty good one. He’s starting a new job at a pretty decent company, he’s been happily married to a gorgeous wife for six years, and he’s pretty good-looking himself. But one day, everything starts cracking at the edges when he starts to suspect that his beautiful wife Si-A is having an affair. He can’t stop obsessing and worrying over it, but his pretty coworker Min-A might have the perfect solution: a steamy affair of his own. Si-Hu isn’t sure this is the right thing to do, but it’s hard to say no when his wife is more suspicious than ever and there so many gorgeous women at his office. So maybe a little infidelity can’t hurt…right? 

(Source: Lezhin X)

Kim Moojin's job was to support the supernatural beings known as "vagrants" on missions, cleaning up the messes they leave behind. Then one day, he is killed in a fight between vagrants, but to his surprise, he wakes up in the year 2002, the peak of his youth! Though excited to relive the good years, he finds out that, unfortunately, he's been cursed by a demon! Now, the only way for Moojin to cure himself is by working with the ones he hoped to avoid the most... the vagrants. 

(Source: Tapas)

After going to live at his childhood friend's house to attend college in the city, he sees her doing something naughty. "It's not fair if only you saw, I should see something of yours too". Soon their relationship gets a lot closer than expected... 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

display_title: Trapped in My Daughter's Fantasy Romance
description:
Park Soonja stumbles on a mountain and passes out, waking up as the heroine of her daughter's romance-fantasy novel, Belita Partel. She first enjoys her new life and youth, until it hits her that her daughter is left all alone in the real world. She then tries everything to go back but nothing works. It seems the only way to escape is to marry the male lead of the novel, the crown prince. 

As she strives to achieve the goal, she unintentionally charms the male characters one after another. Can she ever get out of this novel and reunite with her real daughter? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Do you believe in superstitions? Cause I do. Why? Because it's not only a superstition... It's reality. I'm jinxed.

(Source: Toomics)

An ordinary woman is reading her favorite novel on her way home when she gets into an accident. As she loses consciousness, she hears a voice say, “my name is Elsia Artize. Please save him for me!” When she awakens, she finds she’s become Elsia herself! Destined to die early, the new Elisa knows the only way to escape death is to save her crush, Prince Ixion, from assassination. Though she succeeds and is now ready to live her own life, the prince complicates things when he proposes marriage! 

(Source: Tapas) 

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Ever since that fateful rainy day when she was rescued by the handsome Duke Killian Devonshire, Rowena has lived as his mistress. Though she believes that Killian has grown to love her over the past three years, she wants to repay her debt to him and become his equal so that she can stand proudly by his side. But when Killian begins to behave strangely, her trust in him wavers, only for it to be fully broken the day he introduces another woman to be his future wife. Thus, Rowena decides to make some drastic changes to their relationship. But will it be for better or for worse?

(Source: Tappytoon)

display_title: Nightly Taming of the Werewolf Duke
description:
Siyoung Kim finally got into her dream school, the prestigious Soul National University. But while taking a little nap in the library... What the-! She finds herself in the world of the trashy smut "Conquering My Duke." Now as the heroine Eileen White, she has to marry the seemingly perfect Duke Caden for a year. But what's the catch? There has to be one, right?? Well, he definitely has a beast of a secret. Will she be able to get back home safely? Or will she have to tame this wild duke herself...? 

(Source: PocketComics)

Ma Dohee comes from a family of witches cursed to die a horrible death if they ever fall in love. Fortunately for Dohee, her ability read people's emotions through color has been enough for her... or so she thought until she met her CEO, Cha Taesung. Since the day she first saw him, she strangely can't stop her heart from racing. She tries to bury herself in work and avoid him at all costs, but he suddenly joins her team for a big project. Just what can she do to stop this magical attraction? 

(Source: Tapas)

Muzel Clave Laurent Morze is destined to die during the war caused by the heroine of the novel "Mesiria." In order to avoid her horrid fate and live a carefree life, she decides to change the future with a special ability that allows her to look at the memories of people and objects with a single touch. She soon gets involved in the dramatic events of the original story in an attempt to make things go in her favor... but will her touch be enough to ensure the happy ending she's always wanted? 

(Source: Tapas)

There is wonder to be found in books.

After returning home from a horrible first day at a new school, Julie is distraught to find that her mother's given away her favorite childhood book. Determined to get her comfort object back, she seeks out a used bookstore where she not only finds her book... but also a new world of possibilities!

(Source: Manta)

Fantasy romance over a cup of coffee.

Sam-Wol, a nine-tailed fox, unwittingly turns into a human after eating her thousandth liver in an attempt to become a mountain god. After descending the mountain, she meets Jong-Man, who employs her as a part-timer at his café. Can romance blossom between these two "humans"? 

(Souce: Manta, edited)

Jun Jung was a bystander who watched his classmates bully Soorim Sung, a student who transferred to Bukak High School at the start of his second year. Although Jun never participated in the bullying, he also never did anything to help stop it. Six months later, Jun’s class was picked for Abyss—an escape room on a ship. Jun and his classmates couldn't be more excited, but their excitement soon turns into fear when they realize the person behind Abyss is out for blood…

(Source: Tapas)

After Sunghyun’s parents decide to go to Europe for a few years without so much as a warning, he’s left alone with no house or money, forcing him to fend for himself. He’s reluctant about taking a job at a child-friendly café at first, but he soon realizes that it’s not only a place for kids to find playmates. After a while, he’s in luck when two of the hottest moms show interest in him. Yujin, a mother of two who still wants to be treated as an attractive woman, and Ahyun, a single mother who feels lonely raising a child on her own. Will this 21-year-old be able to find a way to juggle a relationship with the two cougars without being caught?

(Source: Lezhin X)

The good go to World One, the bad go to World Two, and the others await God's judgment in World Three. 19-year-old Yoon Cheol never questioned this system... until her sister, Jung, was taken to World Two for an unknown crime. Determined to uncover what that crime was, Cheol ventures to the boundary area between World Two and World Three, which is guarded by God's powerful subordinates. But with no special skills or knowledge of the world beyond her own, can Cheol hope to succeed?

(Source: Tapas)

Noah’s a small-time pickpocket. He’s a bit of a slacker who’s never really had a steady job but when he hears of an opportunity to steal a rare diamond, for the first time in his life, he gets ambitious. With his new crown jewel, he plans to start fresh and escape his mediocre life. But things don’t go according to plan when two guys, who have it out for each other, both get involved. Noah’s really mashed up between a rock and a hard place. How the hell is he going to get out of this one…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

A genius brain scientist is knocked unconscious after he finds his wife's dead body. One year later, he begins to search for clues in his own mind.

*"The memory of that criminal is in my head!"*

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Shin Min-Cheol is the hero of Angeles, a world where he used his powerful mana to defeat an evil king. His arms full of gold, he returns to modern-day Korea to live the dream of being rich and unemployed. However, his peaceful days are shattered when gang activity hits a little too close to home. Before he knows it, Min-Cheol's powers are recognized, and he gets swept up in international intrigue that brings him face-to-face with some heavy hitters. Is Min-Cheol really as invincible as he thought? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

An education center filled with bullies maintains a balance of power. The appearance of a legendary fighter, on a quest to get revenge for his younger brother, will shake this up!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: A Love Story of Heaven and Hell, Part 2
description:
Our favorite celestial couple is back for a steamier and more dramatic season! Sara, the Queen of Hell, is annoyed as ever with her puppy-dog husband, Marshall. It's only worse because the King of Heaven is all grown up now and wants to do (ahem) grown-up things, but Sara just doesn't have the time to entertain all his hormonal desires when she has a kingdom to run. All this sexual frustration causes a fight between the two that climaxes into a freak accident - Marshall splits into two people after getting mixed up with one of Sara's magic spells! But are these two kings the same person, or is one just a copy of the other? Whatever the truth is, Sara will have to manage double the trouble until she can turn Marshall back into one person again! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a world where whale monsters run rampant, humanity's only hope is Fishermen, who possess special abilities to fight them. Iri also dreams of becoming a great hero, but he just has a boring, ordinary life. That is until he runs into a monster one day and realizes he has a mysterious power called Bloodsurge. Now Iri must learn to control it and prove he can be a true Fisherman, despite doubters and enemies growing wilder. Will he succeed, or will the whale monsters prevail once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

Mo Dahye only tried out for a reality dating show to show the producer, Lee Wongu, that she was totally over her one-sided love for him. What she didn't count on was getting cast! Now, Dahye will spend a week with seven men who are trying to win her heart, all while Wongu watches. However, not everyone is who they claim to be, and some people didn't join the show for the right reasons. Will Dahye be able to find the right man for her, and will the viewers agree with her call? 

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Fabulous Lives of the Hillington Sisters
description:
Hildea Hillington, the daughter of duke Hillington, always knew that she was a mere supporting role in the story. She also knew that her destiny was to watch her younger sister, Roserielle, get married to young and ambitious duke Gabriel Velkius.
But something was definitely off. Why does Gabriel say that he loves me? He's supposed to be in love with my sister! 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Jung Daeman leads a double life. On the outside, he’s the adopted son of a rich and beautiful family, but behind closed doors he’s little more than their servant. Only one of his “sisters” is ever nice to him, and the rest of them work him like a dog! Things only start to change when the head of the house, Mr. Kim, comes back from a business trip, and makes it clear that he thinks of Daeman as his son and tells his wife and daughters to be nicer to Daeman. The thing is, while he might want them all to be closer, surely he didn’t mean this close?!

(Source: Lezhin X)

In a world where dying is no longer a tragedy, but a privilege, the rich design their own extravagant funerals resembling weddings. Ceremonies are held not for the deceased, but for those left behind. Han Hee-Jun has lived selfishly his whole life and realizes no one will remember him if he dies. Desperate to leave behind a perfect image, he takes on death planning. But when Kang Ido, a wealthy client with the same deep emptiness, requests a quiet, meaningful death, Hee-Jun's carefully planned world shifts.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

At Hertiar Academy, exclusive to the elite, Jeremy, the troubled heir of the Hertiar family, becomes dangerously fixated on Lucian. When Daniel arrives and discovers Lucian is the one he's admired for years, he ignores warnings and befriends him. Consumed by jealousy, Jeremy openly displays affection for Lucian in front of Daniel, trying to drive a wedge between them. One who can have everything except the one he wants. One who would like nothing more than to leave. And one who is determined to save his friend. Just who will come out on top of this struggle of love? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

At a young age, Lia was adopted into the rich and political Henricksen family, only to end up being treated more like a servant than a daughter. In order to break free of her restraining household, she uses a stalking incident as an excuse to move out. But upon revisiting her parents’ home, she finds them murdered with a mysterious man named Ivan Yelka waiting for her. After a failed suicide attempt to escape her tragic life once more, Lia wakes up in an underground bunker handcuffed to a bed. Ivan assures her that she’s safe and that he’s actually a CIA agent who had connections to her father. But can his words truly be trusted? Or does he have an ulterior motive for keeping Lia completely confined in his grasp? 

(Source: Tappytoon)

He can never get it up with the same woman after doing it once, but she was different, which is the reason they got married. However, his condition returned, and now he is on a hunt for new women...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

This story is about Baekseon, a Sangun/god that rules over the mountain, and a mountain girl named Jaechun who has magical powers. On their journey, Jaechun serves Baekseon as her master, but secretly covets Baekseon’s skin at the same time. Although they don’t fully trust each other, they are both after a special leopard, a mystical creature that seems to take away people’s lives…

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

Celebrating failure. 

Feeling like a failure after giving up her lifelong dream, Kkang-Jang travels to Iceland, a country where failure is embraced — and also one of the most expensive places in the world. Can she make her journey work on a shoestring budget? Follow along as she travels with the help of a guardian spirit! 

(Source: Manta)

One little toy started it all. One tiny little toy. Office romance, secrets, and a bunch of... Come join in on the office fun.

(Source: Toomics)

Won-Hyuk’s life is simple: study hard, stay out of trouble, and prepare to study abroad. But everything changes when his alpha stepbrother Han-Seo suddenly reappears. Won-Hyuk wants nothing to do with him, but how does he face someone when his body remembers what his heart wants to forget? 

(Source: Manta)

*Note: Includes a prologue.*

The tyrant who ruined my life is suddenly kind?!

Bland and unexciting Yui Shinohara had lived a mediocre life until one day, she suddenly died and reincarnated into a heroine in a romance novel. Although she got to live her second life as Marilyn, a beautiful girl born into a noble family, her life gets ruined by a tyrant and a villainess. Just before dying a wrongful death, Marilyn is saved by the guardian deity of the Imperial family, Goddess Antia. She claims the world will end if Marilyn does not go back in time to stop the tyrant. Not only that, Marilyn now has to face her destiny to love the cruel tyrant Rael because of this stupid ring she owned...!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Gildong is a country boy that needs some fresh inspiration. He has aspirations of becoming a famous comic artist but he wants to draw women and the only ones he knows are his mom and grandma. He has a solution in mind, however. Move to Seoul, the land of opportunity, where voluptuous and scantily clad “inspiration” abounds! No more old ladies and nights alone. A new life awaits the bright-eyed and bushy-tailed pushover from the boonies when he starts fresh in the big city!

(Source: Lezhin X)

Lee Chan-Hyuk desperately needs money. Not only does he have to pay his mother's hospital fees, but he's also been roped into paying off his friend's debt. But when a man appears and offers him 300 billion won if he breaks a high school bully's finger, he takes a chance and is shocked to see his bank account overflowing with cash. As it turns out though, as easy as it is for the money to come in, it can disappear just as fast! To what lengths will Chan-Hyuk go to keep his newly-minted fortune?

(Source: Tapas)

Director Na Eun-Seo just needs the third season of her reality dating show Housemate to do well. Then she can finally direct the program of her dreams! However, when the icy former child star Ha Se-Won is added last-minute to the cast, he causes incident after incident and threatens to ruin her plans. At least Eun-Seo has her sweet, shy friend An Jae-Hui in the cast to help her out. But why are no sparks flying this season? And why do the two male contestants only seem to be looking at Eun-Seo? 

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Seojin grew up to not excel at anything, except distinguish a pair of twins. The twins, Uimin and Uisin, like Seojin very much; perhaps, a bit too much. A deep love that is erotic and dark, where a soft-spoken man gets trapped between unhinged twins

(Source: INKR)

display_title: She is A Web Novel Writer
description:
As an outsider, he always sits in the corner of his club room reading web novels. Suddenly, he's asked to draw the cover of a web novel written by the prettiest girl in the area! Their struggle to become the best web novel duo!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Junwon’s sure he’s straight. Yes, all of his girlfriends dumped him for one reason or another, but that doesn’t mean that his relationships will work out if he dates guys. However, a certain someone’s been on his mind. His school sunbae, Jaehyun. Jaehyun’s good-looking, friendly, makes Junwon’s heart pound…and straight. Not only is he straight, but he also used to date Junwon’s sister, Jiyeon. That doesn’t stop Junwon, though. He wants to look at his feelings and find out what he really wants. Everything starts with one question: Aren’t you curious what it would be like to kiss a guy? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

The city is engulfed by a zombie virus. But what if you are with a bigger and stronger BYUL? The story of BA-DA and BYUL coming back home, where their sister is waiting.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Kang Hasun has the ability to see vagrants, special beings that disguise themselves as humans. They have never caused him any trouble, until one day he is attacked by a vicious group of them. Just as he is on the verge of death, Beom, a tiger vagrant, pops out of his necklace and saves him. With Beom's help, Hasun learns that his family has a deep connection with the vagrants and a secret power that they desire. Can he learn how to control these powers and defeat these villains in time? 

(Source: Tapas)

Jeon Woo-Chi was the greatest taoist 500 years ago, and now he's ready to take over the era of social media! All he dreams of is a peaceful life as a successful online streamer. However, Kang Jin-Hee, the granddaughter of a man Woo-Chi saved in the past, comes to him with a mysterious scroll and zombie-like monsters in hot pursuit. As he tries to find the source of these monsters, he's invited to Exceed, a competition for top streamers, only to find there might be a link between the two...

(Source: Tapas)

display_title: The Reason She Is Avoiding Her Childhood Friend
description:
After being reborn as a baby in a new world, Arendine Ade is determined to make this life better than her last! Once a miserable and underpaid college drop-out, now she is the daughter of a baronet. With an early start to her education, she makes it her goal in this life to become a government employee – everyone knows they get the best benefits, after all. Unfortunately, her diligent studies are interrupted by the appearance of Kiershka Reinfont, the son of the grand duke. Despite his angelic face, he’s a rotten bully with the manners of a devil, and worst of all, he’s taken an interest in Arendine. With her new life at stake, Arendine will do whatever it takes to make sure this new “friend” doesn’t mess things up!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yoon Minho may seem like your average, slightly clumsy kindergarten teacher, but she harbors a remarkable secret: the ability to travel through time. When the National Museum commissions her for another thrilling time-travel mission, she finds herself unexpectedly crossing paths with the enigmatic and aloof Park Ewan. Ewan seeks her help in locating a priceless historical artifact, and despite their less-than-ideal first encounter, they embark on a captivating journey that blurs the lines between history and romance. Join them on this exhilarating rollercoaster ride through time and love! 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Life was going perfect... I started dating my first love as well as my high school teacher. But then Turner came along and turned my life upside down!

(Source: Toomics)

Ji-Un is infatuated with the enigmatic Se-Jin, confessing his love daily despite constant rejection. Se-Jin, on the other hand, believes Ji-Un could never truly like him for who he is. However, when Ji-Un vows to stay by Se-Jin’s side no matter what, the two decide to officially go steady. As their romance blossoms, Ji-Un is elated…but he soon discovers Se-Jin's hidden, sadistic tendencies. And things only get more complicated, as it comes to light that Ji-Un's best friend In-Hyuk has been harboring feelings for him all this time! Will Ji-Un be able to accept Se-Jin for who he is and learn to love his lusty lover? Or will Se-Jin’s lechery leave him longing for his bestie's embrace?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Wuyeon is just another young man struggling to make ends meet. Never did he imagine that he'd catch the attention of two wealthy brothers: Jae-ha, who wants to help Wuyeon live in luxury as his personal toy, and Jinwoo, who wants to help Wuyeon escape from his situation. Will either of these men save Wuyeon? More importantly...will Wuyeon need to be saved from them? 

(Source: Lezhin US) 

*Note: Chapter count includes a New Years Special and an epilogue.*

Let me hold your hand once more. 

Jiwoo can see the future of those she holds hands with. Yet when she holds Haesung's hand, she can see her own! Hoping to know her fate in the upcoming art contest, Jiwoo tries to hold Haesung's hand again, but he refuses. What trauma lies in his past? Can the two pull each other back to the present? 

(Source: Manta)

display_title: I Don't Want to be Loved
description:
After losing her child and catching her husband in a compromising position with her half-sister Leticia, Leannan takes her own life rather than continue living miserably. But instead of dying, she wakes up the day before Leticia comes to live with her family. Determined to prevent a repeat of her past, she comes up with a plan to get rid of all the obstacles... starting with her cunning sister and her cold husband. Will Leannan succeed and live happily, or will she drown in misery once more?

(Source: Tapas)

I came to kill myself after I lost my life savings investing in cryptocurrency... Goodbye world... Wait, who's that girl?

(Source: Toomics)

Born with a scar seen as undesirable, Erica Corr thought she might never get married. That is, until she is betrothed to the ruthless emperor Carl Lakin as a noble consort. With several of his previous consorts having turned up dead, it is predicted that the sweet, gentle Erica won’t last very long. However, she discovers that beneath Carl’s twisted exterior lies a surprisingly soft side and some scars of his own. But is Erica strong enough to heal this tyrant? Or will she be his latest victim? 

(Source: Tapas)

Jongwan falls for a girl who wants to use his talent, and for her, he starts serving as an outlet for different women's urges.

(Source: Toomics)

Lee Chul-Joong, a team leader in the Jae-Young faction, isn’t thrilled about the arrival of a new director from the entertainment industry. What could someone like that possibly know about "real" business? But when Chul-Joong meets the director for the first time—while secretly carrying drugs in his person—things take an unexpected turn. In a twist of fate, he strikes the deal of a lifetime with Director Choi Ha-Gyeong, the perfect deal that could either destroy him or completely turn his world upside down.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Chapter count includes prologue.*

Yujin is a “normal” teenager who’s preparing to retake his college entrance exams. He is not into boys. Nope. At least that’s what he tells himself when his classmate, Jun-hyeok, starts hitting on him. But as time goes on, Yujin can’t deny his increasing attraction to Jun-hyeok and reluctantly admits that he’s probably as straight as a circle. But even if Yujin accepts his sexuality, will his and Jun-hyeok’s love prevail successful against all odds, or will it succumb to societal pressure?
BR> (Source: Lezhin US)

It's my first year of college, but the pandemic forced my first class to be online... The thing is... that class would be life-changing.

(Source: Toomics)

The start of a love triangle between a male professor with a special kink, his wife who's smoking hot, but surprisingly modest in bed, and his student who's been living in his spare room... How will this messy relationship end?

(Source: Toomics)

True love conquers all. Or at least, that is what Tessa would like to believe. Growing up stuck in an orphanage with her lover, Hert, she would do anything to give the two of them a better life. So when she is presented with a contract that would place them in servitude of the Marquis de Juttert - she as a maid, and he as a squire - she jumps at the chance. But reality hits when the true nature of the contract is revealed: Tessa is now doomed to become the Marquis’s sixth wife, and Hert a gladiator faced with certain death. But years later, when the Marquis is overthrown by a vengeful Hert, the knight has only one question for the sorrowful Tessa: “Why did you betray me?”

The main character starts doing jobs for his uncle who is the head of an entertainment company. He discovers a passed out woman and just as he's about to help her, more girls start coming out of a portal. And then... his uncle decides to make them idols!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

Teaching at a swimming pool frequented by ultra sexy women ought to be the ultimate dream job, but for glorified litter-picker Yoo Myungjin, it isn’t quite what he’d expected. Everything begins to change, however, when he gets his first taste of hands-on teaching with the oh-so-stunning Yura, and not long after that he’s approached with a deal that’s too tantalizing to refuse. Is this finally his chance to get a taste of real teaching, and all the perks that come with it? A game of love and lust is officially underway, but just what will go on beneath the waves?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Terry might be jobless, but he has the perfect married life. But it looks like there's more than meets the eye when he starts working at the same company as his wife...

(Source: Toomics)

Can a pair of survivors last in a earth plagued by bitter cold, zombies, and other survivors who will cross any line?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Dong-Hyuk has one go-to hobby: lusting after the beautiful actress Hwa Riae. Others might call it a mid-life crisis since he’s almost 50 now, but who cares? He still thinks she’s the hottest person to ever walk the face of the earth. But he sure wasn’t expecting to meet her in real life… and definitely not as his son’s girlfriend, or just maybe, his future daughter-in-law? Dong-Hyuk tries hard to deny his feelings, but Riae’s even sexier in person. And going by how she looks at him, looks like those sparks aren’t one-sided, either…

(Source: Lezhin X)

Hyeseo and Seoha were only supposed to be tutor and tutee. But why are they becoming something more...?

(Source: Toomics)

Yong-Joo is a surgeon and a damn good one at that. And although she's made it to the top of her field, she has another dream: to become a mom. But in a world without men and a rigorous selection process for those who apply to be mothers, Yong-Joo has a better chance at being struck by lightning than accomplishing that dream. But what if she were to take less savory means...?

(Source: Tapas)

The Southern Line Express carries all sorts of passengers. Sovian Darnell is just the newest to join the train's economy class after he's tasked with smuggling an invaluable bead across the tundra. But nothing could have prepared him for the dark reality he's met with after he accepts a seemingly innocuous drink from another rider. Suddenly, Sovian is overcome with an insatiable lust that must be quenched, and everyone on the express wants a piece of him. With no place to hide on an unstoppable train, he'll have to service his fellow libidinous travelers until he can make it to his destination. But will his stop ever come? Sovian is in for one hell of a ride, but once you hop on this train, there's no getting off.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Elijah just opened up a pet store where he also offers training. But will training dogs be the only thing on his agenda?

(Source: Toomics)

Porn had stopped turning Hyuk on like it used to. Everything was so repetitive, boring, and uninspired…because nothing compared to Park Ara. After catching her masturbating in the staircase of their college prep academy, Hyuk made it his mission to get close to her, despite the fact that his girlfriend, Minjung, is the hottest, most popular girl their academy. But she will hardly ever have sex with Hyuk, giving him one more reason to be drawn to Ara. However, there’s something else even more enticing about her; she listens to his every command, like his very own obedient little pet. Sit, stay, get on all fours…Hyuk teaches Ara how exciting sex can be, doggy style!

(Source: Lezhin X)

Hwang-soo’s gambling problem cost him everything, including his house and his farm. With the family on the verge of becoming homeless, Hwang-soo’s wife Mijah and daughter Danbi ask Dooshik, a wealthy man, for his help. But it turns out that the man they thought was a philanthropist, was actually someone quite villainous. After forcing her to sign a contract, Mijah finds out Dooshik was the one who had coerced the family into losing everything. Can Mijah and Danbi get their house back? Why did Dooshik target Hwang-soo in the first place? And will everyone's greed for money and lust for sex eventually catch up to them...?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Ian Lane wakes to find himself in an eerie house with no memory and only ominous strangers for company. He soon discovers that he's a member of a team of afterlife enforcers and that he was recently tricked into giving away an important key, setting off a chain of events that disturbs the entire balance of the beyond. It's up to the executors to set things right again, but between formidable new foes and demons from Ian's dark past, this job gives new meaning to the phrase "life or death."

(Source: Tapas)

Hyeongwu is a long-time idol trainee who just had his dreams and debut dashed to pieces, thanks to a betrayal from a former group member. With nobody to fill the empty spot in their group, Hyeongwu is on the verge of losing his opportunity to become an idol—until he stumbles across a strange, handsome man called Yun, who just might be their group’s ticket to stardom. Yun has the charisma and looks of a man fit to rule a kingdom…which, speaking of. You’ll never guess where this Prince Charming is actually from.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After the military I entered the university and now I'm living at my brother's flat. One day my old school friend Jeong Se-Ah came to my place during the rain. She is so sexy and beautiful, that my body cannot resist.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Losing the item means losing the love! A man finds out that his girlfriend has been cheating on him. In shock, he enters a mysterious pawn shop in the alley...

 *"Are you sure you want to forget everything?"* 

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Her delicate appearance and bright personality captivate the hearts of many men. At the age of twenty, she is at the peak of her beauty and is everyone's first love. However, a dark shadow begins to fall on what seemed like a bright future.

(Source: Toomics)

Don't open Pandora's box.

Estranged daughter Som discovers a mysterious box in her mother's closet after she falls ill and is hospitalized. Upon accidentally opening the box, Som meets a strange woman who introduces herself as a grim reaper. Just who is this mysterious woman and what is her connection to Som's mother?

(Source: Manta)

*"You and she won't work".*

Since the night they faced destiny, something seems off about their friendship. Friends who've been close since childhood for over 10 years, Hae-Young, who has developed feelings for Ye-Ji, asks for help from his friend, I-Su, who is known for his power of foresighting. I-Su discovers that the one who loves Han Ye-Ji will inevitably get hurt. Despite I-Su's warning to stay away from Ye-Ji, Hae-Young still chooses her, and I-Su is determined to keep them apart by any means necessary...

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Way We See Each Other
description:
Desperate to escape his painful past, 24-year-old Hyun-Oh has cut ties with everyone he once knew. But when he unexpectedly runs into Cha-Mi, his former high school friend, Hyun-Oh's world is turned upside down. He does everything in his power to push Cha-Ni away, only for Cha-Ni to insist on sticking around. With no other options, Hyun-Oh fakes a confession of love, hoping it will drive Cha-Ni away for good—only for Cha-Ni to admit he feels the same. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

Welcome to back to TruthTalk TV, a channel dedicated to solving relationship problems from around the country! Our latest submission comes from a Joo Do-Hee, young woman torn between her ex and her childhood best friend. She writes: “Dear TruthTalk TV, my ex and I ended our four-year relationship because he couldn’t keep up with me in the bedroom. So, I drunkenly slept with my best friend one night, and it was everything I ever could have hoped for! The only problem? He’s always had feelings for me, and I think that our night together only made him fall even more in love. And now my ex is crawling back, asking for one more chance to do me…I mean, our relationship…right! What should I do?!” What do you think, dear subscribers? Should Do-Hee give her ex another chance to get in her pants? Or is her new fling the real thing? Keep tuning in to find out!

(Source: Lezhin US)

display_title: The Tale of The Hyungsan Sect
description:
Abandoned by his family, Gunak is sold to the Hyungsan Sect for 20 gold coins. The Hyungsan Sect treats him as their own with affection and Gunak grows attached to them quickly. However, he leaves the sect for ten years, and when he returns...

(Source: Toomics)

Saving the world with handsomeness.

In a world where love for one another has become a rarity... seven men will do whatever it takes to save what's left of humanity; using their... HANDSOMENESS. Watch Jehui and his misfit group of boys use their god given talent to conquer the world of webtoons in their quest to become 2D idols.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Grim Reaper is My Guardian
description:
Okji Mun can’t escape bad luck. From tripping in class to near-miss accidents, her life has always been one streak of misfortune after another. What she doesn’t realize is that her best friend, Ha-Seong Ji, is actually a Grim Reaper assigned to keep her safe. When the truth comes out, Okji learns her fate has changed and she has only 30 days left to live. A strange method might let her alter destiny, but it comes at the expense of others. As high school drama collides with a mysterious threat, Okji must decide what to do before time runs out.

(Source: WEBTOON)

*Note: Includes one extra chapter.*

display_title: I Didn't Mean to Send That, Sir!
description:
A scandalous text meant for an ex-boyfriend mistakenly lands Seo-Hae in hot water with her handsome, cold boss. His ultimatum — a contract marriage for his dying grandmother. Caught between office friction and unexpected family warmth, she navigates a bewildering path toward an unforeseen love.

(Source: Manta)

display_title: The Tale of Goldiluck, the Black Kitten: Side Story

description:
In a world where the Han Empire never fell, martial arts is a power used to squeeze people dry. So when a new continent is discovered, both good and evil men alike flee to settle there and escape the tyranny of the Emperor, opening up the era of a Martial Wild West.

In the turbulent frontier, Zhang Qian is a man that reincarnated from our cushy, modern world, but his new world is nothing like the fantastical world he dreamed about from reading martial arts novels. While the martial arts in his new world are powerful, they are also too crude and lack elegance. And so Qian journeys along the continent for his dream of bringing true martial arts back to the new realm.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A close and dangerous cohabitation with the cult leader's son has begun!

Chung-A was swindled by her uncle who she trusted and her parents disappeared, saying they are chasing their missing uncle, and Chung-A suddenly begins living on her own. But it wasn't just Chung-A's family that was scammed! The biggest cult in the autonomous district, "Millennium Adventist," was also deceived by her uncle. And Yo-Han, the son of the cult leader, came to Chung-A's house. He's dragging his luggage in...! God, is this cohabitation gonna be okay?

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Includes three extra chapters.*

Soo-jeong is always getting on the self-absorbed Eunchan's nerves since he first appeared before him out of the blue. 

Soo-jeong feels the same way towards the socially inept Eun-chan, who is often harsh towards him. Their ironic relationship develops as they try to survive together, even though they don't trust one another. 

What should you trust? Your past experiences and memories, or intuition? 

*Note: The chapter count includes five side story chapters.*

display_title: I Am the Wicked Woman Desired by His Tyrant Majesty
description:
*“You, too, will be corrupted. Then I will make it all come true.”* 

If I had only joined hands with him and agreed to become his mistress then, could I have lived a little longer? At least I would not have know the pain of my eyes being gouged out. But instead I shouted: “I refuse. I will not betray my country”, not realizing that my country, my family, had betrayed me long ago.

Sacrificed, used, abandoned, and finally executed by my own family... I only realized after returning to 10 years in the past that the reason why you wanted me to stand by your side is because you and I were so much alike. Let us fall together this time.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Won first place in the Tateyomi Manga Awards 2025 domestic category.*

L.A.G, an unknown space where humans use abilities or skills through awakening, monsters appear on each floor and room, and missions are given accordingly. 

The goal here is to reach the bottom. The protagonist repeats death and life countless times in the unknown space L.A.G. However, in this life, he has the ability to own unlimited passive skills and finally has a chance to escape there. 

However, unlike what he has been through so far, he will not know an inch of the future as L.A.G continues to change. This is a desperate survival story in which no one can be trusted and continues to survive the hellish L.A.G, where there is no end in sight, and fights for escape from the bottom.

display_title: Why Don't I Have Anyone By My Side?
description:
*"I don't think anyone will want to be friends with me..."* is the thought that has always run through Nayul's head. 

One day, she's unexpectedly reunited with Seoyoon, a boy from her past, when he transfers to her class. Nayul and Seoyoon used to be best friends when they were younger, but after several misunderstandings and unknown reasons, he began to avoid her, still treating her coldly upon their reunion. 

Will Nayul's foggy world ever brighten one day?

There are people in the world that thinks they are the ‘chosen’ of the heavens. It’s been decades since chaos and strife among heroes ensued because of those people. A certain disciple who has six masters has been entrusted with the fate of the central plains. 

*“If you guys are the heavens, then I’m the sword that’ll pierce the heavens.”* 

That was what he’d resolved to do… No one mentioned he was a fatty, though! In any case, now that he’s here, he’ll need to save the… world… Damn it, lose some weight first.

The story of 2 high school students and their growth as they have a hard time around immature adults. 

Yoon Jungwon, the model student and class president, seems to be hiding a secret, and Kwak Gilsung, a rising Taekwondo player stuck in his rebellious phase. Why are these two drawn toward each other? 

The tearful growth of two people exploring their youth! 

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

display_title: A Modern Man Who Got Transmigrated Into the Murim World
description:
I was a public official who worked part-time to survive. I was knocked out by a speeding car while making deliveries in the middle of the night. I have a strong memory of dying prematurely in a hit-and-run. 

*“…I’m Jo Hwi?”* 

At some point, I became the second son of the collapsing Jo Ga-Cheol Clan. This family has neither the authority to drop a flying bird nor the power to carry out one’s will. There is only an enormous amount of debt that can annihilate the entire family. There’s only one way out! 

*“Father, please pass the Jo Ga-Cheol Clan on to me.”* 

The story of a successful modern man who has to utilize all the knowledge and experience of a public official begins now. 

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

To avenge his older brother, an orphan named Jongli Chu killed Hwang Jung, a Heaven-slaying sect disciple. Following the death of Hwang-Jung, he joined the Imitating Blade killer of Soul-killing Chambers to avoid the pursuit of the Heaven-slaying Sect. However, a huge mess called ten chastisements was waiting for him. 

To escape the shadow of chastisement, he has no choice but to become a Legendary Death God! Can Jongli Chu become a Death God and find freedom in the stifling rules created by the Orthodox Sects? 

(Source: Naver, translated)

Scholar Woon Hyun enters the palace after passing the Imperial Examination. Though he soon comes to lament his poor and miserable life of having to deal with the Crown Prince's hobbies, despite that, he doesn't give up and tries his best to learn martial arts. But Woon Hyun suddenly picks up his brush to conquer the Murim?! The hidden story of the scholar who passed the Imperial Examination at a young age begins.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A senior disciple from a countryside martial academy returns as the world’s best! Dragged into a brutal political war, senior disciple ‘Hyeok Musang’ didn’t return after the bloody war ended. No one knew whether he was still alive for 5 years. 

Upon barely returning to his hometown, he found his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy being persecuted and destroyed by a third-rate gang. 

He thought he could live peacefully with his fellow members after winning the war but seeing the miserable state of his master and fellow disciples, he was filled with anger and guilt. 

With the return of the senior disciple, everyone thought things would get better but only for a moment. Things were still happening in his hometown of Yangzhou County. Was the war really over? The head disciple raises his sword against the dangers threatening his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy.

display_title: The Secret of My Next Classmate
description:
Yang Kiryong is an ordinary high school boy who has a classmate named Yoo Jae-Kyung, who is somewhat clumsy and clueless. Both have a very good friendship, but without any kind of love attraction. Until one day, by chance, Kiryong discovered the deepest secret of his friend and because of this his heart began to beat, will it be beats of fear or love?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Through a combination of numerous injuries, a weak frame, and financial difficulties, the protagonist Lee Jinyong gave up on his path to being a baseball athlete and lived as a factory employee instead. One day, the spirit of Kim Jinho, the baseball hero who was hailed as a legend in Korea, as well as Lee Jinyong’s idol who passed away 10 years ago, appeared before him. At the same time, an unknown notice appeared, stating that the ‘Baseball Manager’ would start, and Lee Jinyong gained an ability that gave him the constitution of a pitcher, similar to a game avatar. He returns to the field to become .

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

display_title: At That Time When We Were Like
description:
Choi Ah-ran, a novelist and publisher, runs a publishing company while hiding the humiliation of her past as Jo Ah-han, a writer who made a big name for herself 20 years ago with an internet novel about the most popular of Sanggo High falling for an ordinary high school student. Ah-ran goes to her parents' house, where she grew up, to announce the end of her engagement, but loses consciousness and is dragged into the realm of internet novels, 'Cheonyang.' Cheonyang is completely different from reality. Her now divorced parents affectionately wake up Ah-ran, and emoticons expressing their feelings appear in the speech balloon. The spelling is a mess! Such a cliché blabber! Ah-ran goes to school in an unguarded moment and realizes that this is an imaginary world where the laws of Internet fiction are constantly occurring. ‘This is a world I made up, so I can escape!’ While searching for a way to go back home, she goes to the city with her friend Soyoung, and meets the Four Heavenly Kings in the arcade. Ah-ran falls off the stairs and lands on Kang Hwiyoung, their leader. 'Oh, no! If I fall like that, there is a high probability that I will kiss Hwiyoung regardless of my falling position!'

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B7%B8%EB%95%8C-%EC%9A%B0%EB%A6%AC%EA%B0%80-%EC%A1%B0%EC%95%84%ED%95%9C/2690), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/60682678)

**Official Translations:**  
[S.Chinese](https://pdt.tencentac.com/?adtag=appshare.ios.detail%26QQ%26238&contentId=238&platform=IA), [Japanese](https://piccoma.com/web/product/131970)

A summer special short story that unfolds in the background of a hot summer. 

Contents:

1-5. **Isegye Harem Yongsa** (이세계 하렘 용사, This World's Harem Knight) \[ero404\]
