This is the story of Namgung De-So, the youngest son of the Namgung Clan. After losing his dantian in the competition for the position of vice-patriarch, he then faces an unexpected death out of nowhere and regresses into the past… 

The youngest son of the strongest clan? Such a title is way too bothersome. Let someone else become the strongest person or whatever! 

Can the former trash of the clan make the most out of his second chance at life?

Dan-Jo is a freshman in a university and lives a monotonous life. On orientation day she goes to the warehouse on an errand for her senior and witnesses a broom that transforms into a human. From that day on, the Broom Ghost persistently asks for help from Dan-Jo, who she has never met, saying she has nowhere to go. In the end, Dan-Jo accidentally gives the Broom Ghost, the name 'Eundohae', and they live together in a small gosiwon. In return the Broom Ghost promises to make Danjo happy.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

display_title: I'll Be Taking a Break for Personal Reasons
description:
My name is Yu Il-Sin, a third-rate web novel author. I discovered a strange gaming app and was judged to be a G-rank hunter. You save the world in the game and gain divine powers you can use in real life. It's a little bit strange, somehow? My follower count and the number of quests keep increasing. In the midst of this, when should I write my web novel? It's suspended for personal reasons... No, I'm starting the serialization.

(Source: Naver, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

In the smash hit game, \[Demon War 3\], there are ‘extras’ that die every day in all sorts of ways. But despite not contributing the slightest bit to the game, an extra named Evan D. Shelden has a death scene with exclusive computer graphics that stole the love of the production team! Damn it, isn’t that the name I received when I was reincarnated into this game world? I, someone who isn’t the main character and an extra who has too many deaths to count, must survive at all costs!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.*

*"I like big ones!!"*

Ji-Ho values ​​the size of a man's "sex" the most! The day after drinking with a big guy, his junior from school, Da-Bin, joins the company as a new employee. Ji-Ho even dated Da-Bin, who was close to her ideal type, but for some reason, Da-Bin ran away and left her behind... This man with a size(?) that he can't forget even after several years... I'm going to capture him!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Lim Hwa-Pyeong. Just like his name, he was a man who wanted to live a normal life. Everything he achieved was destroyed. 

\[ Your love has become hate for me.\] 

You shouldn’t have messed with me. You should have just let me live a quiet life. 

( Source: Kakaopage, translated )

The continuation of the story Red Fox. 

Sana, who was bestowed the destiny of eternal life, and the only being who can accept her, Iza. “The moments when you deeply yearn for someone always tend to come unexpectedly.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Soo-Hee grew up trapped in a household preaching about an old-policy that women must be submissive and modest. And at the age of 29, she left. Using an app on her phone for the first time in her life, she got connected with a man, whose personality and voice were her type. And during their first phone call... *"Your voice makes me so horny. The moment I heard your voice, I just wanted to do things like this."* She moaned silently as an attempt to suppress her moaning, she buried her head in her blanket. The man patiently waited for Soo-Hee's response, and as soon as she got quiet, he finally spoke. *"Now put your hand down there."*

display_title: I Became a Renowned Family's Sword Prodigy
description:
Baek Woo-Jin is the youngest son of a renowned swordsman family who has neither talent in swordsmanship nor an impressive Aura, despite trying harder than anyone. Although he was dishonored by his own family and killed, he reincarnates as the owner of a Magic Sword. His only goal is the destruction of his own family.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ara and Graham are childhood friends who used to have a sibling-like relationship. When they are finally placed in the same class (since the age of 8) as they enter their 2nd year of high school, their situation begins to change towards an unexpected direction. Will they be able to cross the line of dating, or not?

An offer to give 100 million won for bringing a ballpoint pen.  
For his family in need, Han Seojin pretends to be a partner for the night.  
He is heading to the house of Choi Moohyun, executive director of Daeil Air.  
But with a cynical smile and cold eyes, Muhyun, who looks clean and perfect without any flaws, pushed Seojin away.  
Seojin gives up his last pride and begs him…

[Original Novel](https://ridibooks.com/books/3074000270)

**Original Webtoon:**  
[RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/3846000142), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/trigger), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/trigger_), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000063192)

**Official Translations:**  
[French](https://www.lezhinfr.com/detail/bt_1110216), [Japanese](https://www.cmoa.jp/title/293891/), [German](https://www.lezhinde.com/detail/dbd_00058), [Thai](https://www.lezhinth.com/detail/thwt_3747)
*Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the novel of the same name.*
*Note: This is a one shot prologue for the web novel of the same name.*

During his school days, Seojin developed an interest in Seung-Woo, who would stare at him with a completely expressionless face. description:

Among the divine beasts, the rabbit spirit 'Bi-Yeon' is on the lowest level. Although he is the highest level of a divine beast, 'Do-Ryu' was born with a prophecy that he would destroy the country. Their meeting, disguised as chance, and his other self from his previous life, starts opening his eyes to new things.

When I returned to my senses, I discovered I was in the novel I was reading. Did a seventh-grade civil servant like me became the spoiled young master of the great Jaegal family?! An energy source that is tens of thousands of times more efficient than a steam engine has already existed in Jungwon… That is the martial arts. What if the principle of martial arts, which had been hidden by a few established powers from the past, was spread widely to the public by chance… If so, how would have the world change?

Seonghyeon returns 13 years back into the past to when he was 24 years old. And the method acting ability that goes into his scripts became the character itself! Okay, this life is about being reborn as a genius actor!

Nu-Ri finds themselves attending an all-boys high school, replacing Cha-Yeon, the son of a prestigious family who looks like her like two drops of water. But here's the catch: Nu-Ri is actually a girl! As she attempts to conceal her true identity, she befriends Seok-Yeong, a charming and caring classmate. Seeing a little too much... Follow Nu-Ri on this adventure where she will have to juggle between the weight of her secret and her budding feelings.

I went back to my university school days 20 years ago, in 2010. I'm 22 years old, but with 20 years of field experience, I'm going to fulfill my dream of being an architectural designer and make world famous designs of my own!

Rosetta, now wandering between pioneering a new life for herself and her inevitable destiny, continues to live in hardships even today.

He swallowed once and looked up at the hotel. Today, he hadn’t come to pick up a steak for his boss’s breakfast.

Today was the day he was meeting his boss’s family for marriage.

“Hey. Are you really going to marry me? You don’t even love me.”

Instead of answering, Yeonsim’s thoughts hurried back to two months ago.

***

Executive Director Seong Hyunho, infamous for his scandalous private life, had been caught leaving a hotel with his secretary on the very day of his formal meeting between families. His fiancée immediately called off the engagement, and Hyunho was in the middle of fleeing to avoid the chairman’s wrath.

Na Yeonsim, an employee who had been at the company for only a week, ended up hiding Seong Hyunho—the heir to Taekyung Group—under his desk, even while the chairman thundered in anger.

That was his mistake.

“Work with me.”   
"What... do you mean by that?"   
"I'm scouting you."

He wanted to say no. But Hyunho had taken a liking to Yeonsim’s quick thinking in hiding him and was completely stubborn about it. In the end, Yeonsim began his tearful life as a secretary.

"Just manage my private life."

Forced into becoming Hyunho’s secretary, Yeonsim was given the heavy responsibility of managing his boss’s scandalous private life.

And yet, the one who ended up rolling around in bed with him was Yeonsim himself—drunk out of his mind.

"Inside this peanut shape, this thing—it's beating."   
"What...... what's beating?"   
“The fetus heart.”

Just what exactly is this executive director, who doesn’t even seem surprised after getting a man pregnant?

And can I really give birth safely to this childish man’s baby?

It was a miserable day.  
She lived a life where she could not die.  
Rat, who lived in the slums, was in danger of being sold to a perverted nobleman.

“P-please save me…!”

Her first attempt at rebellion was easily thwarted, and she wondered if she would die like this.

“You’re safe now.”

She is saved by a man she meets for the first time.  
And a fantasy-like life is given to her.  
She gets to know her parents, who she thought never existed, and reclaims her real name, Irina.  
Among the kind-hearted people of the Winfried family, Irina heals her wounds and grows little by little.

“Miss Irina, make sure you’re happy here.”

The man who saved her, Duke Logan Winfried.  
Irina falls in love with him as if it were already set in place.

But why?  
Why do I feel empty somewhere even though our hearts are connected?  
Why do you look so distressed?

“You said you wanted me to be happy.”

So do I.  
I want you to be happy too.

display_title: I'm Dead, but the Hero Went Crazy (Pre-serialization)
description:
*This is a Promotional oneshot for the novel.*

As the hero's comrade, I died after blocking him from the evil dragon's breath. Well, it's fine. The Hero Elkinas was the only friend I trusted to have my back. I'll go out with a bang, I guess, so the hero can marry a pretty woman and live the rest of his life.

…Is what I thought would happen, but after 80 years passed, I came back to life in a completely different body. And… “It’s regrettable, Arlene. Elkinas went insane. Completely insane.” That was the first thing I heard.

What else could I do? I need to help my close friend who seems to have not been able to accept my death, so I decided to stay by his side while hiding my identity. This way he could completely accept the past and become happy, which is why I died for him. But… I think he recognized me. "You… You're Arlene, aren't you?"  
I touched my face. I definitely don't look like Arlene. Shouldn't there be no way he could know who I was?  
"I won't ever let you go… Ever," Elkinas said with shining eyes.

While we conquered cancer, dementia, and aging, and even solved the problem of global warming with space mirrors, humanity, pouring all its resources into overcoming global warming, spent the next century stagnant in many ways. Around the time humans were forced to abandon not only meat but even companion animals, humanity acknowledged its failure and established an AI government. The first-generation AI, "Virginia," freed humans from the obligation of labor through bold legislation and monetary management. However, it faced numerous trials and errors, one of which was the enactment of the Death with Dignity Act. While the human lifespan approached 200 years, a significant portion of humanity chose euthanasia before the age of 50. Most importantly, the suicide rate among women who advocated for euthanasia was catastrophic. Within 30 years of the Death with Dignity Act, the gender ratio collapsed beyond repair, and humanity's greatest enemy was not war or viruses, but depression and helplessness. The second-generation AI, "Agotha," ordered the abolition of the death with dignity law and the development of innovative antidepressants. Thanks to these drugs, which induce increased libido and short-term memory loss, humanity began to live their days, enjoying polyamory and VR sex. for Hyojung, it was a day when she didn't want to care about anything,
a day when she just wanted to go home.
Even to Hyojung, new friends naturally approach,
but opening her heart isn't easy for her.

Amidst this, a story reaches Hyojung's ears.
The subject is a quiet, reserved child in her class.
That child's name is Ha-an.

A grim rumor follows Ha-an:
someone refused his confession,
so Ha-an set something on fire.
Hyojeong draws a line, dismissing it as none of her concern.
But life never flows according to one's intentions.

Gyu-Rye, a second-year student at Yeonriji High School. He is at an age where he should be interested in love and good alarms, but what Gyu-Rye wants most is a lottery ticket to escape from a family that does not pay attention to him. Is he trying to grant his wish? One day, two people appear in front of Gyu-Rye. A game buddy and affectionate son, and a boy who claims to be Han Kang-Rin's childhood friend and makes him feel bad, Ok So-Han. One of these two is a lover from a past life 70 years ago who has a 'shield', and the other is an avenger who has a grudge from a past life with a 'spear'. 

A story of three people's entangled relationships that have continued for over 70 years, with their memories of past and present lives mixed up in a mess.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Office worker Hyun-Ah decides to spend a sweet week-long vacation at home with her dog, Gu-Bongi. She's excited to use the dog speaker (dog interpreter) she bought during her vacation... But that night, Gu-Bongi is whining and can't sleep, so she turns on the dog speaker and hears a single word: "Don't kill my owner!" 

Survive a week from a monster that can only be seen by dogs!

(Source: RIdibooks, translated)

Someone stole my movie from the future! 

A-Ram, who happened to go to the future, saw an impressive movie there and returned to make the same movie, but that work was a work for which Ga-Eun and U-Bin, who are currently film students, had just completed the script. A-Ram, realizing this fact, is obsessed with the desire to create her own work and tries to eliminate Ga-Eun and U-Bin. Ga-Eun and U-Bin fight against A-Ram to survive and to retrieve their future and precious works that were stolen by A-Ram. 

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

My younger brother who lives the perfect life that I made for him. Everything you enjoyed was mine. After her parents passed away, Lee Ryeong lived sacrificing for her twin brother Lee Seon. One day, when Lee Seon gets hurt before an important event, Lee Ryeong pretends to be Lee Seon for a month and lives her younger brother's life. As she experiences things she never had, her greed grows... 

*"I want to enjoy the things you enjoyed."*

(Source: Naver, translated)

Tae-eun', who came from the provinces and lived in a shabby old house, gave up on a pretty house in the evening. I live to save even a little bit, but the desire to live in a nice house is growing day by day.

I live alone in a nice house

With the scars of letting go of the cat I had been raising due to the stress of serialization

'Jungmoon', a webtoon writer who can't sleep well

First, he meets Tae-eun, who resembles the cat in appearance and even the feel of his fur, and falls into a sound sleep.

Sleep is essential to life.

Because he desperately needed that sleep, Jeong-moon made Tae-eun an offer that was difficult to refuse despite the embarrassment...

“Pretty person! I like you!” 

A 17-year-old dog-type who moved to Seoul from the countryside to find a new best friend, ‘Yuu’ meets ‘Robin’, a cat-type who is beautiful from head to toe, on the first day of school and makes a 100% straightforward confession. 

The two part ways without even exchanging names due to the annoying ringing of the bell, knowing Robin’s pounding heart. Yuu follows her scent to meet her again and debuts as a student council worker… 

The straightforward dog-type Yuu and the proud lover Robin’s crazy school life begins now! 

(source: Peanutoon, translated)

On his way to school as a senior, Parang feels nothing in particular. But into his colorless, monotonous daily life comes an unexpected variable: his first love.

*“Sir! Later on… please marry me!”*

However, his confessions, which continue for a whole year, fail every single time. On the snowy day of graduation, one word from Juhwan leads Parang to postpone university and decide to enlist in the military. As time passes, Parang, who thought he would never see Juhwan again, ends up reuniting with him by fate in an unexpected place.

*“Sir, I don’t have anywhere to stay. Could you let me stay just for one night…?”  
“Okay. You can stay.”*

Thus begins their sudden cohabitation-

Will Parang finally be able to achieve the first love he has longed for?

description:

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Ra-Ho and Bun-Hong live parallel lives that almost seem to touch, and snow and comets fall between them. Can the two cross the line to touch?

display_title: Miserere Mei: Have Mercy Upon Me
description:
"Listen, Catherine. All I need is a child. A child of Cavendish blood."
Just three months after their marriage, her husband died. He left a will asking her to bear a child who will continue the family line.
But Catherine could not have a Cavendish child. There was no man left in Cavendish who would continue that line. That’s what she thought.
“It’s a pleasure to meet you, my sister-in-law.”
But on the day of her husband’s funeral, her husband’s half-brother David, whom she never knew existed, appears and says,
“Get out the casket, get out the casket!”
Just before the burial, her husband Saul miraculously comes back to life and strange things begin to happen...

“Are you trying to shake my mentality and take away the top spot in the entire school?” 

Gaonnuri is the best specialized school where a path to success is guaranteed for its graduates. The top student here is not someone from a single family, but Ji-Ye, who came from an orphanage. On the outside, she wears the mask of a kind and pretty child who studies well, but inside, she is the queen of hypocrisy whose only goal is success. On the first day of the new semester, Seung-Jun, the third son of the country’s top hotel conglomerate and who looks like the main character of a pure love comic, confesses to Ji-Ye, whose heart starts to pound at the unexpected declaration of war…

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)
